articleTitle: A review on electric vehicles and renewable energy synergies in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Nowadays, global energy system and environment are facing enormous challenges. In the context of energy internet, transport fleet is transitioning to electric, plug-in and fuel cell vehicles and energy utilization are greener. The electric vehicles and renewable energy synergies in smart grid are of great significance for ensuring energy security, preventing air pollution and promoting energy saving and emission reduction. But due to the randomness, intermittent and power electronic of renewable energy, the synergies of electric vehicles and renewable energy are full of challenges. Firstly, the architecture of smart grid and the interaction between electric vehicles and renewable energy are depicted in this paper. Then, the impact of electric vehicles and renewable energy development is analyzed and according to the specific problem, the key technique including smart charging, coordinated scheduling and energy management is investigated. What is more, the economic and environmental impacts of synergies are analyzed. Finally, the existing problems in the current development are discussed and the future directions for electric vehicles and renewable energy are briefly given.

articleTitle: A very short term wind power forecasting approach based on numerical weather prediction and error correction method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The rapid development of wind power brings great stability challenge to power system due to the randomicity and uncertainty of wind power output. One effective way to overcome the challenge is wind power forecasting. A novel very short-term wind power forecasting approach based on numerical weather prediction and error correction method is presented in the paper. From the statistical analysis of the error probability density distribution of Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) based wind power prediction, an error estimation model is presented and an error correction method is proposed. The key step of correction method is calculating the corresponding prediction uncertainties according to the predict value. This method combines the advantages of both error estimation model and error probability density distribution, which is evaluated with the data from 7 wind farms and numerical weather prediction, and is proved to be an effective way to improve the accuracy of very short term wind power forecasting.

articleTitle: Study on the impact of voltage sags on different types of electric vehicle chargers
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage sags can lead to abnormal operation of electric vehicle charging equipment, but the problem has not been paid more attention now. With the gradual increase in the application of electric vehicles, it is necessary to study the impacts of voltage sags on the electric vehicles charging. The simulation models of 6-pulse rectifier charger, 12-pulse rectifier charger and PWM rectifier charger are established, then the impacts of different severity and different types of voltage sags on chargers working in different conditions are analyzed and the degree of influence is assessed. The simulation results show that the impacts of voltage sags on chargers are not only related to the strength and types of voltage sags, but also related to the working state of the chargers.

articleTitle: Two-stage stochastic optimization for unit commitment considering wind power based on scenario analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the unit commitment problem considering wind power, a two-stage stochastic optimization model aiming at minimizing the expected operational cost is implemented. In the first stage, we use the forecasted wind power as input, the unit startup and shutdown plan and generation schedule is made day-ahead while satisfying the constraints; the second stage is related to real-time operation of power system, we adopt dynamic scenario analysis to model the uncertainty of wind power, and evaluate the required reserve quantity of the scheduling plan determined in stage one. After the overall consideration of the two-stage decision problem, the final generation schedule is obtained. The proposed two-stage stochastic optimization model is applied to a modified IEEE 30-bus system. The simulation results show that the proposed model can perform daily energy and reserve scheduling and reduce the expected operational cost reasonably and effectively.

articleTitle: Research of an active and reactive power coordinated control method for photovoltaic inverters to improve power system transient stability
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, the installed capacity of photovoltaic (PV) power keeps increasing rapidly. However, the typical control objective of the PV system is to provide as much active power to the system as possible, ignoring the reactive operating characteristics of PV inverters. On this basis, an active and reactive power coordinated control method of PV system suitable for electromechanical transient stability analysis is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model for PV inverters is established. Then, a novel active and reactive power coordinated control method based on an improved double-loop control scheme is proposed, according to the steady-state active and reactive power operating limits of PV inverters. The voltage control loop is to get active and reactive current component references, combining the maximum active power point tracking under present solar irradiation and reactive power controlling under system voltage requirements; the current loop realizes the active power and reactive power coordinated control. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed control method on power system transient stability is tested, based on the IEEE standard test system. Simulation results show that the proposed coordinated control method for photovoltaic inverters is helpful in improving the angle stability and voltage stability of power systems.

Author Keywords: Active and Reactive Power Coordinated Control Method

articleTitle: The implementation of the Internet of Things technology in Henan smart distribution network demonstration project
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Internet of Things (IOT) technology is highly integrated and comprehensively used of new generation information technology, which has been promoted as national development strategy by the state council. Smart grid is an important application field of IOT technology. In order to accelerate the convergence of IOT technology and smart grid, the State Grid Corporation of China organized IOT technology demonstration project in Henan Hebi in 2013, selecting two 10kV distribution lines to carry out distribution network equipment with on-line monitoring, condition-based maintenance and life-cycle management based on IOT technology to resolve operational management, lacking of condition-based maintenance means etc. The project achieved good results through the practical application.

articleTitle: Analysis of short-circuit current calculation method in wind power plant design
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the differences between wind power plant and normal power plant in mathematical model and network structure, it will lead to great discrepancy between the results worked respectively by the practical method of normal short-circuit current calculation and the international popular IEC60909 method in engineering design. Therefore this paper analyzes the differences between the two methods and put forward an improved practical method. Finally with the simplified modeling of collection lines, the effectiveness and feasibility of this method is verified by the actual wind power plant data and simulation results with ETAP. This method offers some ideas to the establishment of uniform standards of short-circuit current calculation method of wind power plant in our country.

articleTitle: An analysis of market mechanism and bidding strategy for power balancing market in micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the penetration of renewable energy sources such as photovoltaics or wind power, it becomes a more important issue to keep power system stable in terms of power balance with proper frequency. To this end, balancing markets have been developed and utilized in order to ensure the security of frequency regulation with lower cost based on the market principle. For example, in the European countries and regions, secondary and tertiary control balancing energy have been traded through balancing markets. Although the details about those market mechanisms are different from country to country, there are two mainstreams: “uniform-price auction” based on marginal fuel cost and “pay-as-bid auction” with discriminatory pricing. Under the uniform-price auctions, all players whose biddings are cleared receive the same market-clearing price which is the highest offer price cleared. In contrast, in the case of pay-as-bid auction, prices paid to cleared players are based on their own actual discriminatory bidding price, rather than the highest clearing price. For power suppliers, one of the most important issues is how to determine the bidding strategy in the electricity balancing auction market to satisfy their profit-maximizing goals. In this paper, supposing the frequency regulation in Micro-grid will be also realized based on balancing market, fundamental characteristics of two auction mechanisms, uniform-price and pay-as-bid methods, were examined. The behavior of each player in the balancing market, namely bidding strategy, is modelled by using Q-Learning algorithm to maximize player's profit. In this approach, the bidding strategy is regarded as one kind of stochastic optimal control problems and agent-based simulations are performed in which each player can learn from past experience. The performance comparison of the balancing market is discussed based on the simulation results.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of distribution network considering the randomness of distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper studies the reliability evaluation algorithm of power distribution network with distributed generation. The randomness of the output power of photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation is studied firstly. According to the randomness of the output power of distributed generation. By Latin hypercube sampling, the reliability evaluation model of distribution network which considers the randomness of distributed generation is established. According to the importance of load, this paper builds an optimization model of islanding division in the power distribution network with distributed generation. On this basis, combining with the analysis of network topology, the reliability evaluation algorithm of power distribution network with distributed generation based on Monte Carlo timing simulation method is proposed. Finally, by using the proposed model and algorithm, this paper makes a simulation calculation to the main feeder F4 of IEEE RBTS Bus6 system, and verifies the validity and practicability of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the load characteristics of inverter and constant speed air conditioner and the influence on distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the increasingly wide usage of air conditioners, more attention has been paid to its modeling and the impact on distribution operation. To improve load modeling for conventional constant speed air conditioner and new inverter air conditioner, operation characteristics for these two types are investigated through a specialized test platform in this paper. Energy efficiency effects of these two types are compared based on long term operation data. Effective load model for power flow studies is proposed in accordance with static operation characteristics analysis. Advice on load modeling for dynamic simulation is provided. In addition, the impact on distribution operation is compared for these two types of air conditioners under conditions involving start, dynamic response and stall shut-down. The inverter air conditioner is reviewed to be more convenient for distribution operation.

articleTitle: A SCADA data based anomaly detection method for wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a data driven method for Wind Turbine system level anomaly detection is proposed. Supervisory control and data acquisition system (SCADA) data of a wind turbine is adopted and several parameters are selected based on physic knowledge and correlation coefficient analysis to build a normal behavior model. This model is based on Self-organizing map (SOM) which can project higher dimensional SCADA data into a two-dimension-map. After that, the Euclidean distance based indicator for system level anomalies is defined and a filter is created to screen out suspicious data points based on quantile function. Moreover, a failure data pattern based criterion is created for anomaly detection from system level. The method is tested with a two-month SCADA dataset with the measurement interval as 20 seconds. Results demonstrate capability and efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Methods for transient AC overvoltage reduction at wind farm terminal
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the booming developing wind power market, wind converters are one of the key equipment for wind power integration in the power system. However, the overvoltage level that wind converters can withstand is relatively low compared with the conventional power generation system. Large amount of WTGs might trip due to overvoltage protection if the transient AC overvoltage in the system is too high. Therefore, it is important to limit the transient AC overvoltage in the system. This paper mainly presents four different methods for transient AC overvoltage reduction at wind farm terminal, which could reduce the trip risk of large amount of wind turbine generators (WTGs) and increase the operation stability of the power system integrated with wind power.

articleTitle: Cost-benefit calculation and analysis of V2G system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the new electricity tariff market, as an important part of the smart grid, V2G (vehicle-to-grid) has been obtained widespread concern and in-depth study. In this paper, taking the scenario of year 2020 in the urban district of Chongqing, China for example, the size of EVs (electric vehicles) and EV charging facilities are estimated, and V2G system's net revenue are calculated. The results show that earnings per V2G electric car is still too small, and it's not enough to stimulate electric car owners to participate in V2G mode. The main reason is that the high cost per kWh of EV battery and relatively small peak-valley electricity price ratio.

articleTitle: Study on influence of large-scale electric vehicle charging and discharging load on distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large-scale plug-in electric vehicles charge and discharge in distribution system is the inevitable trend of the development of future electric vehicle industry and V2G technology. Different electric vehicle charging and discharging technology and strategy will cause different influence to distribution system. The paper introduces the actuality and trends of electric vehicles home and abroad from the car types and policy. Based on analyzing the existing electric vehicle's charging and discharging mode, the impacts and research status of large-scale electric vehicles charging and discharging on distribution system is discussed in the viewpoint of reliability, economy, environmental benefits, and cooperation with intermittent energy. Finally, possible future electric vehicle development trend is presented.

articleTitle: A novel control strategy based on DC bus signaling for DC micro-grid with photovoltaic and battery energy storage
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: DC type micro-grids are developing fast for their flexibility in recent years and dc bus signaling (DBS) strategy is always used to manage a dc micro-grid, where PVs are often switched between controlled current source (CCS) and controlled voltage source (CVS). Conventional-DBS switches the working mode of the power electronic devices in the system by detecting the bus voltage in order to control the bus voltage to a certain range. This paper has proposed a novel control strategy based on DBS for dc micro-grid consisting of photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage, where the PVs of the dc micro-grid serve as CCS all along. Simulation results have verified the reasonability and flexibility of the proposed control strategy through the MATLAB/SIMULINK simulation platform.

articleTitle: Optimal power flow research on distributed network considering distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because more distribution generations are added to the distribution network, the power flow of the distribution network is changed. The analysis and Research on the power flow of distribution network with distributed generation is an important means to analyze the influence of distributed generation on distribution network. First, Newton-Raphson algorithm is applyed to calculate the power flow of the distribution network with distributed generation. Then the optimal power flow model of the distribution network is set up based on the objective function of the minimum loss in the network. Finally, the optimization problem is solved by using the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. The simulation is tested and verified by using IEEE14 node system in the MATLAB software. The test results show that the optimal power flow research on distribution network with distributed generation can reduce the loss of the network and improve the economy of the system.

articleTitle: Life cycle management system of power transmission and transformation equipment based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the energy demand increases, the coverage area of interconnected power grid gradually expanded, the number, variety and complexity of the transmission and substation equipment have increased rapidly, the safe operation of electrical power equipment become more important to the safe and reliable operation of the grid. At present, domestic and abroad condition monitoring and management of power transmission equipment have a lot of study, but there are still have a lot of problems, for instance, panoramic views of the state lacks sharing and analysis of analytical equipment, intelligent equipment is not high, the timeliness of diagnosis and decision-making, interactivity and automation level is not enough, the whole life cycle has lacking of integration and closed-loop problems. While, the Internet of Things (IOT) of electrical power equipment enriches and expands the network properties of the smart grid, and greatly supports the realization of electrical power equipment intelligent in technology. The operation status monitoring, fault diagnosis, condition assessment and life-cycle management of electrical power equipment has important scientific significance and application value to improve its operation reliability and utilization, as well as to achieve its optimal management. Therefore, how to construct power transmission technology based on networking equipment intelligent monitoring and having a full life-cycle management capabilities networking, It has great scientific and practical significance to enhance the safe and stable operation and the grid operation risk control of electrical power equipment and power grid.

articleTitle: An analytical method for intelligent electricity use pattern with demand response
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Intelligent electricity is one important part of the smart grid, and it lead to the new electricity utilization patterns of families, as the interaction mode between smart grid and users. This paper proposes an analytical method of users' electricity utilization behaviors for the future intelligent electricity utilization environment. First of all, based on the intelligent electricity scene, users' specific intelligent electricity behavior is analyzed. Then, according to the characteristics of intelligent power consumption behavior about the demand response, distributed generators and plug-in electric vehicles, the load model is built based on intelligent electricity. The paper proposes an analytical method for users' power behavior, which is based on pattern recognition. The feature selection method based on information measure is used. Considering the features of intelligent electricity behaviors, the heuristic forward sequence search strategy for feature optimization is used to select corresponding characteristics from the common feature space and compose the feature set. The fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, the initial clustering center of which is improved, is used for different users' intelligent electricity behaviors clustering. In the numerical example, at first, we get the intelligent power simulation load via the load model, and adopt the proposed method in this paper to achieve users' electricity pattern recognition, aiming at the above simulation load. Then we get different electricity categories of users. Analyzing the characteristics of users category curves, we can match them with the corresponding users' behaviors. The experiment proves that the analytical method proposed in this paper, which is about users' electricity utilization behavior, can effectively identify users with different intelligent behaviors.

articleTitle: Hierarchical coordinated control of multi bus-based DC microgrid considering fault occurred in buses
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Multi bus-based dc microgrid has serious merits such as the higher reliability of power supply and flexibility of distributed energy and loads connecting into the system. Its stable operation would be destroyed by the power fluctuation and bus faults. Therefore, the coordinated control strategy, including five hierarchical levels, is proposed to ensure the stable operation of dc microgrid. The stable operation in case of bus non-fault is guaranteed by the 1st to 4th control levels and the reliable operation is safeguarded by the 5th control level after fault occurred in one of the buses. The bus voltage acts as a monitor of supply-demand balance, and it's controlled in allowable fluctuation range, which is proved by a dc microgrid model in MATLAB/ Simulink. Meanwhile, the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy for the DC MG operating in both islanding and grid-connected modes is verified.

articleTitle: The research on market power and risk analysis of electricity retailers in China distribution and retail market
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: China launched a new power system reform in 2015, and related documents issued with reform have brought the impact on power distribution and retail market. Mixed ownership and private capital has introduced in power distribution and retail market with grid enterprise remains. Market power of electricity retailers in distribution and retail market is researched and risk of retailers is analyzed in the research. Firstly, business categories of electricity retailers in China distribution and retail market is researched that based on domestic and foreign electricity market structures. And then the welfare effect of stakeholders in distribution and retail market is analyzed via the business model of stakeholders in distribution and retail market. Finally, risk of each retailer is analyzed via analytic hierarchy process (AHP) that base on the theory of fuzzy. The case study shows that the competitive mainly existed between weaker market power retailers and retailers with weaker market power faced more risks.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of distribution system with DG considering operation homogeneity
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Operation homogeneity is a basic state property of distribution system with DG. It is related to the active power of bus and DG in the distribution system with DG. Load, network and element parameters are the influencing factors too. High-reliability supplying for power users is a very important feature of distribution system with DG, and it is the material basis for the high satisfaction of power users. In this paper, the operation homogeneity index, reliability indices and the line loose which is the characteristic of economy are calculated and analyzed based on the modified IEEE-33 system. The results show that these reliability index demand bigger DG active power, while these homogeneity indices, security index, economy index needing moderate DG active power. Operation and planning department will decide the operation scheme in practical work.

articleTitle: Research on risk assessment and early warning in active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The access of distributed generation has grant influences on the power distribution system network structure and as a consequence, changes its failure risk. This article presents a power failure risk evaluation model of power distribution network, which including two aspects of device level and feeder level. In the first place, the risk of the power distribution network containing distributed generation will be evaluated from two aspects, device failure possibility and device failure severity. Basing on varies devices' evaluation, through the comprehensive evaluation method to quantify the feeder's risk of failure. When the risk exceeds the threshold value, the system would start its safety precaution. Numerical example results show that, the evaluation method that this article established can realize the risk evaluation and early warning of the power distribution network containing distributed generation, the results have guiding significance for construction retrofitting, and hastens the optimal operation for active power distribution network.

articleTitle: The research on the integration of energy storage and generating wind turbine system model
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the wind power penetration, control the volatility of the wind, this paper has carried out the research on the integration of energy storage and generating wind turbine system model. The idea has been gained based on the analysis of the current wind turbine system, wind turbine system with low wind speed starting and running and the integration of energy storage and generating wind turbine system. Local energy storage, distributed energy storage and centralized energy storage has been discussed in this paper. Two kinds of wind turbine system model based on local energy storage which are energy storage in the front of generator and in the back of generator also have been studied.

Author Keywords: energy storage in the back of generator
energy storage in the front of generator
the integration of energy storage and generating

articleTitle: Generating units maintenance scheduling considering peak regulation pressure with large-scale wind farms
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Owing to the increasing connection of large-scale wind farms to the grid, recent electrical power system significantly requires much more precise decisions in the dispatching and operation. In some parts of China, the insufficient of local consumptive ability for wind energy, for the lack of peak regulation ability in power system, leads to a large amount of abandoned wind energy in valley period. Therefore, considering the operational characteristics of wind power and the peak regulation ability of power system when planning a generating units maintenance scheduling will be of great significance for the exploit of wind power and safe operation of power system. In addition, more and more recent research on maintenance scheduling pay attention to the peak regulation problem. In the power system including large-scale wind farms, a maintenance scheduling model for generating units with a synthetic consideration of maintenance reliability, economy and peak regulation pressure balance is proposed. The objective function of this model is a combination of generating costs, maintenance costs and peak regulation pressure penalty fee, along with the constraint including the basic ones such as reliability of power system, continuity, duration and resources of generating units maintenance, and an additional one for peak regulation pressure balance. For the reason that the proposed model above is a nonlinear optimization problem comprising a plurality of constraints, genetic algorithm is applied to solve the proposed model due to its wide adaptability and good robustness. The proposed method has been explored on the IEEE reliability test system (IEEE-RTS), and the wind power data is provided by a wind farm in Hunan province for which this old system itself is not included. A comparison is made in this study between two situations that for one the peak regulation pressure balance is considered and the other one is not. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the prosed model is confirmed by the test result.

articleTitle: Electrical model and control method of heat pump water heaters for promoting renewable integration
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Heat pump water heaters (HPWHs) have a high energy transformation efficiency, which contributes to their wide utilization in public buildings and residences. This paper proposes the electrical model of HPWHs, which describes the heating function, electricity utilization, user comfort requirements and physical constraints of HPWHs. A novel control method using the heat demand as control criterion is then proposed. The purpose of controlling HPWHs is to make good use of their energy storage ability. For a distribution grid with massive HPWHs installed, properly controlled HPWHs can modify the load curve, thus promoting the integration of renewables. A case study based on a real-world distribution system demonstrates that the electrical model of HPWHs well represents their characteristics, and the control method is effective in promoting renewable integration with HPWHs. The impacts of massive HPWHs on the load curve are also investigated.

articleTitle: Operational risk assessment of distribution network with consideration of PV output uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a large amount of photovoltaics integrating into distribution system, uncertainties of PV output have significant impacts on system operation. This paper proposes an operational risk assessment framework for distribution network with high penetration of PVs. With consideration of uncertainties, a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN) model is developed to perform probabilistic forecasting on PV power productions. The impacts of PV outputs on system operation are measured by thermal and voltage severity indices. Operational risk indices are then calculated by multiplying the probabilities of PV outputs with the thermal and voltage severity indices. Case studies on an IEEE 53-bus test system validate the feasibility of the proposed framework that can help system operators quantify operational risk on distribution network with consideration of PV output uncertainties.

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization for distribution system with distributed generations based on AHSPSO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distributed generation (DG) has significant effects on the voltage quality and economic operation of distribution network. Taking reactive powers supplied by DGs and reactive power compensation equipment as control variables, the reactive power optimization problem in distribution power system with DGs is researched and an adaptive harmony search-particle swarm optimization (AHSPSO) algorithm is proposed. Considering economic factors, the multi-objective reactive power optimization model of distribution power system with DGs is established firstly. Then a new hybrid algorithm - AHSPSO algorithm is proposed based on the improved harmony search (HS) algorithm and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. Compared with original HS and PSO in a modified IEEE 33-bus system simulation analysis, the results show that the proposed algorithm has stronger global search capability, higher convergence accuracy and faster convergence rate. Besides, taking DG as a mean of reactive power compensation can effectively reduce the power loss and improve the node voltage level. AHSPSO algorithm is suitable for solving the reactive power optimization problem in distribution power system with DGs.

articleTitle: Security analysis and access protection of power distribution wireless private TD-LTE network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper investigates into the security challenges of power distribution wireless private TD-LTE network (PDWPN) and proposes a systematic security protection architecture with a secure access scheme. The security challenges are discussed from link/entity/terminal perspectives, based on which a “triple-domain, triple-layer, triple-plane” security protection architecture for PDWPN is proposed. A security access scheme consisting of three procedures, i.e., terminal registration, authentication and key negotiation, security activation at access and non-access layers, is further analyzed to achieve the secure access of PDWPN and ensure the safe operation of PDWPN and power distribution network.

articleTitle: An electric shock impedance modeling method of living organisms in low-voltage distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the refusing action and maloperation problem of electric shock of living organisms of Residual Current operated protective Device (RCD) in low voltage distribution network, an electric shock impedance modeling method is proposed in this paper. Trough building up the experiment test bed of electric shock of living organisms, electric shock voltage and current data are collected. After filtering the original electric shock signal, the electric shock voltage and current signal are transformed from time domain to frequency domain by using Fast Fourier Transform. Electric shock voltage and current power frequency component can be extracted. The total electric impedance amplitude and phase values of the living organisms are from Ohm law. Based on the group of 30 electric shock impedance values, using data fitting method to calculate the value of the living organisms electric impedance amplitude and phase. Then, the digital simulation model is set up by using Simulink of MATLAB. Through validating of the impedance modeling, the results show that the model can reproduce the transient process of electric shock organism well. Experiments and results show that the proposed modeling method can improve the operation of RCD with better accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Wide-area damping controller design of large-scale PV power plants in interconnected power systems
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High penetration of photovoltaic (PV) generation has become a reality in many power systems. The impacts of large-scale grid-connected PV on low frequency oscillation stability cannot be ignored. This paper presents a method for the wide-area damping controller design for the suppression of inter-area oscillation using auxiliary signals in PV controller. Firstly, the capability of low frequency oscillation suppression using PV is investigated. Then a low order damping controller for inter-area oscillation suppression is designed based on phase compensation. Dominant mode ratio (DMR) is also employed to select the optimal feedback signals of supplementary controller. Finally, a simulation model of two-area four-generator system with a large-scale grid-connected PV power plant is established. The effectiveness of damping controller is validated both from the results of eigenvalue analysis and time domain simulations.

articleTitle: Operation and maintenance analysis for power communication networks based on big data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To support the reliable operation and reasonable construction demands of power communication networks, this paper uses Big Data technologies to analyze the equipment operation and maintenance status of power communications networks based on the equipment ledger, failure and maintenance data. The actual network data is mined using this method, and according to the data mining result, the equipment operation and maintenance situation of power communication networks is analyzed from the points of maintenance effect, maintenance cost and time distribution of maintenance.

articleTitle: Short-term PV generation forecasting based on weather type clustering and improved GPR model
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A combined prediction method based on weather type index and Gaussian Process Regression(GPR) improved by linear weight reduction PSO algorithm was proposed to deal with the problem of forecasting of short-term PV generation. Firstly, the samples, according to the weather type index, was built, and then three types were classified based on daily mean temperature and humanity; the different GPR model, considering different highly correction factors, which measuring combined covariance functions and taking LinW-PSO to optimize the hyperparameters of model, were built; The corresponding computer code was programmed in MATLAB. Seen from simulation results of forecasting of the PV station in XinJiang, the given classification method and LinW-PSO-GPR combination predicting method enable the rate of convergence and the accuracy of results improved.

articleTitle: Frequency domain harmonic model of electric vehicle charger using three-phase uncontrolled rectifier
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The harmonic pollution of electric vehicle (EV) charging station is mainly caused by the former level uncontrolled or thyristor-controlled rectification circuit of charger. In allusion to the charger which adopts three-phase uncontrolled rectifier with passive power factor correction, this paper analyzes the operating principle of charging current in continuous and discontinuous mode. According to the voltage and current balance equations in charging process, the frequency-domain harmonically coupled admittance matrices of charger are derived, and the parameters of the harmonic admittance matrix under different operating modes are gained on the basis of the charging equivalent circuit, therefore the frequency-domain harmonic analytical model of EV charger is established. This model transforms the time-domain nonlinear characteristic of charger into frequency-domain linear admittance matrix to represent the coupling relationship between current harmonic and terminal voltage harmonic of charger. Finally, the accuracy of the model proposed this paper is verified by the simulation analysis and experiment test.

articleTitle: Optimal layout and scale of charging stations for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering energy security and environmental protection, electric vehicles will become a major choice for developing China's automobile industry. The popularization of electric vehicles depends on convenient charging. As the theoretical basis for charging stations, a dynamic traffic network method is used to build a multi-objective optimization model with hard-time-window constraint to obtain the optimal layout and scale of these charging stations. In this model, a minimum capital and charging cost is considered as the optimal objective, and a two-phase heuristic algorithm is proposed to solve this model. Finally, a case study on a simple example verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model. Results show that the layout of electric vehicle charging stations is determined by the charging demand of different locations and charging time constraints, and that the scale of charging stations is related to the number of electric vehicles, layout of charging stations and duration of charging at peak hours.

articleTitle: Practical experience using VLF Tan Delta and partial discharge measurement in medium voltage cable
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Condition assessment of power cables is one of the most important tasks in maintenance and management of power networks. Significant investment has been made to ensure the reliability of cable systems. Very Low Frequency (VLF) test is an alternative method for 50 Hz AC voltage test. Using VLF voltage source, Tan Delta (TD) and Partial Discharge (PD) measurement can be carried out simultaneously. TD measurement is a nondestructive integral test to assess the overall cable condition, while PD measurement can be used to localize defects that generate electric discharge activities. This paper focuses on the practical experience using combined VLF testing with TD and PD to assess health condition and localize defects in medium voltage cables. Field experience with VLF TD and PD will be shared. Detailed testing and evaluation technique will be described.

articleTitle: Evaluation of impact of integrated distributed generation on distribution network based on time-series analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents comprehensive quantification indices to evaluate the influences of distributed generation (DG) integration on distribution network from three aspects, which involve voltage quality, economics and hosting capacity. Based on the modified IEEE 13-nodes test system, the time-series power flow analysis of DG integration is carried out for duration of one day. The proposed indices are calculated and analyzed according to the different time-series simulation scenarios to evaluate the different DG integration cases, which has the great theoretical and practical significance for the development and application of DG integration.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation for charging piles in multi-areas considering charging load forecasting based on Markov chain
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the complexity and diversity of user travel habits, and satisfying the charging demands, charging piles in different areas should be reasonable planned. Firstly, Markov chain is used to describe changes in battery state of charge with three decision-making behavior including driving, charging, neither charging nor driving of electric vehicle owner's trip in the whole day. According to real-time charging behavior in the process, the fast and slow charging demand of different vehicle types are predicted. Then considering mobility characteristics of electric vehicles and the number of different types of electric vehicles in different time periods in some area, the total load demand would be predicted. The optimization model aims to minimize investment and operating and maintenance costs for the charging piles, which takes balanced electric vehicle movement characteristics inequality constraints into account, and is realized by particle swarm optimization algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the simulation on 33-bus system.

articleTitle: A distribution network state estimation method based on power user electric energy data acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on power user electric energy data acquisition system, a state estimation method for the distribution network is presented in this paper. In the method, the node voltage and angle of the feeder are treated as condition variables. And the measured voltage, current, active and reactive power on load side from electric energy data acquire system are treated as measuring variables to supplement SCADA measurements and enhance the redundancy and accuracy of state estimation algorithm. Then by the Newton-based state estimation algorithm, all distribution network feeder operational conditions, node voltage and power are estimated. The result can help the operator get more information about the network and make more scientific decision. Finally the method is applied on IEEE13 and IEEE34 systems simulated by MATLAB, and the result indicates that the proposed approach is applicable and effective.

Author Keywords: Power user electric energy data acquisition system

articleTitle: The arcing fault based multi-cycle incipient fault detection for underground cable
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for detecting a multi-cycle incipient fault in an underground cable. The incipient faults are recognized as self-clearing arcing faults and detection method is performed by calculating fault point voltage total harmonic distortion (THD) for all possible distances in the cable. The arc fault is detected when the fault point voltage THD at any assumed fault distance is larger than the threshold. The proposed arcing fault detection method eliminates the effect of fault distance. The proposed incipient fault detection has been verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulations. Results show that the proposed method is effective and accurate. Lab experiments are also conducted to further validate the proposed detection method.

articleTitle: Optimal feature selection for partial discharge recognition of cable systems based on the random forest method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Optimal feature selection is one of the most significant challenges of Partial Discharge (PD) pattern recognition of cable system as the number of PD features is with large quantity, which reduces the efficiency of PD pattern recognition methods and restricts the effectiveness of PD based condition monitoring and diagnostics. To overcome the challenge a random forest method is presented in the paper to select the most effective PD features from 18 different kinds of features. Firstly, PD data from five types of artificial defects based on IEC 60270 system in High Voltage (HV) lab is introduced. Secondly, PD data pre-processing and feature extraction are carried out and 18 kinds of PD features are extracted from the raw data. Thirdly, the random forest method based optimal feature selection is presented in details and compared with Lasso method. Finally, the feature selection methods are evaluated with Random Forest and Logistic Regression based PD pattern recognition method. The top 6 features are recommended for PD pattern recognition based on the experimental data and the random forest method.

articleTitle: Assessment of AC/DC hybrid microgrids based on grey comprehensive evaluation theory
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of distributed generation and expansion of load types, more and more AC/DC hybrid microgrids are gradually formed at the terminal of distribution network, which influence the safety and stability of the distribution network severely. This paper researches the planning program, power supply reliability and power quality of the hybrid microgrids, analyzes the influence of DC distribution network integrating into traditional AC distribution network. Afterwards, a comprehensive evaluation index system considering both AC and DC power supply model is proposed and set up for the grey comprehensive evaluation model. Finally, in order to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed evaluation system and evaluation model, an assessment case is studied.

articleTitle: The bi-level programming model of load transferring strategy based on topological units of high-voltage distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A load transferring strategy for High-voltage distribution network (HVDN) is presented in this paper to mitigate operation congestion in urban power system. A novel bi-level programming model based on topological units (group) is established in this paper instead of traditional intelligent algorithm with 0–1 integer variables. In the upper level, the balance factor is defined to guide the reasonable load allocation of the system, while the load shedding factor is to coordinate the unbalance between transformer capacity and load in emergency; In the lower level, the supply channel matrix is used to execute orders from upper and feedback the results. The simulation using proposed models is verified in simplifying decision space which is very suitable for online analysis.

articleTitle: Integrating high-penetration renewable energy into power system — A case study
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A case study of high-penetration renewable energy integration into power system is an important part to promote the development and utilization of renewable energy. The feasibility of a series of measures such as output control of generation side, transferring power supply control of grid side and load regulation of demand side is analyzed. From the perspective of economics, the economic value such as grid loss and permeability of a variety of ways is calculated, and the cost-benefit is assessed and the optimization strategy is analyzed, a case which has the actual parameters of the real network is provided and it can be used for active distribution system planning and operation research. At the same time, this paper figures out the power inverse of distribution network, load forecasting, optimization of control strategy, reducing the grid loss and other issues of research.

articleTitle: Benefits analysis of smart grid demonstration projects
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Three example benefits analyses of smart grid demonstration projects are reported. Two U.S. projects are both in Irvine, CA. Southern California Edison's Irvine Smart Grid Demonstration project achieved excellent results for Volt-VAR control, but 9 demonstration zero net energy homes proved far from economic. A microgrid controller being developed for the U.C. Irvine campus promises valuable reliability benefits, and its combined heat and power plant delivers significant ongoing benefits. At the Tianjin Eco-city, multiple demonstrations have been effective technically, but fall short of economic viability.

articleTitle: VPP frequency response feature based on distributed control strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Virtual power plant(VPP) integrate distributed power, energy storage device and load, through reasonable control mode, the virtual power plant will have the same controllable external characteristics as the traditional power plant, such as maximum power generation capacity, minimum technical output, climbing rate, and frequency regulation characteristic etc. This paper presents a control strategy for the frequency modulation characteristics control of virtual power plant, which is suitable for the non-center control, by the pinning node of directly receiving the power grid dispatching instruction to convey information to all nodes in the virtual power plant, complete distributed pinning control, to meet the power grid scheduling requirements for the overall power adjustment. The numerical examples are verified by the electricity-communication interactive simulation platform, power simulation is done by MATLAB, and the communication simulation is done by OPNET, through COSIM interactive interface, interactive simulation platform will be able to simulate the impact of different communication architecture on frequency modulation control performance. The numerical examples show that the distributed pinning control strategy could effectively accomplish the task of frequency modulation control in virtual power plant, and make a beneficial exploration for virtual power plant engineering practice.

articleTitle: The application of a generator coherency identification method based on linearization in complex power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper introduces a practical generator coherency identification method based on the linearization of non-equilibrium points. The oscillation modes between generators can be obtained using the eigenvalues of coefficient matrix of linearized models. In both cases all the eigenvalues are non-positive or not, the dominant oscillation mode affecting rotor angle trajectories are determined. Then a concept of coherency index is defined according to the eigenvector corresponding to the dominant oscillation mode and the detailed procedure of generator grouping is presented based on the coherency index. Using this approach, we can identify generator coherent groups continuously along the trajectory. Finally, simulations on IEEE 39-bus and IEEE 118-bus test systems verify the practicability and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design and application of integrated distribution network line loss analysis system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Line loss calculation of distribution network is critical to energy saving and comprehensive line loss analysis is an in-depth research for theoretical line loss calculation, which helps to achieve meticulous management of loss management and grid operation. This article describes various methods of line loss calculation and common algorithms. A comprehensive distribution network line loss analysis system is proposed and its feasibility is verified by practical examples.

articleTitle: State evaluation of power cable based on RBF information fusion algorithm using multi-parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of electric power industry, power cable will play a more and more important role not only widely used in distribution network, but also in the field of AC/DC and high voltage transmission system. Power cable is generally underground or underwater, the problem that fault concealment and long time troubleshooting make serious impact on the power supply reliability of power system. Evaluate real-time operation state of power cable by using multi-parameters from variety of monitoring and detection information, and strengthen early defect equipment monitoring on the basis of evaluation result, it can reduce equipment failure rate and prevent accident expanding and it has very important significance for improving power supply reliability, From the perspective of information fusion, the method of evaluation algorithm based on RBF (Radial basis function) neural network is proposed. Multi-parameter including online detection data, environmental factors, testing and equipment information is used to conduct a comprehensive evaluation on cable status. The method using data fusion in decision-making level by RBF neural network for results of different algorithms including catastrophe theory and ANP fuzzy theory can make up applicability problem of different evaluation algorithm, and achieve complementary functions between the algorithms. To further adapt to the actual conditions of parameters, the integrity of input parameters was associated to credibility of evaluation results, it will make evaluation results more complete. The affectivity of the algorithm was verified by practical data.

articleTitle: An improved fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm for transformer fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Normal operation of the transformer is an important guarantee of the reliability of the power system. The transformer fault diagnosis is an important basis for transformer maintenance. Three-ratio method is widely used in oil-immersed transformer fault diagnosis, however the encoded value is too severe to correspond to the type of failure. FCM (Fuzzy C-means clustering) algorithm is introduced to solve this problem, and its performance determines the correct rate of transformer fault diagnosis. This paper focuses on the defects of FCM algorithm and in view of diagnostic data characteristic of three-ratio method, the FCM algorithm is optimized in two ways. Firstly, the introduction of outlier factor detection algorithm weakens the adverse effects caused by outlier factors in the dataset during clustering process. Secondly, the penalty factor in the objective function of FCM algorithm is used to maximize the difference of cluster object and cluster center. The experiments are performed on multiple sets of samples of transformer fault diagnostic from IRIS standard data sets. The results verify that the improved FCM algorithm for transformer fault diagnosis has a higher correct rate than traditional methods.

articleTitle: An active re-configuration strategy for distribution network according to in-sufficient power supply capability of transmission network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To solve the problem of insufficient power supply capability of transmission network, a strategy for distribution network reconfiguration is proposed in this paper. This proposal is done through both distribution network reconfiguration and the feasibility analysis to achieve the minimum loss of load. Firstly, the sensitivity analysis of load distribution and power distribution is proposed in order to construct the evaluation index of the minimum loss of load, based on insufficient power supply capability of transmission network. Secondly, the network is re-configured for distribution network, followed by evaluation of minimum load loss. Because of the distribution network re-configuration and the evaluation of minimum load loss above mentioned, a reconfiguration optimization scheme for distribution network is established. To satisfy the multiple needs of minimum loss of load, minimum numbers of breaker operation, security and reliability operation of power system transmission and distribution, a practical and optimized re-configuration strategy for distribution network is achieved. Finally, a real case based on a regional Liaoning electric power system network is simulated and calculated to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this strategy.

articleTitle: An efficient pricing mechanism of the inter-area electricity market based on the special transforming period in China
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In China, electricity market reforming is just at the beginning of the second phase. Now, the competition market is mixed with the planned, the integrated and special experimentation coexist, the region market is combined with the Province market, those will result in complex energy price. It's not efficient in resource allocation and investment guiding. However, the inter-area electricity trading according to reasonable market pricing will make good in efficiency. In the transforming period, an operational pricing mechanism on the inter-area electricity market is provided to lead efficiency and full utilization of clean energy considering these complicated situation. Market Clearing and bidding will also be discussed.

articleTitle: Optimal distribution network reconfiguration for load balancing
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To cope with increasingly serious three-phase disequilibrium in distribution network, a reconfiguration model is proposed for distribution network with the optimization objective of reducing three-phase disequilibrium. First by analyzing the distribution network in topology, the distribution network reconfiguration problem is converted into a problem of constructing spanning tree of the graph, which is solved by breaking-cycle-basis method. Then by selecting the first-branch randomly and canceling the heuristic value of network, an improved ant colony optimization algorithm is proposed to solve the reconfiguration problem, which can expand the search extent and avoid search stagnation. Specific examples of verification prove that the proposed algorithm can obtain the global best solution with less computation time and higher probability compared to the conventional methods.

articleTitle: Study of power grid planning integrated information platform based on big-data technology
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional power network planning usually meets the poor basic data sources and lacks the necessary information tools. This paper develops the Power Grid Planning Integrated Information Platform based on the large data processing technology. The platform integrates mass basic data which from Grid GIS, Production PMS, Dispatch EMS and Intelligent Distribution Network Operation Monitoring Platform, and makes full use of advanced technology such as big data analysis and processing, multi-source information fusion analysis, multi-dimensional display of large data, etc. The platform develops six modules, including integrated information management, analysis of power grid diagnosis, power grid graph management, analysis of load forecast, planning and feasibility evaluation, economic and technical evaluation, etc, to realize the comprehensive arrangement of network planning data, the real-time diagnostic of grid, the accurate simulation of grid operation, and the centralized shared of planning achievements. The platform has been piloted in Shandong power grid, and significantly improves the efficiency of power grid planning and the informationization level of power grid.

articleTitle: Control strategy to mitigate secondary frequency dips for DFIG with virtual inertial control
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The rotor of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) is connected to the grid through converters and the active power can be regulated by controlling the converters. Thus DFIG can quickly response to frequency fluctuations with virtual inertial control, releasing kinetic energy stored in rotors. However, it must exit from frequency regulation mode when rotor speed decreases to the minimum allowable speed, limited by finite kinetic energy stored in rotor, and then its output power will drop rapidly, leading to a secondary frequency dip. This paper proposes a new method to alleviate the secondary dip where DFIG can exit smoothly so that sharp decrease in system frequency can be avoided. Compared to the traditional recovering strategy, sudden change in output power is avoided under this control, so the frequency changes smoothly at the cost of a comparatively wider recovering time scale. The influence of parameters is analyzed and methods of parameter determination are given accordingly. Simulation shows that the proposed strategy can efficiently reduce the secondary frequency dip.

articleTitle: The technology of interlocking logic visualization for smart substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The background of interlocking logic configuration difficulty reading and viewing in smart substation is introduced. The based on the G language scheme of interlocking logic visualization is proposed. Key technology is mainly researched, which includes interlocking logic text normalized description, loading rule files, complex logical expressions decomposition and analysis, generating interlocking logic tree, interlocking logic tree converted into topological connection relation, designing based on the G language interlocking logic file structure including device and graphic description information, the interlocking logic visualization expression implemented. Interlocking logic visualization could shield complex semantic relationships, improve the efficiency of viewing, reading, verify and debug testing interlock logic, and make non-professional people easily understand, which helps the stabilize operation of the substation.

articleTitle: Research on transmission line power losses effected by harmonics
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: By analysis of 66kV substation with a line of 10kV line loss increasing instance, the harmonic currents and the skin effect is the main reason of line loss increasing is described. By the metering principle of induction and electronic energy meter, there are no errors on the electronic energy meter, and certain impacts on the accuracy of the induction meter by harmonics.

articleTitle: Analysis of photovoltaic power generation system low voltage ride through control during asymmetric fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The electromagnetic transient model of photovoltaic power generation system is established based on PSCAD/EMTDC platform. The mechanism that 100Hz fluctuations appearing of PV output power and PV array operating point during asymmetric fault are simulated and theoretical analyzed. The paper proposes a positive and negative sequence separation control strategy, to filter the negative sequence current, making PV output current do not contain negative sequence component and outputting standard sinusoidal current waveform during asymmetric fault. The paper also proposes a DC voltage fluctuation suppression control strategy, to eliminate the DC voltage fluctuations and make the PV array operating point stable. Finally, simulation verification is made on PSCAD/EMTDC platform.

Author Keywords: positive and negative sequence separation control

articleTitle: A design and implementation of FPGA-based real-time simulator for distribution system with DG integration
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Real-time simulation of distribution system is challenging due to its' complex structure consisting of DGs. In this literature, a real-time simulator for distribution system with DG integration based on the field programmable gate array (FPGA) is realized for hardware emulation. The overall framework and asynchronous multi-rate interface method between DG with high nonlinearity and distribution system is proposed. The models of main components in distribution system are designed in FPGA. The hardware parallelism and highly pipeline design is utilized to guarantee real-time simulation, which has strong generality and flexibility. The simulator uses a floating point arithmetic calculation to achieve high accuracy. To validate the new simulator, a photovoltaic-battery hybrid generation system and a typical distribution system integrated with PV generation system are emulated in the hardware. The time-step of DG system and distribution system reach 1.096μs/1.696μs and 2μs/2μs respectively. The captured waveforms show excellent accuracy in comparison to the offline simulation in PSCAD/EMTDC. The time-step is less than RTDS which indicate a higher precision. The resource consumption of FPGA also show advantage compared with RTDS.

articleTitle: Analysis on asymmetric fault current of inverter interfaced distributed generator
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Fault characteristics of inverter interfaced distributed generator (IIGD) are determined by its grid-side converter. To deduce the fault current of IIDG is to analyze the current response under the action of grid voltage sags. To enhance the low voltage ride through (LVRT) ability of IIDG when asymmetric fault occurs, the dual current control strategy is widely used. In this paper, the positive and negative sequence current expressions were deduced based on the dual current control strategy and the influence factors were analyzed based on the expressions. When the amplitude of the fault current is higher than the maximum value of the converter can transfer, a new fault current calculation method was proposed. Theoretical analysis and simulation on PSCAD verified that the d-axis components of positive and negative sequence current meet second order response and the q-axis components are zero. The steady-state value of positive and negative sequence current is determined by the unbalance degree of grid and the transient process of fault current is determined by the control parameters of the grid-side converter. The conclusions are of great significance to relay protection of the grid with HDG.

articleTitle: Multi-objective decision-making model for distribution system condition-based maintenance
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective maintenance decision-making model based on Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory to determine the optimal maintenance scheme from the alternative schemes. This model selects the change of distribution system reliability after maintenance, load loss and maintenance cost as decision-making indexes. And decision-maker's preference of three indexes is also taken into consideration to meet the requirements of different maintenance circumstance.

articleTitle: Improved PV model and its application in reliability evaluation of microgrid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Accurate modeling for renewable energy generation system is a key factor to analyze the stability, security and reliability of grid-connected power system. Aiming at reliability analysis of the photovoltaic (PV) power generation system, based on detailed analysis of characteristics and deficiencies of existed PV output models, an improved model is proposed in this paper, with the operating condition constraints, namely irradiance, temperature and operating capacity, taken into consideration comprehensively. In order to further analyze its influence on microgrid reliability evaluation, the reliability evaluation process based on sequential Monte Carlo state sampling method is designed and conducted. Theoretical analysis and evaluation results show that the proposed model can make evaluation results more rigorous, and the variance of the actual output power can be decreased to accelerate the convergence rate compared with the existed models.

articleTitle: The application of UHF detection & positioning method into the process of partial discharge detection of switch cabinet
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Partial discharge detection technology of switch cabinet is widely applied nationwide. It is necessary to judge whether the switch cabinet is abnormal by detecting TEV and ultrasonic signals of switch cabinet at preliminary stage. It is necessary to redetect the abnormal signals with UHF detection technology to judge whether it is discharged, determine discharge type, realize positioning of partial discharge and determine the damage degree of equipment. Based on partial discharge detection case of 10kV switch cabinet of certain transformer substation, the application of UHF detection method into partial discharge detection process of switch cabinet is introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis on IIDG's negative-sequence current upon asymmetric fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As a large number of distributed generations (DG) are connected to the distribution network, the fault current of the distribution network has been changed, and the reliable operation of relay protection in the distribution network has been influenced. In the background whether the negative-sequence current protection can be used in the distribution network containing inverter interfaced DG (IIDG), this paper studies the mainstream method of controlling the fault characteristics of inverter based on negative-sequence component, analyzes and deduces a negative-sequence control structure, demonstrates the inhibitory effect of negative sequence control algorithm on the fault current, and has important reference value in proposing the protection principle for IIDG-containing distribution network. Finally, RTDS test simulates the asymmetric short-circuit fault conditions of the photovoltaic inverter, to verify the conclusions of this paper.

articleTitle: Research on 6L0WPAN wireless sensor network and IPv6 network interconnection in power distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper is for large data applications with electrical massive data collection, transmission and integration, researches for interconnection way between wireless sensor networks based on 6LowPAN and IPv6 networks in the power distribution network area. It presents the entire 6LoWPAN wireless sensor networks as a virtual IPv6 network access point ideas, gives specific method wireless sensor network through a root node to communicate with IPv6 wired networks, this makes wireless sensor network based on 6LoWPAN can directly access the IPv6 wired network, and realizes interconnection at any point between the two networks, it provides a strong guarantee for the big data application in power distribution system.

articleTitle: Research on improving power quality of wind power system based on the flywheel energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, impacts of the wind power random nature on the power quality, especially on voltage quality, increase gradually. Flywheel energy storage system (FESS) has the ability of independent regulating active power and reactive power. This paper designed the energy management system (EMS) model of FESS which can be used to improve the power quality of the grid. The model is based on the bi level decision model. The upper layer uses the fuzzy algorithm to solve the charging and discharging power of the FESS through assess the state of FESS and the amount of wind power fluctuations, the lower layer control the energy exchange between FESS and grid through by control the back-to-back converters based on dual-loop control. The voltage fluctuation of the PCC was compared using the FESS before and after in the MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment. The simulation results verify the validity of the model. The model can improve the utilization efficiency of FESS and the power quality of the system through the cooperation between the wind power and energy storage system.

articleTitle: Comparison of three stability analysis methods for delayed cyber-physical power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power system with wide-area damping controllers (WADC) embedded is essentially complex delayed cyber-physical power system (DCPPS) since time delays are introduced during transmitting and processing wide-area measurements. In this paper, three methods for stability analysis of DCPPS, i.e., delay-dependent stability criterion in the time domain, Padé approximation-based method as well as explicit infinitesimal generator discretization-based method (EIGD) in the frequency domain are extensively compared from both theoretical and numerical analysis in terms of conservativeness, accuracy, scalability and the capability of handling multiple delays. Simulation results reveals that: (1) The conservativeness in delay margin derived by delay-dependent stability criterion reaches to 7.09% for the two-area four-machine test system. (2) Padé approximation-based eigen-analysis method is sufficiently accurate even a low order of the approximation, e.g., 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> order, is used. (3) Padé approximation-based eigen-analysis method is more efficient than EIGD for small stability analysis of large DCPPS.

articleTitle: Research and simulation of V2G technology in micro grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the application of V2G technology in micro grid, the strategy of electric vehicle charging pile in micro grid is designed. When charging pile is discharged, the double closed loop control structure of voltage and current was applied by converter. The outside loop is voltage control and the inside loop is current control. Inverter is based on droop control and P/Q control which has the function of shifting peak and filling valley of active power.
