It can also be used as a dynamic reactive power compensation device to stabilize the voltage of the micro grid. When the charging pile is used for charging the electric vehicle, the inverter adopts the constant DC voltage reactive power control to stabilize the voltage of DC bus. At the same time Converter uses three kinds of control mode constants pressure, constant current and constant power, to meet the demand of electric vehicle charging. Finally simulation results verify the feasibility of the charging pile strategy.

articleTitle: A new method of congestion management based on power flow tracing
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Nowadays, with the competition and optimization of resource's allocation being introduced into the power market, the problem of transmission congestion also emerges. In power systems, lines and transformers transmiss energy which is a comprehensive reflection of the active power and reactive power, thus the causes of congestion should include the active and reactive power. The results of sensitivity analysis method may be inaccurate because only the effect of active power is considered. A new congestion management method which considers the linkage characteristic of active and reactive power is proposed in this paper. When there exists congestion, the analytical relationships between the line power and generator outputs can be obtained by power flow tracing. Then the power vectorgraph could be made and congesiton can be eliminated effectively by adjusting relevant power components in four quadrants. The correctness and effectiveness of the new method can be verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of voltage sag loss and treatment based on on-site data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper firstly discusses about the impacts of voltage sags on electricity users. Combined with economic survey methods of power quality in domestic and foreign countries and the actual situation of electricity users suffered of voltage sags, a calculation method of the losses due to voltage sags by questionnaires and face-to-face interviews is described. Then, cost-benefit analysis of voltage sag treatment is discussed by assessment of both costs and benefits. Economic analysis of voltage sag treatment case is also presented. Results show that voltage sags may cause huge losses to industrial users of continuous production process-types and benefits of voltage sag treatment are generally much more than their costs.

articleTitle: Research the effect of UHV GIS disconnector contact shape on the multi-restrike
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The multi-restrike during UHV GIS disconnector operation produces the very fast transient overvoltage (VFTO). In order to study the effect of contact shape on the multi-restrike process, this paper calculates the electric field of the disconnector gas cell based on the finite element method, and the contact gap breakdown voltage under different distance with different contact shape according to streamer breakdown criterion. Obtain the breakdown voltage characteristics between the contact gap using the least square method, building the multi-restrike simulation model of disconnector operation adopting ATP/EMTP software. Simulation results show that: under a certain operating speed, the breakdown voltage and the amplitude of high frequency transient oscillation pulse caused by breakdown are positively correlated; when operation phase angle in a power frequency cycle, the distribution of the maximum VFTO amplitude in the process of multi-restrike is approximately normal distribution. The value of contact fillet radius has certain influence on the VFTO amplitude.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of the protection system in smart substations
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at implementing the condition-based maintenance of protection systems in smart substation, a new assessment method of the operational level of protection systems is presented. Based on the characteristics of smart substations, a monitoring method reflecting the changes of the protection system function in terms of logical nodes was given first. According to the needs of the condition-based maintenance, reliability indices of the protection system were then selected. Along with these indices, a dynamic Markov reliability assessment model was built to quantitatively calculate the maintenance requirement under given conditions. Finally, a typical 220kV smart substation was utilized to illustrate the application method of the assessment model. The result shows that the method, with certain operability, could provide reference for maintenance decision-making of the protection system in smart substations.

articleTitle: Analysis on theoretical calculation of line losses for main network of Hubei power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the measured results of loads, the method of theoretical calculation is used to analysis the composition, distribution and influencing factors of line losses for main network of Hubei power grid on the representative day. Considering the current situation of large-scale wind power integration on power system recent years, the impacts of wind power integration on line losses of power grid are also analyzed in this paper with Suizhou area as an example.

Author Keywords: Main network of Hubei power grid

articleTitle: A novel fault self-recovery strategy for distribution network with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Nowadays, with the growing development and application of Distributed Generation (DG), the proportion of DG in Distribution Network (DN) becomes an increasingly large. Traditional power service restoration strategies for DN have no consideration for the introduced DG, as a result they cannot be directly used in the Distribution Network with Distributed Generation (DNDG). In this paper, a novel network partition and load transfer based Fault Self-Recovery (FSR) strategy for DNDG is proposed. It can come into effect after fault location and isolation through several processes as follows: Firstly, a genealogy based network description method is presented and used for DNDG's describing, and on the basis of which the definition of Node Power Margin Matrix (NPMM) is given. Secondly, a NPMM based DG's power supply path searching method is put forward and utilized to find out the DG's power supply area in DNDG, in which loads can be served by DG through islanding operation. Finally, a fast load transfer strategy for non-fault outage area is suggested and applied for the service restoration of the rest of the outage area, and the self-recovery of the faulted DNDG is achieved. In this paper, several cases with different fault scenarios are studied in a modified IEEE 37-bus DNDG model, the results validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed FSR strategy in DNDG.

articleTitle: A modified grid voltage feedforward method to improve the stability-robustness of the grid-connected voltage source converter under weak grid conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The grid voltage feedforward method is widely used in the control scheme of the grid-connected voltage source converter (GC-VSC) because it can improve the quality of the injected grid current as well as improving the dynamic performance of the system during grid voltage variation. However when the grid is weak, this feedforward method may amplify the high-frequency injected grid current harmonics or even result in instability of the system. To solve this problem, a low-pass filter which is incorporated in the grid voltage feedforward path is proposed in this paper. Therefore, the stability-robustness of the system is improved, meanwhile, the advantage of the grid voltage feedforward method is also remained. Finally, the simulation and real industrial application results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of this control method.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis method for microgrid with intermittent distributed generations
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper concerns on the reliability analysis method for microgrid with the intermittent distributed generations (DGs) and their power supply failure. Some types of DGs, such as photovoltaic and wind turbine, have the characteristic of intermittent and uncontrollable, which leads to unstable power output. It is worth to analyze and quantify the microgrid influence of DGs on the power supply reliability. In the paper, taking wind turbine as example, a multi-states power output model for intermittent DGs was provided with Markov chain. And then, a microgrid reliability analysis method, considering the influences of DGs intermittent and power supply failure, was proposed. The probability distribution of loads and power supplies are used, and a quantitative reliability indicator was given in the method, which could well reflect the microgrid reliability on various random factors. At last, an actual microgrid in Nanjing City was used to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Digital-analog simulation test of grid-connected performance for string inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power device switching frequency of string inverter is greater than 10kHz, the traditional real-time simulation platform based on CPU processor can not meet the needs of simulation. In this paper, based on FPGA and CPU processors, hybrid simulation model and test scheme of grid-connected performance for string inverter are proposed. First, using RT-LAB, hybrid simulation test platform for string inverter is set up, which contains digital simulation model, linear transformation unit and tested inverter controller. Then, based on the equivalent decoupling model of transformer, Seamless connection between the large step size simulation model of 20us and the small step size simulation model of 0.1us are realized. A primary power circuit models are established for the string inverter low voltage ride through (LVRT) test, frequency adaptation test and anti-islanding protection test. Finally, according to the national standard GB / T 19964-2012 “the photovoltaic power generation station access to electric power system technical regulations”, digital analog hybrid simulation test of low voltage ride through (LVRT), adaptive frequency and anti-islanding protection is carried out for string inverter controller, simulation test results can fully reflect the dynamic and static performance of the string inverter, which can effectively prove the correctness of the proposed test scheme.

articleTitle: A customer baseline load prediction and optimization method based on non-demand-response factors
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid growth of power demand, there are more and more concerns on demand response as it helps improve the power consumption efficiency and maintain the balance between electricity supply and consumption. Customer baseline load(CBL) forecasting is the basis of demand response implementing, and the selection of similar days and the method of calculating significantly affect the accuracy of CBL prediction. This paper proposes a baseline load forecasting and optimal method based on non-demand-response factors, considering the effects of non-demand-response factors on costumer load characteristics and CBL forecasting. The proposed method combines non-demand-response factors mining, similar days selecting and CBL calculating. A combined calculation model is adopted to predict the CBL. The case study reveals the greater accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of visualized multi-dimensional integrated management platform for switching substation (power distribution room)
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is difficult to monitor switching substation (power distribution room) due to the characteristics of large number and regional dispersion. This paper studied and designed to achieve an integrated multi-dimensional visual monitoring and management platform for monitoring the running state of the switching substation (power distribution room). The platform takes the running state of primary/secondary equipment, environmental temperature and humidity, the fire-fighting system, the security system and so on as the monitoring object, realizes the functions of remote real-time monitoring, equipment running state identification, abnormal alarming, event linkage by video analysis technology, which makes the switching substation monitoring more convenient and improves the Security and reliability of switching substation.

articleTitle: Research on maintenance schedule optimization of distribution network including distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: There are more load transfer schemes can be formed when some device is in maintenance with distributed generation. Considering the effect of distributed generation, within a maintenance time period of a month, a multi-objective minimum optimization framework on distribution network maintenance scheduling for total outage capacity, total switching times, as well as total network loss is developed on constraints of mutually exclusive and simultaneous maintenance. In addition, the NSGA-II algorithm with multi-period overall coding is applied to solve the model and the optimal maintenance scheme of a month is chosen based on priority order of objective function. The example results prove the validity of the multi-objective model and the NSGA-II algorithm in maintenance schedule of distribution network.

articleTitle: Simulation and stability analysis of spring operating mechanism with clearance for high voltage circuit breakers
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Spring Operating Mechanism (SOM) is a dynamic mechanical system to open and close high voltage circuit breaker in electric power controlling system. The dynamic characteristics of SOM are short operating time and high instantaneous speed in the process of working, which present strong nonlinear features. In order to save time and money for a new design and analysis of SOM, the dynamic model with clearance considering the contact and collision under ADAMS program is established. The result indicated that the existence of the clearance joints causes hysteresis and impact effects on velocity and acceleration of the mechanism compared to the mechanism without clearance.

articleTitle: Design of dual PWM inverter for harmonic minimization
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In photovoltaic power generation system, DC voltage variation leads to AC voltage distortion. This paper introduced a dual PWM inverter to reduce AC voltage harmonics when DC voltage was changing, which is based on D&T's inverter model. Dual PWM inverter is composed of two series three-phase PWM inverters. Its fundamental voltage characteristic is used to calculate modulations to maintain output voltage stably, and its harmonic voltage characteristic is used to calculate the operating point for harmonics minimization. Therefore, the two series inverters worked with different modulations, but its total output voltage is constant, and the harmonic distortion rate is at low level. Finally, the inverter's topological structure, characteristic analysis and control method is testified to be effective by simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Voltage sag improvement using DVR and SVG in power systems
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage sag is the most serious problem of power quality in industrial parks today, which brings heavy financial losses to voltage-sensitive loads. The problem couldn't be solved using one single custom power device, so the coordination of several custom power devices should be considered. This paper proposes a solution using two kinds of custom power devices, which are the Static Var Generator (SVG) and the Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR). The paper gives the mathematical models of DVR and SVG in detail respectively, and then presents the detecting methods used in the models of SVG and DVR. Based on the models and methods, a simulation about Suzhou industrial park is performed using MATLAB. Four scenarios of voltage sag events are considered in the simulation, and the result shows that using DVR and SVG to deal with voltage sag is suitable for voltage-sensitive loads in industrial parks.

articleTitle: Research on capacity value estimation for hybrid power generation system based on WT/PV/ESS considering operation strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The increasing integration of renewable energy generation (REG) makes the capacity value (CV) estimation for the REG become more important in the process of generation expansion planning. However, most researches on the CV ignore the hybrid generation system based on multiple complementary energy resources, as well as the operation strategy of energy storage system (ESS). To solve these problems, the models of available capacity of ESS are developed based on three different strategies. Then, using the sequential Monte-Carlo simulation method, the models and methods are developed for reliability assessment of generation system and capacity value estimation for the hybrid power generation system based on WT/PV/ES (HGS-WPE). By the application in IEEE-RTS79, the feasibility of models and estimation methods are verified. Finally the impacts of the complementation of HGS-WPE, the capacity and operation strategy of ESS on the reliability assessment and capacity value estimation are analyzed.

articleTitle: Novel method for partial discharge detection in gas insulated substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the insulation diagnosis of electrical imaterials in power apparatus, partial discharge (PD) measurement has been recognized as an important tool. In this paper, electrical and mechanical methods were combined for the detection of the PD defect. To analyze the fundamental frequency vibration, the induced current including eddy current and circulating current in GIS was analyzed firstly. Then, PD pulses and vibrations on enclosure were measured on a 252kV GIS PD test system. PD faults included protrusion and insulator flashover. The phase of the pulse current of the two kinds of PD defects was analyzed. Meanwhile, the frequency spectrum of vibration on the GIS equipment was analyzed. In order to diagnose the partial discharge fault better, the relationship between the pulse current signals with the vibration signal was established. A more reliable PD detection method was proposed by combining with the electrical signal and the vibration signal.

articleTitle: Shunt capacitor bank protection in UHV pilot project
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The configuration and setting of shunt capacitor bank protection is very important to ensure the safety of power system and power equipment. This paper introduces the shunt capacitor banks connection and shunt capacitor banks protection configuration of the UHV pilot project from Southeast Shanxi via Nanyang in Henan province to Jinmen in Hubei province. The application principle on the configuration and setting of this 110 kV shunt capacitor banks protection is studied and discussed in detail. The principle to ensure the safety of power equipment is chiefly taken into account in order to achieve a reasonable configuration and setting.

articleTitle: Electronic transformer real-time analysis technology
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the process of intelligent substation construction, electronic transformer has many defects in the beginning, and gradually entered a stage of stable operation. Currently, the primary means for operating personnel operation to found electronic transformer defects is their own warning or the alarm of protection equipment using this electronic transformer's data. For those who did not lead to consequences, fleeting anomalies, lack of necessary monitoring tools and instruments. In order to improve the monitoring of running status of the electronic transformer, this paper presents a strategy of real-time operational status analysis for electronic transformer substation based on SV data, to establish a hardware independent reliability evaluation model. Through long-term monitoring and analysis of reliability, stability and correctness of the electronic transformer's output data, to assess the reliability of electronic transformer. Through the application of electronic transformer monitoring method based on SV data, SV data exception diagnosis model is established, and the exception information statistics, records. Not only real-time monitoring the SV data status of each electronic transformer, has also established a plurality of electronic transformer monitoring model based on bus and main transformer unit to indirect verification data accuracy of the electronic transformer. This method not only can carry on the real-time alarm of exceptions, also can carry on the long-term track record and regular classification statistical analysis of exceptions, comparing the long-term trend analysis, early warning of possible risks. This method can effectively enhance the level of electronic transformer operation and maintenance security of power grid.

articleTitle: Steady-state control performance modeling and simulation analysis for grid-connected PV inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because photovoltaic (PV) power generation has characteristics of volatility and randomness, with large-scale PV power generation connected to the grid, it will effect the safe and stable operation of power gird. It is necessary to establish an accurate grid-connected PV inverter model to carry out a reliable load flow analysis calculations. Under the steady-state, grid-connected PV inverter control performance mainly includes the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control, active power set point control, active power reduction control with increases in grid frequency, reactive power control, protection control, etc. In the paper, using DIgSILENT/ Powerfactory software to establish a 500kW three-phase grid-connected PV inverter model. The PV inverter model can give expression to the steady-state control strategy, carried out simulation analysis according to different control modes. The paper verifies the accuracy of the PV inverter model, combined with laboratory type testing data.

articleTitle: Based on RFID and temperature tag smart inspection and maintenance technology for distribution power network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the electric energy demand and electric supply reliability increasing, the inspection and maintenance task exceed the ability of maintenance manpower by using the traditional operation and maintenance mode. The concept based on “mobility” and “standardization” is adopted to transform the traditional inspection and maintenance method. RFID technology, portable terminal device, wireless communication technology, GPS navigation technology, temperature measurement chip technology were adopted to construct intelligent inspection and maintenance system for distribution network. The application of the innovation technology promoted field inspection and maintenance to achieve the Informatization, standardization and intelligentization. The inspection and maintenance quality for distribution network equipment and channel was improved, which meet the need of condition based maintenance of distribution power network.

articleTitle: Research on dielectric characteristics of SF6/N2 gas mixtures based on FEM-FCT
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on dynamic characteristic of microscopic particles in discharge process, streamer discharge model is set up. Combining finite element method and flux corrected transport method, the paper simulate the streamer discharge process at SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> with mixing ratio of 50%:50%. On this basis, experimental platform for gas discharge is set up, and breakdown voltages of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixtures are measured. Influences of mixing ratio and pressure on SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> breakdown voltages is analyzed. The results show that electron number density in discharge gap is increasing with streamer moving forward, meanwhile electrons diffuse from high particle number density to low particle number density, and the peak value of electron number density reaches 3.0 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> at 5.5ns. Dielectric strength of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is higher than the value weighted according to partial pressure ratio, presenting synergistic effect. The synergistic effect is obvious when a small amount of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> is contained in gas mixtures.

articleTitle: Provincial electricity market orderly operating evaluation model adapting to the new round of electricity reform requirements
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Provincial electricity market is the constituent unit to protect the basic electricity market economy and social development. On the basis of analyzing the characteristics of the provincial electricity market, this paper constructs orderly operation evaluation system of the provincial electricity market, assessing the market supply and demand, market structure, market behavior, market efficiency and other aspects and analyzing the relevant key indicators. Combined with the requires of the new round of electricity power system reform, early reform facing the key issues of preventing market forces, this paper mainly analyzes the direct measures to prevent market forces and the indirect measures to resolve transmission congestion and market challenges in respond to tight supply and demand. The Model constructed in this paper provides strong support to promote the orderly development of the new round of electricity reform.

Author Keywords: The new round of electricity reform
orderly operation of the evaluation model

articleTitle: Research on energy storage converter with VSG seamless switching technology in AC/DC hybrid microgrid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the research of the virtual synchronous generator technology in AC/DC hybrid microgrid, this paper proposes a seamless switching technology between AC/DC hybrid microgrid and distribution network quickly. It solved the problem that there was no voltage support within 10 ms in the process of switching with grid-connect and islanded mode, between microgrid and the distribution network. Although 10 minutes was not long, but it can aggravate the microgrid sensitivity loads. Additionally, AC/DC hybrid microgrid grid-connected and islanded implementation principle by SVG is researched, experiment equipment development with such technology has been developed and test waveforms was proposed and analyzed. The technology in this paper proposed has been applied in energy storage converter with VSG, Experiment concluded that this method has good control effect; it provides a good technical foundation support for the rapid development of Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid.

articleTitle: Gauss-Newton hybrid power flow algorithm for AC-DC distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper a hybrid power flow algorithm is proposed for multi-terminal AC-DC distribution system. Droop control is regularly used for multi-terminal system to coordinate the power output of each source, causing that the voltage of the slack bus is also needed to be calculated for power flow with an iteration-based method. So In this paper Newton method is adopted for DC distribution system, and Gaussian algorithm is used for AC distribution system, taking both advantages of less computational complexity and good convergence. Considering that the convergence of Newton method is sensitive to initial value, an initial value calculation method based on constant voltage control is proposed, to ensure the convergence of the algorithm when the initial value ranges with the droop control curve. Finally, the results are tested with a modified IEEE123 case, verifying the validity and correctness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Mid-long term load forecasting of the unstable growth sequence based on Markov chains screening combination forecasting models
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the process of mid-long term load forecasting, it is important to choose right models according to the trend of the historical data. This paper chose the continuous 11 years electricity data of a certain district in Lianyungang to make up the historical data. Five forecasting models were always used in load forecasting field to forecast the electric quantity of the twelfth year. The data, which had been chosen in this paper, had the feature-the medium-term data showed fluctuation and the overall rising tendency was unstable. In order to check the forecasting results whether meet accuracy requirement, the concept of the grey relational degree was introduced. In terms of problems that even the forecast models meet the requirements of the grey relational degree, the forecast results still have great differences. According to the feature that the growth rate of load data is non-after effect property of Markov chains, by analyzing the growth rate of load data, using Markov chain to divide the growth rate to three state intervals, and getting the Markov state-transition matrix. According to the growth rate between the tenth and the eleventh data, combining with the Markov state-transition matrix, judging the rising tendency of the growth rate between the eleventh and the twelfth data. According to the rising tendency, screening two kinds from the models which had met the accuracy requirement, the method of variance-covariance was used to assign weights. Calculating results show that more targeted models could be chosen and combined. By this method of screening, not only can be appropriate for the rising tendency unstable data, but have a high precision.

articleTitle: The influence of green development idea on power supply reliability and power quality of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The idea of Green Development is one of the Five development concepts which are purposed by the Central Committee of the China Communist Party on 18 Fifth Plenary Session. It is based on the new concept of economic sustainable development, the important instruction significance to China's economic and social development of all aspects. At present, The increasing China's energy resource constraints, ecological environment problems gradually emerge, and the pressure of energy structural adjustment, energy efficiency improvement, energy security further increase, traditional energy development based on fossil energy is difficult to continue, Green and low-carbon development Road must be taken. Distribution network is an important part and the terminal step to provide premium power services for the users. It undertakes the important functions and social responsibility to adopt hydro, solar, wind and other clean energy, and then deliver power safely and efficiently to the terminal users. It plays a crucial role in practicing the Green development concept, building clean, efficient and sustainable modern energy system. In this paper, the current development status and existing problems of the distribution network in China are reviewed, the influence of Green Development idea on the power supply reliability and power quality is analyzed. A series of methods and measures such as the enhancement of distribution network development quality, the acceleration of the transformation and upgrading of power distribution network are raised. In addition, the expectation of the future of China's distribution network research and development trend is presented, along with several suggestions to improve the power supply reliability and power quality ability of distribution network.

articleTitle: The maximum entropy probability distribution and the improvement of its solving method for negative sequence current of a traction substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, improved solving method are proposed to calculate the maximum entropy probability distribution of negative sequence current. Negative sequence current is got from the process of the measured data obtained from power quality monitoring system first. Second, curve fitting method is used to calculate probability distribution of negative sequence current based on maximum entropy method. Logarithmic function and the method of deleting small probability value points at ends of probability distribution are proposed to improve the parameters solution method of curve fitting. The probability distribution obtained from the improved solving method is more consistent with the actual distribution of measured data compared with the original parameter solution method. Finally, fitting error parameters are used to evaluate the fitting effect of probability distribution and prove the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: State estimation for active distribution networks basedon multisource hybrid measurements
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the fact of long-term coexistence of the remote terminal unit(RTU), the phasor measurement unit(PMU) and the advanced metering infrastructure(AMI) in active distribution networks, In this paper, a hybrid algorithm of state estimation based on hybrid measurements of RTU, PMU and AMI is presented, which consists of nonlinear static state estimation, linear static state estimation and linear dynamic state estimation. Linear dynamic state estimation and linear static state estimator tracks the changes of node injection active and reactive power utilizing PMU and RTU measurements, which can provides highly accurate virtual measurements for nonlinear static state estimation in the absence of AMI measurements. The proposed algorithm can shorten the calculation cycle and improve the accuracy of nonlinear static state estimation, and promotes the ability of state forecasting for active distribution networks. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is illustrated with numerical simulation using the IEEE 13-bus system.

articleTitle: Study on the typical mode of EV charging and battery swap infrastructure interconnecting to power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the development of electric vehicles (EV), this paper analyzes the influence of EV charging on Distribution network, and designs the typical mode of connection of EV charging and battery swap infrastructure. The typical mode considers several factors, such as the voltage level, the significant of user, point of common coupling, power supply, electrical equipment selection and the quality of electric energy and so on. The achievement could provide the guide to the planning of the EV charging and battery swap infrastructure interconnecting to the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent load transfer strategy based on distribution automation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution Automation is one of the most important parts of the construction of Smart Grid. And the related standards are important for Smart Grid standard system. Modern power distribution network, which has three features including network grid, multi-connecting power supply and distribution automation, will strengthen the network connection. It improves the power supply service that less time is needed to recover when breakdown happens. Radar reflection principle is used for the strategy of load-transfer among main stations of Distribution automation in Pudong area, which consists of load shedding plan, checking method of topological power flow and searching the path of power supply. Therefore, it is possible to recover from complex breakdown nearby and separately, which ensures the distribution automation system work more steadily and reliably.

articleTitle: Study and analysis of magnetic flux controlling continuously adjustable reactor
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a Magnetic Flux Controlling Continuously Adjustable Reactor (MFC-CAR). It provides a magnetic circuit and device whose reluctance could be controlled by provision of a rotatable iron core. The key difference between MFC-CAR and conventional single-phase reactor is that a rotatable iron core with air gap is inserted in the upper yoke. The equivalent magnetic resistance could be regulated by adjusting the angle of the rotatable iron core, so reactance adjustment in a wide range can be obtained. Moreover, The driving system consisting of stepping motor, over-running clutch and reducer, brings great improvement on anti-electromagnetic torque, in order to hold the iron core in a designed position. The three-dimension finite element model of MFC-CAR is established and studied in the MAXWELL software, and a prototype of 13kVA/400V adjustable reactor has also been manufactured to study the magnetic characteristics of the MFC-CAR. The actual measurement values match well with the theoretical calculations, as well as the simulation results, and the inductance could be continuously varied within 44% ~ 100%, which indicates a promising prospect for industrial application.

articleTitle: A residential load identification algorithm based on periodogram for non-intrusive load monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring is an important development direction of electric load monitoring. Traditional NILM mainly track and decompose the power voltage current, and other transient or steady-state parameters like power parameters at the monitoring system entrance, and then identify the specific type of load. The load identification method is complicated, and there are limitations on identifying multiple devices switching simultaneously. This paper studied on NILM oriented residential load identification methods and proposed one based on periodogram, and then made the detailed theoretical analysis and simulation verification of the selection and determination of electric appliances characteristic model. This method could greatly simplify the system complexity and improve the efficiency of identification. It offers important reference value for the research on load online monitoring methods in residential domain.

articleTitle: A stochastic generation scheduling model for large-scale wind power penetration considering demand-side response and energy storage
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The presence of high levels of wind power production brings technical and economic challenges to system operators. To better accommodate wind power, this paper proposes a coordinated scheduling optimization model considering demand-side response (DR) and energy storage (ES), incorporating conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) assessment. In this paper we use CVaR as the risk measure to evaluate the risk of loss of load and wind curtailment and indicate decision attitudes. Price-based DR program and ES are incorporated into generation scheduling and uncertainty from wind power prediction and DR is considered. The proposed model is tested in a 5-bus system. The results show that scheduling costs are different with different security risk weight and the coordination of DR and ES efficiently increases the level of wind power integration.

articleTitle: The method of complex power increment based on Cauchy Riemann condition
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The calculation of traditional electrical distance is based on the method of sensitivity. It transform the Jacobi matrix to the voltage/reactive power sensitivity and cluster the nodes represent the electrical distance that comes from sensitivity matrix elements. But this method is short of theoretical proof and a unified calculation method in mathematics. Different from the method of sensitivity, this paper propose a new method of complex power increment to describe electrical distance under the fact that active and reactive power are coupled and prove this method is analytic by deriving formula and analysis the numerical example.

articleTitle: Nonlinear regression analysis of failure probability of power grid equipment based on its condition
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In allusion to the deviation with the EA empirical formula on analyzing interrelationship of the power grid equipment condition and its fault probability, this paper uses history statistics data of power grid equipment conditions and their fault probabilities and puts forward the correction method for EA empirical formula based on the nonlinear regression analysis theory. Through tracking and collecting condition evaluation results and fault data of 110kV power cables in Shenzhen power grids from the year 2010 to 2011, the SPSS statistics analysis method is adopted to estimate the sample parameters and fit the relationship curve for the operation conditions of power grid equipment and their fault probability. The correlation coefficient of nonlinear regression is used to verify the correction function.

articleTitle: Study of configuration and simulation test on 220kV reserve power source automatic connection in 500kV substation of Shanghai power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the particularity of city status of Shanghai, the requirement of its power supply reliability has been increased. As important automatic safety device, application of reserve power source automatic connection on higher voltage will increase reliability of power supply in a larger scale. According to primary connection and protection configuration of Shanghai power grid, study has been made on main logic points of 220kV reserve power source automatic connection in 500kV substation, the influence of switching procedure on both primary and secondary devices is simulated, RTDS dynamic simulation is also made on logic functions of 220kV reserve power source automatic connection according to real parameters of 500kV Jing'an substation. 220kV reserve power source automatic connection has been successfully put into operation in Jing'an substation.

articleTitle: A data synchronization method in smart substations based on characteristics of sampled values
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Smart substation is the key parts of smart grid. The schemes of sampled value transmission in the process layers and the data synchronization methods are related to both the reliability of data acquisition and the security operation of smart grid. The common schemes of sampled value transmission are concluded. The common data synchronization methods are expounded and the problems of different methods are analyzed. A new data synchronization method which depends on the characteristics of sampled values is proposed. Compared with existing methods, the new method solves the major problems that the transmission delay in the networking transmission scheme is variable and the measurement of it is hard to achieve. The new synchronization method can keep data synchronization even when the synchronization clock signal is lost, raising reliability of data synchronization and providing an effective method for application of networking scheme in smart substation in the future.

articleTitle: Ensuring safe operation of liaoning power grid based on big data statistical analysis theory
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Statistically, power grid accidents are inevitable. The larger the scale of a power grid, the more probably a power grid accident will occur. Preventing a power grid accident as soon as possible from occurring and handling the accident in a most efficient and quick way are two important topics to power grid dispatchers. This paper analyses in detail the causes of grid accidents such as tripping of above 220 kV lines of Liaoning Power Grid using big data statistics method, and finds some objective laws, which would help Liaoning Power Grid and other power grids in safe operation and scientific management.

articleTitle: Study on the optimization method of energy storage configuration for new energy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: New energy and renewable energy is the important source of the 21th century. However, wind and solar generation have adverse effects on power systems safety and stability, power quality, reliability, plannings of sources and power systems due to the variability and fluctuation. In this paper, we propose an optimization method of energy storage configuration for new energy. The method considers the energy storage battery power and capacity constraints, with the storage to the charging rate, charge-discharge times as the objective function, using point-by-point calculation method to calculate corresponding abandoned electric quantity, charge-discharge times of the energy storage. Finally the power and capacity optimal value of energy storage is obtained. The method has higher practical value for the design of energy storage configuration for new energy in engineering.

articleTitle: Comprehensive prediction of China's power demand based on induced ordered weighted geometric averaging (IOWGA) operator and optimal judgment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A comprehensive prediction model based on induced ordered weighted geometric averaging (IOWGA) operator and optimal judgment is proposed for China's power demand prediction. This method provided here combines the characteristics and advantages of trend extrapolation methods elastic coefficient method and regression analysis method by introducing IOWGA operators, which overcomes the deficiencies of traditional prediction model of power demand in terms of assigning weights. Optimal judgment model is introduced to calculate and determine the weights by setting the highest prediction accuracy as target value, which shows excellent prediction effect. This paper predicted China's power demand during the “13th Five-Year” period using the comprehensive prediction model mentioned above and achieved the expected results.

articleTitle: Coordinated and optimized voltage control in active distribution based on two-stage programming algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A coordinated and optimized voltage control method using two-stage programming algorithm is proposed in this paper. Based on the forecasts of loads and the maximum power output predictions of the distributed generators (DGs) day-ahead, it realizes the coordinated control among the active and reactive power of DGs, on-load tap changer (OLTC) and the shunt capacitors (SCs). With the voltage level for each node in qualified condition, this method takes reducing network loss, reducing regulation times of equipment and promoting power utilization ratio of DGs as target. Firstly, the differential evolution algorithm is used to obtain the feasible state when the statuses of the OLTC and the SCs are determined by the second stage. Then the DG optimal output from the first stage is fed back to the second stage, and the optimal values of the objective function are calculated by the dynamic programming algorithm while the voltage control plan for day-ahead is obtained. On this basis, the method is realized by MATLAB, and the case study verifies the validity and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization analysis of influencing factors on wind power integration based on continuous ant colony support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of wind power integration, using the continuous ant colony support vector machine theory based on the analysis of peaking need, we put forward the method of optimization analysis of influencing factors on wind power integration. According to the influence of parameter selection to optimization effect, we discuss the continuous ant colony support vector machine model and case study Wind Power Integration of Jilin Province. The result proves support vector function based on MG-CACO Algorithm improves the accuracy of the model, and it is very practical and effective in Wind Power Integration.

articleTitle: Study on distance protection based on wide area information
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to avoid the impact of the power system oscillation, distance protections are equipped with swing blocking element. If fault processing program procedures can not work out within 150ms, the distance protection will be blocked, which reduces the performance of the distance protection. With the development of communication technology and digital substation technology, the protection based on wide area information becomes a possible. This paper proposes a kind of wide area back-up protection system independent of traditional distance protection in high voltage grid, it uses the system parameters on the other end of the wide area information to improve the sensitivity of distance element, and uses wide area information to identify the circuit of the swing center and input swing open criterion only on the circuit. On this basis, a resetting scheme of back-up protection system action time, which is based on longitudinal protection discriminant result and takes the fault circuit as the center is put forward, the difficulty of rapid fault removal in the minimum range under the condition of the breaker refusal is solved. The backup protection system takes full advantage of the wide area information, and has advantages in areas of the sensitivity enhancement of distance components, improvement of traditional swing blocking strategy, and backup protection action speed. The distance protection coordinates with the existing power grid distance protection, the configuration and setting of the existing distance protection needn't change, the aim is to improve the performance of the back-up protection.

articleTitle: Planning method for distribution networks based on load growth characteristics of the industry
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the influence of the time sequence of urban distribution network construction by the difference of the growth trend of different industry load in urban distribution network, a planning method based on the industry load characteristics and the total supply capacity of distribution network is established. By studying the load growth characteristic of different industries, the model of industry load growth is established which is to analyze the load growth of the area in the next few years; Through the calculation of the total supply capacity of the existing distribution network, the total supply capacity can be extended is evaluated which determines whether a new substation need to be constructed or not. Through the analysis and comparison of the regional load growth over the next few years and the total supply capacity can be extended, the distribution network's construction scheme by stages can be made. Finally, a case demonstrates the effectiveness and economy of the method.

articleTitle: A novel method for frequency observation applied to droop control on grid-connected inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Droop control is an important control scheme applied to inverter interfaced distributed generators accessing to distribution network. As to the phase locking and frequency measurement issues involved in control process, this paper proposed a novel method based on phase sequence separation and least square method (LSM). To get the values in two phase static frame, use Clarke transformation to the three-phase voltage in the first step; then differential operations had been done to establish linear equations to extract the positive-sequence component, as negative-sequence component and 2nd harmonic would be eliminated by solving these equations; since other higher harmonics would be suppressed by using low-pass filter in rotating reference frame, the real-time phase angle can be obtained. Then frequency can be acquired through the improved LSM, which achieves decoupling through time displacement, and thus reduces the computation load. Besides, phase error caused by filter can also be compensated by the improved LSM. Experimental results testified that grids' phase and frequency can be observed accurately and steadily even in distorted condition, and that droop control based on the proposed method can apply to grid-connected inverter.

articleTitle: Prediction of 10kV distribution feeder monthly outage rate based on decision tree
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to predict the 10kV distribution feeder monthly outage rate. Based on investigation of existing IT systems in distribution companies, influential factors of 10kV distribution feeder outage are first selected according to availability. Correlation analysis is performed to determine the outage critical influential factors. A Decision tree with C4.5algorithm is constructed to predict feeder's monthly outage rate. Case studies on 131 10kV distribution feeders indicate that the proposed approach can reach 90% accuracy level, which can be used to assist in developing inspection and maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: Simulation research on decomposition-based intelligent optimization algorithm in power system reactive power optimization
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reactive power optimization falls into the category of multi-objective optimization. The simulation model of multi-objective reactive power optimization is built on the basis of the conventional reactive power optimization model in this paper, wherein the objective function is consisted of minimum active power losses and minimum reactive power compensation cost. The multi-objective reactive power optimization model is built via following MOEAD algorithm. The simulation results prove that the multi-objective reactive power optimization based on MOEAD could reduce the system active power loss and reactive power compensation cost in fast and effective fashion.

articleTitle: The on-site testing technology of PV power station power generation performance evaluation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In view of the rapidly development of PV power generation at present in our country, the power grid security and stability factors are more considered by the research institutions and Power Grid Corporations which are brought by large-scale grid-connected PV power generation, while the economical and failure efficiency are ignored which caused by the PV power station power generation performance. In this paper an on-site testing technology of the project construction quality for PV power generation is proposed. Moreover, the generality and high efficiency of this testing technology are verified based on the detection for a PV power station.

articleTitle: The application study of loop-encoding scheme based RTS in distribution network reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reasonable choice of encoding scheme can avoid or reduce infeasible solutions, so as to improve the efficiency of solving distribution network reconfiguration problem. The switch-based and loop-based encoding methods are compared in this paper. The efficiency of loop-based encoding program is much higher than the former one. The reactive tabu search(RTS)is introduced to reduce active power losses by reconfiguration. The simulation results on the 69 nodes system show that, the proposed method is able to obtain the optimal solution with less computation. Compared with other algorithms, it has better optimization speed and convergence.

articleTitle: Topology optimization of magnetic energy converter in high-voltage substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the application problems of wireless sensors in power substation, the wraparound topology of magnetic energy converter is proposed. In high-voltage substations, there is a fairly wide range of the spectrum in the magnetic field components. If magnetic energy converter with better collection efficiency is used as auxiliary power source, it will be able to significantly improve the self-powered strength. Thereby wraparound mathematical models of different magnetic energy converter topologies are established and the mutual inductance factors (M) to characterize the collecting ability of magnetic energy are defined. With regard to magnetic skeleton material, skeletal structure parameters and the number of coils in different magnetic energy converter topologies, the optimization of mutual inductance factor is analyzed in detail. As a result, the wraparound magnetic energy converter design principles are obtained and the overall performance of magnetic energy converter is validated by simulation verification.

articleTitle: Analysis on lightning impulse test and breakdown reasons of offshore substation GIS
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the background of Rudong 150MW offshore wind farm demonstration project, this paper expounds the principle of lightning impulse test and breakdown phenomenon of the offshore GIS equipment, the reason of breakdown is analyzed and the relevant preventive measures and suggestions are given. First of all, the principle of lightning impulse test is described, and then the test platform is built, the results show that both two different voltage degree GIS which are tested are breakdown in different parts. Through the inspection of the discharge points of the two GIS, it is found that the breakdowns in this test are reducible metal gap breakdowns, combined with experimental results and test environment, it is deduced that the breakdowns are due to the metal debris which are introduced in the transport and installation processes of GIS. At last, some relevant suggestions are given to prevent the breakdown and improve the test.

articleTitle: Status and suggestion on AGC ancillary service of Yunnan power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For a more equitable and effective management of AGC ancillary service, the Southern Electric Power Supervision Committee promulgated two detailed regulations on the management of ancillary services and parallel running in 2009. Based on the actual data of “Southern Power Grid `1 +5' ancillary services assessment system”, this paper analyzes the Yunnan AGC auxiliary service from multiple perspectives. Based on the power supply characteristics of Yunnan grid, several improvement recommendations on AGC ancillary services are put forward. The recommendations have important roles in the improvement of regulation efficiency, the reasonable utilization of AGC capacity and the improvement of the AGC operating environment.

articleTitle: Research on data query technology of hierarchical storage for electric power dispatching system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a unified dispatching management data query architecture of hierarchical storage in smart grid. With the concept of cloud computing, we take into account the integration IT infrastructure resources, to achieve the effective organization of different data resources. By dispatching data network located in the control center, we provide efficient data sharing, interactive, retrieval of various services for dispatching management business applications. In order to achieve with data-sharing target, we focuses on the analysis of integrated cloud data query architecture for the hierarchical storage management. The architecture can provide a theoretical basis for the overall design and application of the data query prototype system of dispatching management.

articleTitle: IEC61968 information exchange bus based loose-couple integrated application for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the development of smart grid, the growing member of different systems and massive exchange data on distribution network put forward a higher requirement on information integration. Though some systems imported IEC61968 interface and based on Information Exchange Bus (IEB) preliminary achieved information integration between systems, the information none-synchronize between systems still exists. This paper based on the IEC61968 IEB proposed a loose-coupled integration approach for distribution applications, then constructed an integration of distribution advanced applications. The integrated application providing services for the system on IEB with SOA architecture, which can guarantee the unique data source and achieve information integration between applications, loose-coupled structure can also improve the scalability and flexibility of entire system. The feasibility of integrated application has also been verified through case test.

articleTitle: The feasibility scheme design of power dispatching & distribution data integrated network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to solve the information interaction problem between power dispatching data network and distribution data network, this paper analyzed the composition and characteristics of these two network respectively, presented a feasible scheme of data integrated network by comparison of the similarities and differences of two networks and described the principles and network infrastructure in detail. A simulation test about connectivity and supportability is used to verify the feasibility, safety and reliability of the scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of distribution lines lightning accidents caused by microwave tower
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Through the analysis of the microwave tower stuck by lightning, as well as a microwave tower can trigger distribution lines occur lightning accidents, and explaining the consequences of the distribution lines and precautions. From two accidents, discussing the reasons for producing direct lightning stroke and lightning, at the same time demonstrate the over voltage of two kinds of lightning damage the magnitude and the power distribution network, and finally discussing the effective measures to prevent such accidents.

articleTitle: Dynamic charging control strategy of EV considering accessing of renewable energy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electric Vehicle (EV) is an important part of the world's energy technology revolution and the country's renewable energy strategy. Large-scale EV charging will bring impact and challenges for the operation of power system, interaction of charging and discharging of EVs, accessing of renewable energy, security and economic of power system operation, is an important problem in development of EV and renewable energy. Stabilizing power system fluctuations caused by accessing of renewable energy and EV charging, improving absorptive capacity of power system, are serious problems. The thesis analyze the effect of large-scale random charging on power system, than the modeling of EV charging considering accessing of renewable energy is established. The dynamic charging control strategy with multi-objective is proposed. The strategy sets the optimization of regional power peak-valley difference and Stabilizing power fluctuations as the control objectives.

articleTitle: Analysis of overvoltage caused by intermittent earth fault and its suppression method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Intermittent earth faults occur frequently in urban distribution networks, causing overvoltage in the whole system. This paper first presents the distribution characteristics of transient overvoltage caused by intermittent earth faults. Overvoltage level at the end of a sound line turns to be higher than that of the faulted line. In resonant grounding system with Petersen coil based on thyristor controlled reactor (TCR), overvoltage appears to be more severe due to response delay of compensation. Therefore, the influence on overvoltage level of Petersen coil compensation is analyzed, based on which, an overvoltage suppression method is proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis and Experiment of Influencing Factors of Power Branch Parameters for Intelligent Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the changes of meteorological environment and power operation, power branch parameter will produce fluctuation. In this paper, the influencing factors of branch parameters are introduced from temperature, ampacity, seasonal variation. Dynamic characteristic of resistance and operational characteristics of reactance is studied. Fully considering the trait of probability, the test case of impedance is designed based on the platform of experimental verification in CEPRI. The results shows that reactance is the fundamental factor in state estimation indicator.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of environmental impact on power transmission and transformation equipment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of transmission and transformation equipment evaluation indicator that affected by environment, indicator system was chosen properly, and the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model was built, which was used on the environmental impact assessment of transmission and transformation equipment for some regions in Chongqing. Results of the given example indicated the feasibility of the model and provided scientific evidence for condition-based maintenance of transmission and transformation equipment.

articleTitle: Distribution network expansion planning considering comprehensive equipment utilization
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An equipment comprehensive utilization index considering power system security and operating mode was provided, and a distribution system expansion planning method based on this index was proposed. The expansion planning method takes “effective use of existing and additional equipment resources” as the guiding ideology, and makes full use of the historical operation data to realize the distribution system expansion planning. The planning model and the solving process using improved particle swarm algorithm are provided in the paper. An actual case study is used to verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Weak part identification in power grid based on self-organized criticality
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to further study the self-organized criticality when large-area blackouts happened in power system, a model that is used to simulate power system blackout process in all the components power flow limit relative fixed time is proposed. This model researches holistic dynamics when power system is in SOC state and research on the relationship between loading rate distribution and self-organized criticality. According to the simulation results, establishing integrated index to find the grid weak parts from the macroscopic characteristics of electric power system. Taking IEEE39 system as the research object, the paper removes weak lines in turn to calculate average efficiency after obtaining the order of weak lines, and then analyze the effectiveness of the proposed integrated index according to the change of average efficiency. The results show that the integrated index has a better recognition on weak parts. Finally, applying this method to identify weak parts in Gansu power grid. On this basis, the operation and dispatching personnel of the power grid can monitor well and put forward the corresponding defensive measures to improve the reliability of the power system.

articleTitle: A software quality evaluation method for power dispatching automation system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power dispatching automation system is widely used in power grid, a hazard or problem of power system will affect the security of power grid operation in a wide range. Software quality model of power dispatching automation system is built, and index system is proposed to evaluate software quality in this paper. Testing methods for indicators and comprehensive evaluation method are put forward, and then a comprehensive quality index is given, which improve the efficiency and accuracy of software evaluation. It provides a strong support for stable operation of power dispatching automation system and safe operation of power grid. Quality evaluation of state estimation, which is typical software of power dispatching automation system, shows evaluation method is feasible, and has a good value.

articleTitle: Implementation of Automatic Demand Management System (ADMS)
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The Distribution Companies are required to restrict drawl of power from the grid to comply with the specified frequency requirements so as to overcome any threat to system security in an interconnected system on account of overdrawal from the grid. The Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) of India mandates manual as well as automatic demand disconnection from the distribution network under overdrawal conditions and on crossing the defined frequency limits. As the manual control at times become ineffective to decrease drawal by a certain quantum within the time limit and hence the automatic demand disconnection scheme assumes significant importance for Distribution Companies operating in developing countries like India to restrict drawl in its control area. The Automatic Under frequency Load Shed (AUFLS) and load relief by rate of change of frequency relay are the defence mechanism whereas Automatic Demand Management System (ADMS) acts as a tool for ensuring security and reliability of the interconnected system. This paper aims to present details of a unique state-of-the-art Automatic Demand Management System (ADMS) implemented for the State Distribution System by the Transmission Utility of the State of Madhya Pradesh in India, which not only disconnects the interruptible loads but also restores the same automatically on clearing the overdrawal conditions. Under this system real time information is gathered through the transmission Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System and based on logics developed for the scheme, automatic load disconnection & restoration is achieved through the control output of Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) installed for SCADA System of State Transmission network.

articleTitle: Research on a line protection method for DC distribution system based on parameter identification
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A DC distribution line protection method based on parameter identification is proposed. The parameter equation in the conditions of monopolar grounding fault and pole-to-pole fault is deduced by analyzing DC distribution line faults, the protection scheme for DC distribution line is researched based on the principle of parameter identification. The protection scheme utilizes the voltage and current information at protection installation position, fault distance and transition resistance are calculated by method of the least square. The distinction of fault section and determination of fault position are achieved by comparing fault distance with corresponding line length. The model of DC distribution system is built on the real time simulation platform RT-LAB. Numerous tests are carried out on different transition resistances and fault positions, different line types of DC distribution line fault. Simulation results show that the line protection scheme for DC distribution system based on parameter identification is effective.

articleTitle: Construction of high-reliability distribution network of urban demonstration in Chongqing
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power supply reliability means the power system's ability of sustainable power supply, which is a main index in evaluating the quality of power supply system. In order to improve the reliability of urban distribution network and quality of service, Chongqing Power Corporation made urban core area of 31.5 square kilometers as demonstration area on power supply high-reliability, with the acceptance of the State Grid Corporation in 2014. The average interruption duration is reduced lower than five minutes, which reached the international advanced level. The construction of this demonstration area mainly include reliability evaluation on distribution grid, reliability planning on grid structure, cable non-blackout work, reconstruction on distribution grid, risk analysis on distribution grid operation, production and command platform construction, condition based maintenance technology, construction of standard operation and management system on regional distribution with high reliability, etc. Remote loop closing operation is achieved by data interaction between distribution automation system and the loop closing operation device. Through the information exchange bus, distribution automation system, production management system (PMS), 95598 system, geographic information system (GIS), reliability risk assessment system, online-monitoring system and condition-based maintenance system are integrated together. By using PMS mobile operating platform to process work orders, the efficiency of rushing repair is improved significantly. With the widely application of infrared radiation thermometer and Oscillation Wave Test System (OWTS), not only Condition-based maintenance of distribution network equipment is carried out, but the process of distribution grid maintenance and recovery can be monitored. After the construction of high reliability demonstration area, the average shut down time decreased from 33 min. to 4.557 min., the reliability index (RS-3) increased from 99.96% to 99.9915%, and service quality on power supply and customers' satisfaction also increased significantly, and consequently good society and commercial benefit were made.

articleTitle: A transient voltage security control strategy for the wind power centralized system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is significant to research the voltage security of the wind power centralized system (WPCS) for the effective development of the large scale clustering wind energy resources. Firstly, an actual WPCS in the Three-North regions of China is employed to analyze the voltage security problem quantitatively. By analyzing the reactive power response features of the wind turbines and the reactive power sources, the time domain simulation method is utilized to discuss the main causes and the development process of the WPCS transient voltage security accident. On this basis, a transient voltage security control strategy of the WPCS is proposed.
