The simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can suppress the occurrence of the wind turbines' cascading trip-off which is caused by the excessive reactive power.

articleTitle: Analysis of transformer tangled winding joints open welding accident
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Through analysis of 66kV transformer tangled winding connector open welding faults, the coordination of oil chromatographic analysis and electrical test can be used to find the defect and the location. It clarified the tangled windings of the transformer joint diagnosis of full open welding process in detail, and pointed out the direction for the future to find and the troubleshooting.

articleTitle: Paralleled optimal power flow algorithm based on subarea division of the power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the grid scale, the traditional centralized optimal power flow calculation has the difficulties of long computing time and higher dimension matrix. This paper presents a paralleled optimal power flow algorithm based on subarea division, which divides the actual grid into several independent subareas geographically according to the decomposition and coordination method, and uses the auxiliary problem principle (APP) in parallel computing. In each subarea, the multicenter-correction interior point method is used to solve the optimization problem of the subarea system. The example shows that the algorithm has good convergence and faster computing speed.

articleTitle: Research on active power control analysis method of transmission interfaces for online TTC calculation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Total Transfer Capability(TTC) play an important role on anlysis and control of power system stability. This paper proposes an method about active power control strategy analysis of transmission interfaces, which identifies the most sensitive generator for transmission interfaces and decides control strategy of transmission interfaces active power automatically. It can improve accuracy of online TTC which dependent on off-line simulation knowledge, also could not automatically adapt the real-time operation mode of power system. In this paper, a varible of integrative sensitivity of transmission interfaces is defined for reflecting the control effect of different generator for total power of transmission interface. Based on this varible, the method can calculate the adjustment margin and priority of generator in power network, and search adjustable electric equipments for controlling transmission interfaces power, and provide control strategy for transmission interfaces active power. Finally the simulation analysis of actual exapmle verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the sensing characteristics of 1100kVGIS UHF online monitoring instruments
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The paper establishes a defect simulation platform for multi-sensor 1100kVGIS, simulating four types of typical partial discharge defects within the GIS capsule and obtaining detection spectra of different types of defects as well as detection signal spectra of diversified position sensors. The attenuation characteristics of different position sensors were acquired under diversified voltage signals by utilizing steep pulse signal sources, as well as the relationship of equivalence between steep pulse injection signal amplitude and the discharge capacity of the discharge model, which provides a theoretical basis for field verification technology for a 1100kVGIS on-line monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on a method of intelligent reconstruction of conventional substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the developing of communication technology and power electronic technology, building smart grid has been a development trend for power grid in the future. Smart substation is the key link of building smart grid, as the point of the construction for the smart grid. Building smart substation mainly through build the new smart substation and transformation of conventional substation intelligent The thesis make a series studies on the scheme of transformation of conventional substation intelligent based on the reliability of substation operation and economy of transformation cost. At first we analysis difference about main technical between smart substation and conventional substation, and make sure the main technical about the transformation of conventional substation intelligent. Then we discuss innovation methods about equipment and function in station layer, process layer and interval layer to build three layers and two networks in smart substation. Finally, we get a scheme of transformation of conventional substation for Integral function of Substation, and this thesis proposes the scheme of transformation intelligent which takes into account the requirements of the development of smart substation technology reliability and economy.

articleTitle: Prevention control of wind power ramp events
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with conventional wind power fluctuation, ramp events have significant time-sequence characteristics, and the prediction information is usually expressed as the probability distribution of the start time, duration and the ramp amounts of the ramp event. There is a big difference with the conventional wind power forecast information, which is difficult to be directly applied to the system reserve setting and the prevention control process. Aiming at these problems, the prevention control strategy of the ramp events is proposed. The IEEE-24 node system is taken as an example to verify the proposed model by simulation. The results show that this method can be used to control the risk of the system under the action of ramp events and can get the optimal results of the expected objectives and decision preference of the operators.

articleTitle: A transmission delay compensation method considering circuit latency for power distribution EPON communication
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a transmission delay compensation method for EPON system in power distribution communication to overcome the uplink transmission conflicts caused by the inaccurate delay synchronization, which would result in the bit errors and loss of synchronization. EPON system architecture and transmission delay compensation are introduced and the reason of the inaccurate delay synchronization is analyzed. Then, a transmission delay compensation and ranging method considering the circuit latency which is ignored conventionally is proposed. An evaluation platform is also developed to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on power wireless communication special network for IP multimedia subsystem services
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With development of smart grid and demand extension of company's own business, wired network of national grid company which now existed, cannot satisfy mobile internet business requirement that related to IMS fixed application extension, such as remote meter automatic reading, HD video surveillance, mobile office, etc. It is needed to choose the right wireless communication technology and rely on the high-speed and reliable wireless network to meet the new business needs of the State Grid Corporation of China. It proposed three kinds of wireless network scheme implementation suggestion, and submitted the proposal for the scheme selection based on the three schemes. Then it proposed a selection scheme of private wireless communication network. Finally, under the trend of informed environment, it analyzed the promotion of IMS related services in the construction of wireless network, and proposed the development strategy about private wireless network structure to carry IMS services.

articleTitle: Analysis on grid-friendly microgrid economic operation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The ability of the grid-friendly microgrid responding the system operation demand is analyzed by exploiting potentialities of grid operation from the traditional load side. The volatility of DGs output is balanced by including controlling EVs the charging and discharging. The output of microgrid is scalable through coordinating all kinds of DGs based on which a microgrid economic operation model is built. The simulation result shows the microgrid can absorb internal intermittent power and achieve system dispatching well by coordinating kinds of powers. Its dispatching potentiality is sizable.

articleTitle: Investigation on power control validation system of wind plant based on measured data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The accuracy of wind plant power control strategy is the key to ensure the adaptability of the wind plant. Effective testing and verification are essential means for the correctness of the control strategy. In this paper, the principle of active and reactive power control system for wind plant is studied firstly, the implementation architecture of power control system of wind plant is analyzed then, the modules of the power control system of the wind plant is implemented according to the modular design thirdly. Finally, a wind plant model with practical engineering background is established to validate the feasibility of the proposed wind plant power control system by injecting the measured data.

articleTitle: Analysis of incorrect operation of 220 kV line protection power converse and its improving measures
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analysis a mal-operation event of power converse protection. By deeply analyzing the link between time and mal-operation of power converse protection from theoretical analysis and protective logic, it sums up behaviors of 220 kV line protection tripping behavior under power converse situation, concludes that the reason for mal-operation is power converse protective logic can not adapt to the fault fast removal of the operating conditions. This article presents three measures to these problems. The application results prove the effectiveness of these methods.

articleTitle: Research on the economic impact of users' capacity on connection modes of medium-voltage distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper establishes an economic analysis method of medium voltage distribution network connection mode, which considers the “dead zone” of power supply capability. Assuming that users' capacity in medium-voltage distribution network follows probability distribution, this method analyzes several indicators such as load rate upper limit of different connection modes and investment. The method of quantization, comparison and selection of different distribution network structures, which considers the influence of users' capacity is proposed. In the context of power system reform, it meets the needs of expansion planning in medium-voltage distribution network where large-capacity users are centered.

Author Keywords: dead zone of power supply capacity
investment cost of the access of per unit of users' capacity

articleTitle: A method of state estimation with variable weights iteration based on piecewise linear weight function
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the traditional weighted least square state estimation (WLS) methods cannot resist gross errors, the state estimation method with selecting weiht iteration is proposed based on piecewise linear weight function. The M-estimation is converted to WLS algorithm by using of equivalent weight factor function, while the resistance to gross errors and estimate calculation can be accomplished simultaneously in iterative process. The corresponding weighted values are modified according to measurement residuals and linear weight function after each iteration, which can decrease the weight of gross errors and weaken its influence on the subsequent iterative process. The boundary coefficient of linear weight function is automatically calculated by historical multi-section measurements of state estimation, and it makes weight area more reasonable. Calculation results of practical power grid show that the proposed method can effectively reduce or eliminate the gross error influence of measurement system, and have strong practical value for online state estimation techniques.

articleTitle: Short-term PV generation forecasting based on a multi-object AVC strategy assessment system based on modified radar chart method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The AVC system is a critical automatic control system which makes contribution to securing the voltage and reactive power operation of the power network. During the closed-loop detection of the AVC system which is to be applied in sub-transmission network, much problems have been found about AVC strategies, including their failing in optimizing voltage level, power factor of 220kV transformer and active power loss, while in some occasion the switching constraints is not satisfied. The existed AVC assessment index is usually designed based on power system operation assessment index, which is not so suitable for AVC assessment. Aiming at this problem, this essay present a three-layer AVC strategy assessment index. The first two layer of the index gives assessment on the satisfaction and the effect of AVC strategy, while the third layer makes analysis about the regulation potential of the network. The fuzzy membership function is used in the designing of the first layer of index to depict the relationship between index value and satisfaction degree. Finally, a modified radar chart method is employed to illustrate the assessment result, while two evaluation functions are presented to compare different strategies. The example shows that this method is credible.

articleTitle: A sufficient criterion protection scheme for ADN considering the frequency characteristics of DGs
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of distributed generator, the structure of distribution network has changed radically. Accordingly, the traditional protection schemes are difficult to meet the requirements, and the current fault isolation protection methods of DGs are not in conformity with the active distribution network development goals. Considering the differences of fault frequency characteristics between DGs and traditional sources, a novel protection scheme based on the sufficient criterion is proposed in this paper. Due to the harmonic content of IIDG is relatively rich when fault occurs, the novel protection scheme can accurately identify the existence of the fault. In the proposed scheme, only harmonic state information of the current at both terminals of transmission line is utilized, and there is no need of the strict synchronization of the sampled data, so the cost of communication is decreased which satisfies the actual situation of the current distribution network. The correctness of the scheme is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research of area coordinate control based on cyber-physical fusion modeling in active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Cyber-Physical System(CPS) is a new concept of integration of industry and information technology, and it will affect power grid in many aspects. Hybrid system model is a typical modeling method of CPS. This paper has proposed a control method based on cyber-physical fusion modeling of ADN coordinate control model, according to hybrid system model and indicator of feeder control error. Based on the control model, model predictive control theory is used in the optimal control of the grid. Eventually, a simulation is carried out with Matlab, and the result shows the method has a better effect, compared to the PI control.

articleTitle: A novel hybrid analytical and numerical algorithm for solving the circulating current in enclosure of GIS based on the loop current method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the gas insulated switchgear (GIS) system, the electromagnetic induction phenomenon causes the circulating current in the enclosure of GIS, called as the enclosure current (EC) of GIS. EC will lead to energy loss and conductor heating, and so it is harmful to the power system operation. To date, there exists no accurate and fast method to calculate EC. Based on magnetic field coupling analysis and loop current method, this paper creatively proposes a novel hybrid analytical and numerical algorithm, which not only can analyze EC of all GIS connection modes, but also provides a clearer physical insight about EC. Moreover, the numerical integration strategy, which is used to calculate inductance, brings higher calculation accuracy, especially to the loops with irregular shape. Compared with the simulation results of EMTP software, the error of proposed algorithm is less than 10%, which demonstrates its effectiveness.

articleTitle: A 66kV transformer insulation breakdown accident analysis and prevention measures
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The total reflection of the wave will occur twice and the lightning over-voltage will be increased by 2 times when the lightning wave along the line reached in the disconnect switch are derived through the analysis of the accident 66kV transformer insulation breakdown. This will lead to the switch breakdown and discharge to be grounded. In this case the breaker is between the arrester and the transformer and the transformer will withstand 2 times arrester residual voltage result in the transformer breakdown. Finally, effective preventive measures combined with the practical experience are proposed.

articleTitle: Development and application based on Google technology 3D model of distribution lines
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes the Bayannur Electric Power Bureau of Inner Mongolia Electric Power Group circuit diagram of the distribution network management situation and existing problems, the author introduces the development and application of three-dimensional model of function for power supply bureau actual proposed by Google technology map software principle and function points combined through the GPS device and Google technology in practice, to achieve a certain degree of social and economic benefits, and improve the level of distribution network management, to promote the distribution network management to digital, intelligent forward.

articleTitle: A power quality forecast assessment of Bin-zhou electrified railway based on PSASP
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The asymmetry of electrified railway loads accessed to the power system would bring the harmonic waves and negative-sequence currents, giving rise to the distortion of voltage waves and the problems of power quality, such as the unbalance of the three-phase voltage. Combined with the project “Power quality assessment of Bin-zhou railway electrification reconstruction project of the traction substation”, this paper introduces a power quality forecast assessment method based on Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP). Considering the railway load features, harmonic superposition characteristics and access way of traction stations, simulations are performed to analyze various power quality indexes of the point of common coupling (PCC) under different working conditions with traction loads station accessing to the system, then the power quality background test are performed for the substations of the traction station access point, the influence of electrified railway on the whole grid will be found according to the above two aspects. Results show that commutation by turns with traction stations accessing to the system has an offset effect on negative sequence current, and verify that the difference of traction load has various effects on the system.

articleTitle: A method of independent debugging environment based management of model change in distribution network and application
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Frequent change of distribution network model brings problems like unsafty, unintegrity and inefficiency to the model management. For these reasons, a technique of model change management that basing on independent debugging environment is proposed. Model data is modified and verified in the debugging environment, equipment changes obtained by dynamic sharding comparison, and model cluster is taken as the minimal unit to manage model change in distribution network. Customized validation rules, model rollback mechanism characterized by safety and efficiency are also provided.

articleTitle: Study on the relative localness of electromechanical oscillation mode by an improved quantitative index
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents an improved quantitative index and its solving method for analyzing relative localness of electromechanical oscillation mode, which has the advantages of computational efficiency and practicality compared to the traditional indicator. At first the eigenvalue analysis may be implemented based on small-signal model. And the exponent parameter could be subsequently optimized in the closed interval of participation factors employing the dichotomy. Eventually the index can be obtained according to those normalized factors for a mode. The case studies have been carried out on a Kundur 4-machine and 11-bus system and an IEEE 50-machine and 145-bus system by the PST simulation tool package in MATLAB environment, and the results show the effectiveness and adaptability of the presented index.

articleTitle: A framework to evaluate the Power Application Software of the dispatching automatic system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power application software (PAS) of the dispatching automatic system (DAS) is an important support for the development of the smart distribution grid, but it is difficult to evaluate the operational effects of PAS. To find the potential problems in operation, the PSA should be tested before interconnecting into the grid. Here a framework is proposed to evaluate the PAS of the DSA, using middleware technologies for the communication between the simulation system and PAS. The relative index system is established to evaluate the PAS. Test results show that the evaluation framework possess good operational robustness for various applications.

articleTitle: Multi physical field coupling calculation of airflow characteristics of SF6 circuit breaker based on actual gas model
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The Redlich-Kwong state equation of the real gas and the governing equations of the flow field were combined to solve the problem. The distribution of physical parameters of the interrupter was attained under the condition of the circuit breaker in small capacitive current interruption by analysis of the 126kV capacitor group SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas circuit breaker arc extinguishing chamber in air flow field, which is according to enthalpy flow arc model and dynamic model of non-equilibrium arc energy built by microscopic parameters of plasma. The dielectric recovery characteristic curves in arc contacts after the arc extinguished were attained through the coupling calculation in the field of electric and gas flow. Calculation results show that: When the circuit breaker is opening the small capacitive current, the effect of breaking speed on arc burning time is very small and arc extinguished in advance. The arc gap conductivity is about 700S/m, and the thermal conductivity is about 1.1W/m-K at arc extinguishing time. The transient recovery voltage is always lower than that of the breakdown voltage, and the electric arc can successfully break without reburning. To make the short arcing time have a large arc distance, and the large nozzle should be open enough to be strong for the gas blowing condition, the optimum opening speed is 9.6m/s.

articleTitle: Research on the single-phase single-stage photovoltaic grid-connected current source inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Solar energy, which is abundant, easier to obtain and non-pollution etc, has a broad application prospect in photovoltaic power generation system. In traditional photovoltaic grid-connected power generation system, voltage source inverter(VSI) which needs extra voltage-boost link to achieve grid-connected criterion, is more used, not only increasing the power dissipation but also making the circiut structure more complex. However, the current source inverters(CSI) feature voltage-rise itself, which can both realize the maximum power point tracking and grid-connected criterion. This paper focuses on the single-phase current source inverter. Single-Phase current-source PWM grid-connected inverter is established for the research and the linear quadratic(LQ) optimal control method is applied to this inverter, which solved the transient oscillation defect of current source inverter. Through the method combined by computer simulation and experimental study, a laboratory prototype of 400W current source inverter has been implemented and tested. Results of simulation and experiment show that this method can make output AC currents sinusoidal and in phase with grid voltages.

articleTitle: Reliability improvement of long distance transmission line protection in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Since two units of PT.GH EMM Indonesia were put into operation in 2011, because the power grid system structure in Sumatera Selatan is weak and it is located in the tropical rainforest have the climate characteristics of intensity and high frequency thunderstorm, combined with the power transmission line structure, relay protection, automatic device logic and setting many imperfect problems, caused PT.GH EMM Indonesia two 150KV transmission lines trip events many times, that cause the power plant blackout, which make greatly safety menace to the power plant safety production. At the same time, Sumatera Selatan often occur power grid failure, causing power grid frequency swing. This paper analysis a few typical blackout events of PT.GH EMM Indonesia, which caused by power system fault and lightning stroke, in the paper analyses the reason from a technical point of view, take corresponding measures, improve the security and stability of power grid, and the correct action rate of protection and automation device, maximum limit reduces the power system fault and abnormal influence on the safety operation of PT.GH EMM Indonesia. At the same time, propose the improvement measures and countermeasures to the power plant which have similar transmission line structure configuration.

articleTitle: Multilevel model view generation method for distribution network integrating with macro and micro vision
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution network model and geographical distribution map are usually provided to the distribution network automation system by geographic information system, the distribution network logical views for dispatcher are realized by automatic diagraming technology based on the distribution network model or drawn in hand. Because the distribution network scale is large, single view not compatible with macro and micro view, and the general detailing and fragmentation reduces the efficiency of operation of distribution network dispatch. The breadth first approach, implementation of large-scale distribution network model of hierarchical abstraction calculation, form a normalized space point and line model, the abstracted information model logical relationship is reasonable, no loss and heterogeneous, with automatic placement and routing technology automatically generated distribution network multi lateral view and automatically create different views of spatial link, form a whole, better meet the operating and decision-making of distribution network.

articleTitle: Identifying power system transient stability status based on the features of synchronized voltage phasor trajectory clustering
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, transient stability analysis is still of great importance for power system operations, and is only expected to increase in importance with the introduction of non-synchronous renewable generation. This paper proposes a voltage phasor trajectory recognition algorithm, aiming at precisely identifying de-synchronization of a power system with high accuracy. The proposed algorithm is shown to be capable of accurately assessing transient stability and severity level of disturbance in a power system.

articleTitle: Preliminary discussion on design of intelligent overhead transmission line in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the composing of the on-line monitoring system for overhead transmission line, the essential aspects of design technology are put forward. Based on the survey of the security threats to overhead transmission line, the designing principles are constituted. And then, the collocation of online monitoring equipment and the technical solution of data transmission are schemed. The outline of intelligent evaluation and diagnosis system is sketched. The mode of the power supply for the online monitoring equipment and communication device is also commended.

articleTitle: Modeling and parameters design using current-controlled mode active harmonic resistor for resonance damping
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Active harmonic resistor (AHR) has been proposed to damp the resonance caused by reactive compensation capacitors and line inductance in power system. In this paper, a specific current-controlled method for AHR is proposed and modeled firstly, and then the design strategy for AHR optimal resistor value is studied in detail. Simulation and laboratory experiment results proved that using this proposed current control method the AHR impedance characteristics can simulate a resistor in a wide band and AHR can suppress the harmonic amplification significantly.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation system of power control architecture of active distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large quantity of application of distributed power source and all types of soft load determined that the control architecture of active distribution grid has to face the duty of assuring dynamic equilibrium of system energy and improving power quality, so it is urgent to build a comprehensive evaluation system, which has to be objective, fair, accurate and effective, for control architecture of active distribution grid. Main factors that could impact the power control of active distribution grid were extracted and comprehensive evaluation system was built in this article, according to the features of centralized, centralized-distributed and distributed control architectures. Combined weights that objectively evaluated were obtained by adjusting subjective weights which were determined by analytic hierarchy process (AHP) using entropy weight. Comprehensive evaluation was conducted by applying multi-level gray relational analysis (MGRA). Using the demonstration project of district power center from XJ Corporation's as an example, a comprehensive evaluation was conducted for three types of power control architectures and final evaluation results were analyzed, so that the rationality and feasibility of methods and systems were verified.

articleTitle: The mining analysis of distribution network operation efficiency based on big data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On the basis of distribution network operation efficiency evaluation model, big data mining analysis of distribution network operation efficiency is carried out by using the obtained file and operation data of millions of the distribution network main equipment in 2014. The equipment include high voltage transmission line, main transformer, medium voltage distribution line and distribution transformer. The mining process is divided into three stages: business understanding, data preparation and data mining. Firstly, in the stage of business understanding, the data mining goal is made, the data requirement is cleared and the business scenarios are designed. Secondly, in the stage of data preparation, the data collection, checking, repairing, cleaning and reconstruction are carried out. Then, in the stage of data mining, using the selected data mining analysis model, cluster analysis and association analysis is carried out, and the monitoring analysis is further made. Through in-depth excavation of the relevant influencing factors of operation efficiency, positioning the existing problems in order to make the development of distribution network more coordinated, and the operation more economical.

articleTitle: Research on the reactive power algorithm of PV power generation system during transient fault process
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Low voltage ride through (LVRT) ability is the most important indicators of photovoltaic (PV) power generation unit grid-connected performance. At present, most of the important standards in the world require that PV power unit must have LVRT ability, and part of the standards demand that PV power generation unit should have reactive power support capacity as well, in order to maintain grid voltage amplitude stability. LVRT is a transient process; however, the reactive power algorithm is different from the traditional static reactive power algorithm during transient process. Using Matlab software, this paper researches on the reactive power algorithm, based on PV power generation unit in the process of the LVRT. This paper simulates the triangle method, Fourier transform method and instantaneous reactive power algorithm, IEC61400-21 in reactive power algorithm, combined with the actual PV power generation unit in low voltage through current and voltage data. In a result, the paper compares the simulation results, and put forward the suitable algorithm of reactive for PV power generating unit in the process of LVRT.

articleTitle: Dominant objects research of load model calibration in power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Calibration Navigator (CN) of load model in power system is proposed in this paper, which is defined as the first-order sensitivity of system angle stability margin with respect to parameters of each load in system dominant mode. This navigator can help distinguish the dominant objects of the system in load model calibration, including dominant calibration areas and dominant calibration parameters. The distribution of dominant calibration area under different disturbances is analyzed with a two-machine system which has an ideal two clustering characteristic, where several load parameters are considered, and the factors influence the distribution are also studied. The result shows that the distribution of the dominant calibration area depends on the location of the disturbance and the active power of each load, the result is tested on IEEE 39-bus system and a real power grid.

articleTitle: The discuss of protection strategy of HVDC flexible transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The HVDC flexible technology based on Voltage Source Converter topology is increasingly mature, the HVDC flexible control and protection strategies also are studied more and more. This paper summarizes the HVDC flexible system protection strategies of the status quo, and puts forward the corresponding protection strategy according to the characteristics of fault of HVDC flexible system based on Voltage Source Converter.

articleTitle: Design of the new motor operating mechanism for 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on mechanical load characteristics of opening and closing operations of 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker, a new type of permanent magnet brushless DC motor operating mechanism is designed. The main structural sizes of the drive motor are calculated by using the target value method. Through analyzing the performance of the same volume motor under different winding wire diameter and number of turns, the scheme of winding wire diameter and turns — more output torque, faster motor rotational speed, higher power density — is determined. The overall design of the drive motor is completed. The mathematical model of the motor is established with finite element theory. The dynamic rotational angular displacement and output torque of the motor are obtained. Compared with the pre-existing motor operating mechanism, the volume of new drive motor is reduced by 23%, and the average output torque and rotational speed can be increased by 53.4 N·m and 38 r/m respectively.

articleTitle: Study of influence on AC line active power by DC system quitting operation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: If DC system quits operation due to commutation failure in AC-DC hybrid transmission system, the power flow will largely transfer to AC lines, which may cause AC lines overload. Thus, it's essential to analyze the power transferring after DC system quits operation. And the results will provide the basis for the following emergency control measures to ensure system security. This paper studies the change of AC line active power caused by the quitting of DC line under steady-state operation conditions, and sensitivity analysis of AC system is extended to AC-DC system. Fast adjustable performance of DC system and the impact on AC system is equivalent to load or power source with fast dynamical performance. DC line active power transferring sensitivity is introduced to describe the impact of DC quitting operation on AC line active power. Besides, complicated power calculation is avoided by applying the sensitivity of node power injection to line active power. Then the change of AC line active power can be quickly calculated to predict whether there is an overload. The rapidity and validity of the proposed algorithm is verified by the calculation results of improved CEPRI 36 bus test system.

articleTitle: The risk assessment method and management strategy of distribution network cable in Macau
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The real growth rate of the gross domestic product has exceeded 50% for Macau since 2010. Economic boom attracts lot of entrepreneur to invest in Macau. However, the total land area of Macau is only 30.4 km2 but the population has exceeded 646 thousands. High density population and narrow street mean the density of distribution cable is very high in Macau. Hence, ensuring the high stability and reliability of distribution cable is the key factor for ensuring the reliability of Macau distribution network. For achieving the evaluation of cable condition accurately and replacing high risk cables in time, Companhia de Electricidade de Macau (CEM) has established a management strategy which is based on ISO 55000 system for optimizing the cable risk assessment method and the process of asset management since 2012. This strategy can consider different cable test results and convert them to health index in order to make test results easier to understand. The coping mechanism in the strategy can also instruct the electrical technicians the coping method for different test results. Combining these elements, a healthy cable management system can be established. This paper will introduce the cable risk assessment method and also the management strategy.

articleTitle: Study on SVG plus FC allocation optimization by considering reactive load fluctuation coefficients and probabilistic analysis of compensating capacity
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional reactive compensation capacity design of power grids and the proportional allocation strategy of dynamic reactive compensation SVG(static var compensator) plus FC (fixed capacitor) are lack of effective planning, which always relies on engineering experience only. A method allocating the ratio and capacities of dynamic reactive compensation and traditional capacitor compensation was proposed, in which met the requirements of voltage quality and system economy with tracking load fluctuation. In this method, optimal reactive power divided point (RPDP) strategy for reducing transmission power losses was used to determine the capacity of total reactive compensation, which amended by the confidence intervals analysis of daily reactive load curve in different power system operation modes. Next, the allocation ratio of SVG and FC defined by the reactive load fluctuation coefficients and investment economy factor of these reactive compensating installations was given in the final optimization model which consider about the system investment and voltage deviation. An actual grid network was used as a test case, and the model was solved based on Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO). The result proves the feasibility and validity of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Continuation power flow for distribution network considering current limiting status of inverter based distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Bus type of inverter based distributed generation in power flow is based on the control strategy and current limiting characteristic of its inverter. According to the equivalent model of inverter based distributed generation under current limiting status, a continuation power flow calculation of distribution network with inverter based distributed generation is proposed. A judgment part of current limiting state is employed in the proposed method to determine the current limiting distributed generation. If some inverter based distributed generation gets into current limiting state, its bus type and the elements of Jacobi matrix in steps of predictor and corrector, which related to current limited distributed generation should be changed. Finally, do some tests in a typical IEEE33 distribution network to verify the proposed method. The results show the proposed continuation power flow calculation method can reflect the actual operation of distribution network better.

articleTitle: Research on grid-connected performance test method for power converter of electrochemical energy storage
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the grid codes and normal operations requirements for power station of electrochemical energy storage, the grid-connected performance index and its laboratory testing method for power converter of electrochemical energy storage is given in this paper, which include active/reactive power control ability, power quality, grid-connected/islanded switch ability, low voltage ride through and charge/discharge control. By using the bidirectional DC source and typical electrochemical energy storage I-V curve, the test platform of power converter is built. The test and analysis of a 50kW power converter is carried out according to the mentioned indexes and methods. This test method is universal to all types of electrochemical energy storage converter. It provides the basis to establish unified and standardized grid-connected method for Power Converter of Electrochemical Energy Storage.

articleTitle: Wireless sensor monitoring network optimization research in smart substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The poor computation ability and limited storage of power of nodes have seriously restricted wireless sensor network (WSN) applied to smart substation equipment condition monitoring. According to the application of substation equipment condition monitoring, clustering network model for equipment monitoring is proposed. And single-hop and multi-hop network consumption model is established respectively. Then using group search optimization algorithm, energy consumption optimization problem is analyzed under the influence of equipment monitoring network coverage, number of network nodes, node sensing radius and the distance of equipment monitoring node to information fusion node, information fusion node to sink node, in order to achieve minimal node cluster and cluster-head energy consumption. Compared to the particle swarm optimization, the simulation results show that the GSO algorithm is simpler and easier to implement, and has better performance in terms of convergence and computation speed. The results have direct reference value for optimization design of smart substation equipment condition monitoring used in WSN.

articleTitle: UHV capacitance voltage transformer suitable for series compensation platform
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Using ultra high voltage disconnector to switch the fixed series compensation capacitors platform may induce fast transient phenomenon and repetitive strikings of disconnector, the high amplitude and steepness current may damage adjacent CVT. This paper build the simulation calculation model by ATP-draw of the resonance circuit consist of capacitance of series compensation platform to earth, inductance of transmission lines and CVT, the simulation results show that decreasing the rated capacitance of CVT can reduce the amplitude of transient impulse current effectively. This paper analyses the rated capacitance effecting on the error characteristics of UHV CVT, determines to decreasing the rated capacitance of UHV CVT from 5000pF to 2000pF, which will have no effects to the error performance of CVT needed by engineering, and develops the prototype of UHV CVT with rated capacitance of 2000pF. At last, this paper builds a transient impulse current measuring system, and measures the transient impulse current through the CVT with main capacitance of 2000pF and the CVT with main capacitance of 5000pF under the lightning impulse overvoltage, the measuring results indicate that the amplitude of transient impulse current that through the 2000pF CVT is 1.46kA, the amplitude of transient impulse current that through the 5000pF CVT is 2.66kA. The study result indicates that the UHV CVT with small rated capacitance we developed can decrease the transient impulse current amplitude, the reliability under the transient state will be improved.

articleTitle: Study of the voltage stability index considering transient process of the electromechanical in wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, aimed at real-time monitoring of wind turbine generator farm voltage stability, an index is researched based on data from PMU. Firstly, the mathematical model which considered the electromechanical transient process is established for voltage stability analysis of wind farm. Secondly, this paper research a voltage stability index based on PMU data which can real-time monitor the voltage stability margin and ensure the stabile operation of wind farm. Finally, the calculation results in simulation show that the voltage stability index is effective and available in real-time voltage stability monitoring of wind farm.

articleTitle: The method for photovoltaic module temperature ultra-short-term forecasting based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As module temperature plays an important role in the conversion efficiency of photovoltaic(PV) module, an accurate prediction will be very helpful in improving PV power forecasting. In this article, a method of ultra-short-term forecasting for PV module temperature based on RBF neural network was proposed, which had a prediction aging of the next 4 hour, time resolution of prediction point was 15-minute, and prediction rolling cycle of 15-minutes. In the case study, this approach continuously provides reasonable temperature forecasting of the PV module. It is indicated that this approach is of significance in practical application.

articleTitle: Design and evaluation of differentiated lightning protection countermeasures for pudong 10 kV distribution lines
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the dominated position of 10 kV distribution lines taken in lightning outage rate of Pudong power grid operation experiences and the increasing demand for the stability of power supply, it is important to improve the lightning performance of 10 kV distribution lines. In this paper, the lightning outage rate of typical 10 kV distribution lines with covered conductors due to lightning strokes in Pudong power grid is analysed based on ATP-EMTP and the method recommended by IEEE and Chinese Standards, the effects of typical single lightning protection countermeasures are analysed and compared. Refer to the differentiated lightning protection principles recently proposed by China Electric Power Research Institute (CEPRI) for transmission lines, the differentiated lightning protection contermeasures for Pudong 10 kV Distribution Lines are proposed and compared. The result show that three proposed differentiated lightning protection countermeasures based on back-up type, leading type and economical type could satisfy the requirements of lightning withstand performance under different conditions.

articleTitle: Fault line detection based on cross correlation coefficient for distribution network with DG
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault line detection method based on cross correlation coefficient for distribution network which has distributed generation (DG). Firstly, Genetic Algorithm (GA) is used to optimize the potential function parameters of bistable system (BS), and bistable system is utilized to extract zero-sequence current in noise background. Then, as for fault line detection criterion, the cross correlation coefficient is calculated between different lines, and the line which has smallest comprehensive correlation coefficient is judged as fault line. At last, simulation experiments prove that the method can detect fault line exactly in different fault environment, including different grounding resistance, fault distance and so on.

articleTitle: The research on DSM cost-benefit analysis and cost recovery mechanism to electricity companies based on transmission and distribution price
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Demand Side Management (DSM) is one of the most important measures to improve electricity efficiency. It is beneficial to guarantee the balance of power supply and demand as well as to establish a stable, clean and economic energy supply system. The new power system reform in China emphasizes the subject position of power grid enterprises in DSM and it is an opportunity to promote the development of DSM. Researched is conducted on how to analyze the cost and benefit of DSM to electricity companies in order to recover investment and encourage the practice of DSM. Firstly, the cost and benefit to electricity companies when implementing DSM projects are analyzed according to the instruction of the new power system reform. Then the cost-benefit model is established in which the transmission and distribution price reform is considered. Finally, the DSM cost recovery mechanism is put forward and case simulation under the practical background in Shenzhen is carried out to validate the role played by the mechanism in bringing economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Research on calculation method of space electric field around paralleled double-circuit lines and effects of phasing arrangements
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The transmission form of two-circuit lines on the same tower has been increasingly widely used in the actual power grid. With the increase of wires, the space electric field of transmission lines becomes more and more complex. Research shows that the space electric field of transmission lines will be affected by many factors, such as tower structure, wire properties and phase sequence arrangement. First, this paper expounded the tower structure and phase sequence arrangement of common two-circuit lines on the same tower. Then the paper gave the detailed modeling and computing methods of space electric field, and combined with this method to carry out a simulation analysis on 330kV two-circuit lines on the same tower in the northwest power grid. Here comes the conclusion, the intensity of space electric field is not the same when using different phase sequence arrangement for the same two-circuit lines on the same tower. Besides, the paper also gave some measures and suggestions on space electric field environment optimization on this basis.

articleTitle: Research of principle and site trial method for DC current transformer in the converter station
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recently, the development of electric power system in China has increased rapidly. A large number of of DC transmission projects are proposed, thus more and more OCTs are widely used in convert substations. In this paper, the principle and structure of OCT are introduced. And on-sit method of calibration for OCT is researched. Based on the practical field situation, multi-area synchronous measuring method is presented. Then this method is verified by field test and proven to be useful.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of electric power storage system for frequency regulation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The increasing demand for high-quality electric energy makes traditional generators for frequency regulation hard to deal with such condition because the generator responses slowly. However, storage system performs perfectly in the field of frequency regulation because storage system can response almost timely. In order to research economical optimization of storage system for frequency regulation, this study offered the cost and benefit model of storage system and. Besides, storage system can also affect the voltage of power grid, which could reduce the reactive power through transmission lines. A new method was proposed to evaluate the effect based on weak buses of electric grid. Finally, we used Matlab/Simulink to simulate a 500MW grid's frequency regulation with storage system to evaluate the economic of this combination pattern.

articleTitle: Configuration strategy of energy storage system in active distribution network based on area forecasting error
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Global optimization of active distribution network (ADN) divided network into several control areas, it need the output power of control areas keep constant. Because of the difference between forecasting value and real value of uncontrollable distribution generations as well as loads, the output power will be deviated from optimization value. In ADN energy storage system (ESS) stabilizes the power of feeder, however the power and capacity will be large for the method. The cost of ESS is high and the economy will be low in project. Therefore based on area forecasting error (AFE) index and feeder control error (FCE) index using consistent exchanged power control mode, the paper proposes the strategy to control output power as well as configure the power and capacity of ESS. The strategy can stabilize the fluctuation from forecasting error and reduce the power and capacity of ESS.

Author Keywords: area consistent exchanged power control mode

articleTitle: Coordination of power-planning and transmission-planning considering wind power
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the intermittent, volatility and stochastic characteristics of wind power, it is not only a planning issue but also a peak load regulation problem when it comes to power system planning considering wind power. Therefore, it is necessary to make a sensible proportion of ordinary normal power supply when considering wind power in power grid coordinated planning. Load and wind-duration curves are considered to illustrate the volatility of load and wind power. Based on the two curves mentioned before, use scenario method to simulate a series of scenarios. Then a multi-year generation and transmission coordinated planning model is built. The proposed model is a mixed integer linear programming that seeks to minimize investment cost and operation cost during the whole planning period and is constrained by grid security. The model is solved by GAMS programming and calls CPLEX solver to calculate. IEEE-30 is used as a test system to prove the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Researches on the reliability evaluation of integrated energy system based on Energy Hub
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the concept of Energy Hub was introduced to capture the coupling between multiple energy forms such as electricity, gas, heat and cooling in an Integrated Energy Systems (IESs). The reliability model for Energy Hubs was established based on a Smart Agent Communication (SAC) algorithm. In the model, the energy conversion efficiency, failure rate and repair time for various energy supply systems were considered, and thus the effects of coupling among different energy types on the IES reliability were taken into account. According to the SAC algorithm, an Energy Hub was defined as a smart agent which can communicate with other smart agent. Combined with the Monte Carlo simulation, a reliability evaluation approach is presented based on the SAC algorithm and Energy Hub model. In the presented approach, fault localization, fault isolation, system reconfiguration and fault recovery can be implemented autonomously, which effectively improves the system status assessment efficiency during the reliability evaluation of IESs. Finally, the proposed models and approaches are applied on the multi-paradigm modeling and simulation platform-AnyLogic, and the effectiveness of the model is validated by extensive cases studies.

articleTitle: A new condition assessment method for distribution transformers based on operation data and record text mining technique
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In power grid, operating and maintaining engineers have recorded plenty of operation data and fault or defect texts of distribution transformers, which contain asset health information. However, less information is effectively exploited in devices condition assessment. Aiming at improving the decision-making for condition based maintenance, a practical condition assessment method based on multi-source information fusion for distribution transformers is proposed in this paper. Firstly, an assessment index system based on real time and statistical operation data of transformers is introduced. Secondly, through HMM-based text preprocessing and the machine learning of relativity, the text mining technique realized the key information extraction from transformer's fault and defect elimination record texts for condition assessment. Finally, after synthesizing the subjective initial index weight, equipment's aging and the “Short Board Effect”, the optimized condition assessment model based on multi-source information fusion for distribution transformer is established. An operating transformer example reveals that this model is effective and accurate, comparing with the other available models. It shows that with this method, the transformer's accurate health status and evolution trend could be reflected much more timely and rigorously.

articleTitle: The status and prospects of VSC-HVDC reliability research
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The VSC-HVDC technology, as the third generation HVDC transmission technology, is proactive and the most advanced transmission technology. The reliability of VSC-HVDC transmission system needs to be further researched since its short research duration and few projects. Based on reviewing VSC-HVDC technology development, this work investigates on the critical factors and equipment affecting normal operation. Then, the article summarizes reliability research status and presents deficiencies by contrasting with the reliability research methods for traditional HVDC transmission. Finally, combining with engineering example, some ideas and prospects for the application and development of VSC-HVDC reliability technology are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on joint planning model for EVs charging/swapping facilities
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the increasing ownership of EVs, it's a new challenge for traditional distribution network to access large charging loads. Moreover, the temporal-spatial distribution characteristics of EVs' charging load should be concerned while doing distribution network planning to meet the large-scale EVs access. In the meantime, EVs charging/swapping facilities are the link of power system and transportation system and the key point to achieve energy internet, which requests both the access ability of power system and the temporal-spatial distribution characteristics of EVs' charging demand should be taken into account. This paper regards EVs charging/swapping equipment as a kind of demand response resource, concludes the characteristics of central charging station, centralized swapping station and distributed charging pile and analyzes the relationship between different charging/swapping facilities and distribution network, effects from different facilities during the distribution network planning process. A joint planning model for charging/swapping facilities is proposed, which solves the sitting and sizing problems of charging/swapping facilities and investment strategy of transmission lines and transformers considering EVs traveling behavior in region. The case study takes a small region for instance and uses particle swarm algorithm to solve the proposed problem. The results show the validity of the model, it can achieve the joint optimal planning of EVs charging/swapping facilities and distribution network planning strategy and result are affected by whether there are demand response program like orderly charging and what penetration level it is.

articleTitle: A Quasi Monte Carlo probabilistic load flow method of distribution system containing distributed generation and electric vehicle charging load based on Sobol sequence
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To calculate probabilistic load flow of distribution system containing distributed generation (DG) and electric vehicle charging load (EVCL), at first the effect on load flow for distribution system after connecting DG and EVCL is analyzed, and the stochastic characteristics of power output of wind generation and photovoltaic power generation as well as basic load and EVCL are researched, meanwhile a probabilistic load flow (PLF) calculation model of distribution system containing DG and EVCL is built. According to this basis and based on these drawback that the traditional Latin hypercube sampling method is of low accuracy for its incapability of generating sampling sequences of low discrepancy, a Quasi Monte Carlo simulation method (QMCSM) based on Sobol sequence is put forward. The simulation results on IEEE30 bus system and IEEE118 bus system have demonstrated the validity of the proposed method. In contrast to the method based on Latin hypercube sampling, the proposed method is of high efficiency, accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: Study on analysis and decision support system of power grid operation considering meteorological environment based on big data and GIS
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is significant to obtain the impacts of meteorology on power grid effectively in power grid operation and planning. This paper attempts to offer a approach to analyzing the effect of meteorological environment on the power grid, not only meteorological hazard but also conventional meteorological environment such as air pollution and temperature. In this article the business requirements about the impacts of meteorological environment on power grid are discussed firstly, and then integrated analysis and decision support system including four main functions and three layers are designed to satisfy the requirement. Further, considering the characteristics of meteorology and power system, a approach which can extract the meteorological influence on power grid and the internal correlation features on a hybrid correlation mining is proposed. Finally visualization technology of integrated GIS and big data is used to show the analysis results by a multidimensional way. The performance of the proposed method has been evaluated by case studies, with an effectiveness and correctness result.

articleTitle: Interior point method based reactive power optimization of active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High permeability distributed generation (DG) is accessed to active distribution network(ADN), and it has a great influence on the power flow, node voltage and network loss of distribution network. In distribution network, DG has a certain ability of reactive power regulation. Combined with the traditional voltage regulation method, the power flow of the active distribution network is optimized. According to the active power prediction of DG, the reactive power output of DG can be adjusted dynamically to maintain the local voltage stability and achieve the optimal allocation. Firstly, in this paper, the relationship between active power and reactive power of wind power, photovoltaic and other DG is studied. The objective function is constructed with total network loss and the penalty function of discrete variable. With the voltage and reactive power regulation capacity as the constraint, Distribution network reactive power optimization is established as a mixed integer optimization problem. The method of combining interior point method and penalty function was used to deal with the discrete variables. The continuous differentiable Gauss penalty function is introduced into the objective function, and it could change the mixed integer optimization problem into a continuous problem to solve. A calculation example of an ADN with photovoltaic and wind power shows that, reactive power optimization can reduce network loss, and effectively improve the performance of active distribution network.

articleTitle: Evaluation of reconstruction alternatives for medium voltage distribution feeder based on ANP-DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For determining the priority of reconstruction alternatives for medium voltage distribution feeder (RAMVDF) reasonably, both analytic network process (ANP) and decision making trial and matrix laboratory (DEMATEL) are applied in the research, and sensitivity analysis related to evaluated criteria system of RAMVDF is performed as well. By use of ANP which establishes the interactional relationship among criteria and calculates the criteria weight, and DEMATEL which quantifies the interactional degree within criteria, this study develops an evaluation model of RAMVDF based on ANP-DEMATEL. On the basis of linear weighting method, the process of sensitivity analysis with respect to criteria parameter of RAMVDF is deduced in detail, including a set of mathematic formulas for calculating sensitivity. The calculated example indicates that the proposed model is reasonable and effective. Meanwhile, the criteria sensitivity can be figured out effectively which has an instructive guide for multi-attribute decision making in practical distribution network evaluation.

articleTitle: Formal modeling and verification of smart distribution grid based on common information model
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The expanding smart distribution grid with gradually updating business modes is requiring a superior information model to reflect its state precisely. This paper proposed a formal modeling and verification method based on common information model. Considering the imprecision and ambiguity of UML in the modeling process, we constructed the formal definitions and logical descriptions for objects, logics and scenes of the information model, followed by the derivation of ontology rules and propositions. To verify whether the model possesses the expected semantic features, formal verification method is generalized using underlying logics and semantics derived from the ontology rules. Later on, the formal verification tool SPIN is applied to the distribution control area model as an example for formal verification to ensure the synchronization of semantics and structure for data exchange process between information models. a)The formal symbols in this paper adopt the following conventions: b)The formal expressions conform with Backus Naur form, BNF; c)The capital letters represent sets, lowercase letters denote the elements: t∊T; Definitions use the combination of numbers: 2–3; Rules use number and uppercase letter combination: 2-A; Inference use number and lowercase letter combination: 2-d;

articleTitle: Reactive power optimization of distribution network including photovoltaic power considering harmonic factors
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing of the penetration of distributed photovoltaic (PV) power in distribution network' the power system becomes more complex and flexible. Because of the uncertainty of photovoltaic power and the fact that photovoltaic power provides active power as well as reactive power' the traditional reactive power optimization method cannot fully meet the case of photovoltaic grid-connected system. Meanwhile' photovoltaic grid-connected system will generate harmonic pollution in distribution network' so it is necessary to control distributed photovoltaic inverters in harmony to reduce harmonics. Therefore' in this paper' considering the uncertainty of photovoltaic power, the loss of distribution network and the harmonics' the integrated reactive power optimization of photovoltaic power and capacitors is proposed, in order to guarantee the safe and economic operation of distribution network. On the basis of that the stochastic harmonic power flow was calculated and voltage total harmonic distortions (THDs) were obtained, this paper established a reactive power optimization model of distribution network including photovoltaic power considering harmonic factors. The objective function of that model is minimizing the sum of the expected values of the fundamental loss, the penalty term of fundamental bus voltages, and the penalty term of voltage THDs. Meanwhile, chance constraints were put on fundamental bus voltages and voltage THDs, which considered the uncertainty of photovoltaic power. Finally, genetic algorithm (GA) was applied. Results of IEEE-33 test system case show that the proposed reactive power optimization model can consider reducing the loss and the harmonic pollution, in order to improve the economy and security of distribution network operation.

articleTitle: The new master distribution automation system design and key technologies realization
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing and summarizing the distribution and use of the building automation system at home and abroad on the status quo, based on distribution automation to enhance the practical application of the requirements put forward to support the deployment of the integration of new distribution automation repair master system architecture designed to support distribution Network operation Control and repair scheduling integrated applications; new distribution automation system master key technologies, with regard to the frequent changes in the status of the distribution network is proposed based debugging system architecture diagram distribution automation module transaction management implementation model to improve distribution Network Equipment transaction management efficiency; proposed distribution based on the master and the terminal IEC61968 and IEC61850 models of self-identification and mapping technology for remote debugging technology, efficient mass distribution terminal debugging; splicing technology is proposed based on a business model with adjustment full integration of the global grid modeling and decision analysis methods to achieve convergence with the sum of the power grid analysis applications based on real time measurements, near real-time data, historical data, multi-dimensional data. Based on the design, the development of D5200 distribution network operation control and management system, the system in Suzhou, The application shows the idea feasible design techniques, correct.

articleTitle: The impact of electric power system reform on power dispatching institution
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A new round of electricity market reform has started up in China. Power market construction officially started with controlling the transmission systems-and relaxing both generation side and demand side. The electricity market reform brings a series of changes for the grid development, and breakes the balance between responsibilities and rights of power dispatching department. The changing role of of power dispatching department and its cooperation with trading organization under the market mechanisms are analyzed in this paper. The specific impacts on safe and orderly operation of power system standardized management of power dispatching, consumption of clean energy and other aspects are studied in depth. Three kinds of meausres such as resources control, capability improvement and market guide are propesed, and the management system reform and operational technical reserves are prepared in advance, in order to get economic operation of electricity market and safe running of power dispatching.

articleTitle: Characteristics and control strategies of composite energy storages in microgrids
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper firstly introduces the standard models and key control techniques of microgrids. And then the battery energy storage and superconducting magnetic energy storage (SMES) charge-discharge principles and control strategies are discussed, and further more build the simulation models in PSCAD/EMTDC to analyze dynamic characteristics. A combination of energy storage model is built based on the different characteristics, and realize the unity of control. The study is focused on the operational characteristics of microgrids and composite energy storages during the process of connected operation switching to isolated operation and again to the connected operation. The results show that the composite energy storage has both the two energy storage advantages, it can response rapidly, balance the power flow, stable voltage fluctuation and meet the load demand of power supply. It ensures the stable operation of microgrids.

articleTitle: Detection of inrush current in distribution network based on the attenuation factor of current fundamental
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the numbers of transformer, the closing angle and other reasons, the inrush current performed intricately, which usually made the protection miss operation. Therefore, reliability and stability in protection of transformer is important task in distribution system. In this paper, an efficient method for detection of inrush current is presented, which is based on the attenuation factor of current fundamental, and the attenuation factor is calculated by the Prony algorithm, which could obtain the amplitude and the phase too. Finally, results in all cases show the reliability and feasibility of this method used a large number of dates which are from PSCAD simulation and actual scene.

articleTitle: The mechanism and suppression strategies of oscillating current between the shunt and series converters of 35kV MMC-UPQC
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
