abstract: Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) based on a modular multi-level converter (MMC) (referred to as MMC-UPQC) is more suitable for high-voltage large-capacity applications. Because of short electrical distance and strong electrical coupling, there may be oscillating current between shunt and series converter of MMC-UPFC. Based on accession to the grid and practicable grounding design, the equivalent differential mode and common mode oscillating circuit of MMC-UPQC were obtained. And through the equivalent oscillating circuit and MMC-UPQC works principle, the mechanism of oscillating circuit was drawn. Finally, two methods closed-loop suppression and virtual resistance was designed to suppress the oscillating current, and, Validated by RTDS simulation.

articleTitle: A visualization framework for smart substation secondary equipment condition monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Condition monitoring is one of the preconditions of condition maintenance. As an important part of secondary equipment condition monitoring, visualization can provide an effective user interface for operating staffs to view warnings and a supplementary means to eliminate defects. Since the communication in substation is based on Ethernet, the visualization of network topology and connection relationship among equipment become key information that shouldn't be ignored in condition monitoring. In this paper, we summary works of secondary equipment condition monitoring that have been done in three aspects. Considering the demand of secondary equipment condition monitoring, we propose a visualization framework for smart substation secondary equipment condition monitoring after summarize the advantages of Scalable Vector Graphic (SVG). Design works on the visualization framework are mainly consist of 3 parts: system structure, user interface design and interactive design. At last, we realize a condition monitoring system adopting the classification method and the visualization framework. The running result of this system in a simulation laboratory proves that it can provide a more effective way to show the warnings and to locate the fault than current way.

articleTitle: Extended application of online security and stability analysis system in Liaoning power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With constant development of power grid, power grid security and stability analysis develops from offline to online mode gradually. The dispatching and control department at or above the provincial level in China have already deployed online security and stability analysis system. The system contains many functions such as static, transient, dynamic, voltage, frequency, small signal stability computing and short-circuit current computing. This paper analyzes the present situation of online security and stability analysis system at home and abroad. This paper proposes that online security and stability analysis system should be integrated with systems such as dispatching operation order, emergency command system, contingency plan management system, power grid risk assessment system and automatic generation control (AGC). It extends the application of online security analysis in Liaoning power grid dispatching system. Finally, this paper analyzes the necessity of integrating online security and stability analysis system into maintenance plan system, wind power and photovoltaic power control system, and dispatcher training system (DTS). The paper also envisages development on building online security and stability analysis integration computing platform and using PMU data to check online basic data.

articleTitle: Study on the configuration scheme of time synchronization system in the substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The time synchronization of substation is one of the key link of the advanced application of smart grid, and the mean of the time synchronization consist of synchronization and synchronization precision. This paper based on the analysis of the present situation of the application of the power system time synchronization system, different application (system) the requirements and time synchronization accuracy of time synchronization system existence question, on the basis of listed three different substation time synchronization system network scheme, through the analysis of advantages and disadvantages, presents the optimal time synchronization system of transformer substation network scheme.

articleTitle: Study VSC with small time-step simulation based on FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage source converter (VSC) have achieved rapid development in Power grids all over the world, due to its independent active power and reactive power control ability and other various functions. However, small time-steps are needed for VSCs simulation, because VSCs includes large number of power electronics switches. VSC modelling is studied on the small time-step, using a two-level convertor and a double loop current control. New switch modelling for small time-step simulation is proposed. Small time-step simulator is designed based on FPGA, especially to realize the power electronics simulation. It consists of core computation blocks, element blocks, interfaces of small and large time-step networks and commutation blocks, to ensure the real-time simulation. Finally, the simulation result is illustrated to present its feasibility.

articleTitle: Hybrid wind-PV system capacity limit calculation of based on constraint transformer
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the hybrid wind-PV system planning problem, a optimization model of installed capacity is proposed in this paper with the constraint of main transformer. Firstly, to account for the stochastic nature of wind and solar resource, by use of ARMA model and Fuzzy C-means(FCM) algorithm, a full-year time series models of wind power, photovoltaic(PV) power are presented. Then, using main transformer utilization, the complementarity of wind and solar energy resource is quantified. And based on the chance-constrained programming, the calculation models are respectively built for two common kinds of planning problem. With an actual case in Shandong province, the problems of wind and solar accommodation and the optimal proportion are calculated and analyzed. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving the renewable energy resource utilization.

articleTitle: Study of transformer differential protection based on self-adaptive biased characteristic curve
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the conventional biased characteristic differential criterion based on a fixed predetermined characteristic curve, it is difficult to improve both reliability and sensitivity of transformer differential protection. To solve this problem, the comparative analysis of operation trajectories of protection is conducted in this paper. According to the differences among operation trajectories under various operating conditions, a novel self-adaptive protection scheme is presented. The new scheme adopts the means of variable characteristics, utilizing different characteristic curves to cope with different operation conditions. Simulation tests' results based on RTDS show that the proposed scheme provides a high sensitivity for internal faults, while retaining a high reliability for all external faults. Protection apparatuses based on the proposed scheme have been developed and performed well in actual.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of dynamic voltage restorer
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The voltage sag is one of the most serious power quality problems, especially for the sensitive power user. At present, dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) is the effective solution to suppress the voltage sag. And the control strategy of DVR determines its dynamic performance. In this paper, a new control strategy, closed-loop control integrated with feed-forward adjustment based on interference voltage, is proposed to resolve current defects of DVR control system. The new control strategy not only improve steady margin but also speed up system dynamic response. The better performance of advanced control strategy is then validated by simulation studies.

articleTitle: Coordinated optimization of power system with plug-in electric vehicles and photovoltaic power stations based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The volatility and randomness of plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs) charging/discharging power output and photovoltaic (PV) power output have brought new challenges to the economical and secure operation of power system. Time-of-use (TOU) price mechanis can encourage reasonable charging and discharging plan of PEVs to fully play its role in peak load shifting. In view of the uncertainty of PV power output while taking into account the guidance of TOU price, a two-person zero sum game min-max model for optimal dispatch of power system with PEVs and PV stations is constructed utilizing game theory. Aiming at minimize the maximum operation cost caused by PV power, the model utilizes its decoupling property to obtain the optimal dispatching strategy using dual optimization relaxation algorithm, meanwhile, taking grid dispatchers and nature as the bilateral game players. Finally. The simulation results demonstrate the feasibility and validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Risk management strategy and model for photovoltaic suppliers based on bilateral contracts
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Grid-connected photovoltaic generation is developing rapidly throughout the world and photovoltaic suppliers have begun to participate in electricity market in some developed countries. This paper presents a bilateral contract model for photovoltaic power and provides trading strategy for photovoltaic suppliers to allocate electricity between contract market and spot market. Autoregressive moving average model and autoregressive model are used to simulate photovoltaic output and spot price series. Using the risk management theory in financial research field for reference, a mean — variance optimal trading portfolio model for photovoltaic suppliers is built. Based on the proposed model, optimal electricity allocation ratio is calculated. The results of a case study show that the purposed model and trading strategy can help photovoltaic suppliers manage their financial risk and obtain maximum profit utility in electricity market.

articleTitle: The research on power grid frequency regulation strategy with the coordination of vehicle-to-grid and grid-friendly appliances
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The improvement of smart grid interactive technology provides the basis for the development and utilization of demand-side resources, and the auxiliary frequency regulation by demand-side resources becomes development direction. The electric vehicles (EVs) not only meet the requirements of the society for energy and environmental protection, but also have the characteristics of fast response speed, which is suitable for frequency regulation. This paper establishes the power system frequency response model with the coordination of EVs and GFAs. Based on the model, the paper analyzes the frequency regulation performance with different capacity of EVs and GFAs in single area, and calculates the optimized capacity that can satisfy the requirements. Because centralized control has better response effects than decentralized, this paper focuses on centralized controlled EVs in multi area grid frequency regulation. The control logic contains frequency deviation and tie line power deviation, and sets the dead band to ensure centralized controlled EVs to quit in time. The optimal coordinated capacity, proportion and control strategy are analyzed. The simulation results show that the collaboration of EVs and GFAs has a better effect than only insufficient EVs involved in. Also, centralized controlled EVs can participate in restraining power deviation of tie line in multi area interconnected system, which contributes to the frequency recovery after disturbance.

articleTitle: Research on optimal stationing strategy of distribution automation terminals based on power supply reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: High power supply reliability is the target of modern distribution network development and distribution automation system is an important method to improve the power supply reliability of distribution network. There exist big differences between the distribution network structure and power supply reliability of different distribution region, thus we should use different stationing modes of distribution terminals based on actual conditions to reach the harmony and consistency of economy and practicability. This paper analyzes the fault processing mode of distribution automation system for Shanghai A+ region. It also builds a simplified calculation model of power supply reliability considering the distribution automation system, and then uses typical 10kV grids to analyze. It calculates the power supply reliability in different terminal stationing modes and considers other related factors comprehensively to propose the optimal stationing strategy of distribution automation terminals. Related research achievements have been contained in the “Technical Guide for Distribution Automation System Planning and Designing for State Grid Shanghai Municipal Electric Power Company” and will provide good guidance for planning and constructing distribution automation systems in Shanghai and other areas.

articleTitle: SSR-stable area analysis of DFIG based wind farms connected to series-compensated power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For subsynchronous resonance (SSR) phenomenon in doubly fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind farm and series compensated transmission network, this paper firstly studies SSR characteristics in all DFIG operation areas, including maximum-power-point-tracking (MPPT), constant rotation speed area and limiting output power area, to obtain SSR-stable area with the finding that SSR characteristics varies in different operation areas. With the approach of eigenvalue analysis in all operation areas, this paper further investigates the impact of dominant factors on the range of SSR-stable area. In addition, the impact of the number of DFIGs on the stability of wind farm is studied in particular. In the end suggestions are put forward from both designing and operating aspects for wind farms to reduce the risk of SSR.

articleTitle: Location planning of charging station for electric vehicle based on urban traffic flow
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large-scale use of electric vehicles significantly increase traffic pressure and load of distribution network, in complex urban traffic, rational planning electric vehicle charging station is particularly important for intelligent transportation and smart grid. This paper analyzes the urban traffic flow system, considered the traffic characteristics of electric vehicle and objective actual travel behavior process within the service radius, Using the Markov model to predict traffic flow demand of electric vehicles, it presents a real-time transport costs of charging stations to realize operating net income maximization, constraints are travel utility of traffic flow, traffic density and distribution network requirements, the use of immune optimization algorithm to compare. Simulation results show that the planning models and methods have important theoretical and practical value.

articleTitle: Analysis of 10kV grid arc grounding over-voltage hazards and countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Through the analysis of 2 single-phase grounding over voltage accidents caused by capacitive over current in 10 kV power grids in this paper, the causes and damages of arc grounding over voltage are illustrated, and the necessity of capacitive current test and effective methods are pointed out. The test and assessment to the 29 substations' capacitor currents provides a scientific basis for the correct selection of the neutral point operation mode, and the strengths and weaknesses of the neutral Point grounding through the arc suppression circle and the mode trends of 10kV grid neutral grounding are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Research on mechanism of large-scale wind turbines off-grid and preventive relay protection strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Currently, researches on wind turbines off-grid mainly focus on change of voltage and reactive power after fault in wind system. However, due to uncertainty of wind farm, there is another possibility: large-scale wind turbines off-grid caused by active power fluctuation. The paper will study this problem. As is known to us, large-scale blackout accidents in power system are mostly caused by power oscillation. In addition, power imbalance is the root cause. In conventional system, power imbalance is usually caused by a sudden fault, while wind turbine is the unbalanced power resource for wind system. Although output power of single wind turbine is a trivial, the large installed capacity could have a great impact on the wind farm. Considering regulation inertia of pitch angle and power distribution in case of uncertain disturbance, the paper focuses on the influence of frequency fluctuation on the output torque of the wind turbines. It is confirmed that output power of wind turbine brings positive feedback to each other in some cases, namely cluster effect and butterfly effect of wind turbines will make power fluctuation with greater convergence and larger amplitude. In this case, if unbalanced power exceeds the critical point, wind turbines will be out of step from part to the whole wind farm. As a result, large-scale wind turbines off-grid will happen. Simulation model by MATLAB testifies the interaction mechanism between wind turbines. Finally, relay protection strategy is proposed to identify large-scale wind turbines off-grid.

articleTitle: Study on low-voltage ride through capability of the offshore wind power integration based on super-capacitor energy storage
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to avoid grid-unconnected operation of offshore wind turbine under grid faults. Aiming at the problem of fault ride through capability of offshore wind power system, proposing a low-voltage ride through (LVRT) scheme of offshore wind power system based on the super-capacitor energy storage system (SC_ESS). This paper studies on the control strategy of the converter and the SC_ESS in the process of LVRT of direct-driven permanent magnet synchronous generator (PSGM). Simulation models of the direct-driven permanent magnet wind power generation system that before and after super-capacitor energy storage unit added at DC side were established by using MATLAB/Simulink software and analysis of its low voltage ride through characteristics. Simulation results show that under system fault, the presented scheme can efficiently restrain the DC-link overvoltage, provide reactive power compensation to the power system, help grid recovery, and improve the LVRT capability of the power system.

articleTitle: Quantitative assessment of moisture content in transformer oil-paper insulation based on extended Debye model and PDC
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to assess the moisture content of insulating pressboard in oil-immersed transformer, and thus providing reliable guidance for insulation condition and life estimation of oil-immersed transformer, in this paper, we made four groups of oil-paper insulation samples with different moisture content under laboratory conditions and studied the relationship between pressboard and moisture content by using polarization and depolarization current (PDC) technique. The experiment result shows that PDC curve is very sensitive to the change of moisture content, and the change of moisture content mainly affects the tail of depolarization current curve; the extended Debye model parameters can be obtained from depolarization current curve, and as the moisture content increases the number of branches in Debye model increases, the largest time constant becomes large; the peak of time domain spectroscopy turn up at 1000s., the time constant branch which is longer than 1000s presents the pressboard branches of Debye model; the feature quantity Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">paper</sub> can show the internal polarization of insulating paper and has a linear fitting relationship with moisture content, so Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">paper</sub> can be used to assess the moisture content of insulating pressboard.

articleTitle: Scalable and cooperative big data mining platform design for smart grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Significances and principles of smart grid data mining were analyzed. A scalable and cooperative big data mining platform architecture based on Apache Spark and Jupyter was proposed. The method of integrating Jupyter with Spark was detailed about. A new cooperation mode by collaborating with others through the Linux permission model on JupyterHub, the multiple-user server for Jupyter Notebook, was proposed. A hardware and software platform based on the proposed architecture was established for analyzing power big data. on the platform, all consumer load data of Jiangsu province were clustered through K-means clustering to demonstrate the platform functionalities, the research team members cooperated efficiently. The research practice indicated that the platform achieves high scalability, minimal maintenance, and rapid algorithmic exploration capability, leads to higher productivity of the big data mining applications in smart grids.

articleTitle: Harmonics analysis and simulation of NLM in MMC
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Selecting inter-phase circulation, up and lower bridge arm current, and AC output voltage wave of the inverter as research objects, this paper analysed harmonic components in Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) in Nearest Level Modulation (NLM) when MMC is used as inverter. With theoretical deduction, this paper points out that the up and lower bridge arm current mainly contains DC current component, fundamental component and second harmonic component, inter-phase circulation contains only even harmonic, AC output voltage wave contains only odd harmonic components. Finally, the derivation results are simulated and verified by 11-level PWM converter model (See Fig.1 and Fig.2) based on Matlab/ Simulink.

articleTitle: State transition analysis of artificial contaminated test discharge based on leakage current
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Studying and exploring variance regularity of the current signal in the process of contamination flashover development is important and helpful for developing flashover on-line monitoring system and studying mechanism of surface flashover in advance. In this paper, five statistical index computed from leakage current envelope such as mean, standard deviation, kurtosis, skewness and third harmonic distortion factor were selected as analysis objects. Through considering them as samples from five random processes, the one-step state transition matrix of the random processes was calculated and the state transition process was analyzed. The results show that surface arc discharge process has some statistical regularity, and single index can't recognize discharge state. The research methods and ideas in this paper were helpful for advanced research on discharge process, setting up its model and study on anti-contamination flashover technology in the future.

articleTitle: The planning and evaluation method of power system reserve capacity considering risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reliability and economy both have influence on the reserve capacity planning of power system. Based on the quantitative risk assessment, this paper analyzes the comprehensive evaluation index of power system reserve by the use of equivalent energy function, and then proposes a fast computing method of reserve capacity balancing reliability with economy. Furthermore, considering renewable energy integration has great impact on the reserve planning and a multi-state renewable power modeling is employed. Finally, on the basis of a real-life power system, three kinds of models are simulated and compared to verify the rationality and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Substation real-time data transmission and early warnings based on 4G private network of power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: While conventional substation inspection has limitations in determining the status of electrical equipment, some abnormal status cannot be alerted in time. A new technology about substation real-time status data transmission and early warnings was proposed in this paper. It is based on 4G private network of power system. Site inspection staffs could transmit real-time data via 4G private network and view key information of electrical equipment by using virtual screens of Google glasses. The information includes the equipment manufacturer, ratings, last inspection time and real-time operating data. The method proposed in this paper breaks through the limitations of conventional substation inspection. This method achieves substation intelligent early warnings and makes efforts to improve the level of automation of substation inspection.

articleTitle: Surface vibration source number estimation of the 220kV running power transformer based on the Wavelet-SVD-Clustering
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The existing blind source separation algorithm has two problems for the separation of the vibration signal of the transformer. One is the uncertain number of the transformer vibration source. The other is the vibration measuring point, which is not sure after the signal separation. Aiming at these problems, this paper apply the Wavelet-SVD-Clustering analysis method on determinating the number of sources by using one single sensor acquisition of transformer tank vibration signal. The effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation and experimental data analysis. The method of this paper provides guarantee for the correct analysis and separation of the transformer vibration signal.

articleTitle: A comparative study of techniques utilized in analysis of wind turbine data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power produced by a wind turbine is dependent on many factors with different importance degrees. Main factors can be found by a thorough analysis of all the factors and their correlation and impact on the main output. Therefore, it is important to monitor the performance of the wind turbines in order to minimize the operation and maintenance costs by pointing out abnormalities. This paper analyzes the main factors affecting active output power of a wind turbine which are Gearbox Temperature, Pitch Angle, Rotor Speed and Wind Speed. The data are measured over a 12-month period. Several techniques, Kohonen Maps, Multilayer Perceptron, Decision Trees and Rough Sets, are applied to these data. The objective is to show a comparison of different techniques, their positive and negative points and give the reader the ability to choose the best technique for the study based on the their advantages and disadvantages. For the assessment of data, MATLAB and WEKA software are utilized. Each study presents its accuracy based on the output error.

articleTitle: Sample inspection strategy research for distribution network equipments based on risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution network equipments can be divided into five categories nowadays, including 50 equipments and 100 sample inspection test items. To improve sample inspection efficiency and reduce sample inspection cost, this paper uses the thought of risk assessment based on state evaluation of equipments, gets the risk value of equipments by assets, assets loss degree and mean failure probability of equipments, and builds the risk grades standard of equipments. This paper takes distribution transformers as examples, determines the sample inspection proportion and test items by the risk grades standard, and proposes a sample inspection strategy of distribution network equipments for multi-objective optimization based on risk grades assessment. The strategy brings the sample inspection work of equipments into assets management system and makes the sample inspection work more reasonable and economic.

articleTitle: Distribution and scale studies of public charging stations considering electric vehicles' optimal charging choose
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the Dijkstra algorithm and Time-division traffic network, distribution and scale model of public charging station which considering users' optimal choose is proposed. Comprehensive analysis charge probabilities of different state of capacity under various functional areas, and each period characteristics of parked car in industrial, commercial, residential area then the temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of charging demands are analyzed. A new fuzzy Bi-objective optimization approach that can reflect the relevant priority between objectives is presented to strike an effective balance economic objective and user convenience objective. To solve this optimization, the particle swarm optimization is improved. Finally the example analysis verifies correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on improving power quality of wind power system based on the flywheel energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, impacts of the wind power random nature on the power quality, especially on voltage quality, increase gradually. Flywheel energy storage system (FESS) has the ability of independent regulating active power and reactive power. This paper designed the energy management system (EMS) model of FESS which can be used to improve the power quality of the grid. The model is based on the bi level decision model. The upper layer uses the fuzzy algorithm to solve the charging and discharging power of the FESS through assess the state of FESS and the amount of wind power fluctuations, the lower layer control the energy exchange between FESS and grid through by control the back-to-back converters based on dual-loop control. The voltage fluctuation of the PCC was compared using the FESS before and after in the MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment. The simulation results verify the validity of the model. The model can improve the utilization efficiency of FESS and the power quality of the system through the cooperation between the wind power and energy storage system.

articleTitle: Research and application of load balance approach for distribution based on big data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For solving the common existence of feeder overload problem, a load balance approach based on big data is proposed in this paper. Because of the dynamic characteristics of distribution load, a feeder overload quantitative model is raised, while multi data sources are employed, such as total contents of feeder/distribution transformer load, grid fault information, business expanding plan, work/operation tickets etc. The approach changes the open/closed status of sectionalizing and tie switches of the overload feeder and its adjacent counterparts, calculates the comprehensive overload index of all the possible operation modes and chooses the most appropriate strategy. Example shows the effectiveness of this approach. This approach has been actually applied for the decision-making of Jiangsu distribution dispatching.

articleTitle: Power quality analysis system of electrified railway based on PSASP and virtual node and applications
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power quality analysis calculation is an important power system analysis method, which is always held in high regard by power quality researchers. Electrified railway load destroys the symmetrical operation of the power system that injects harmonic current and negative sequence current into the system. A power quality analysis system based on PSASP is developed in this paper to calculate harmonic current and three-phase voltage unbalance generated by electrified railway. System transformation method and virtual nodes are used in the analysis system to make the two-phase traction power supply system and three-phase power system unified in topology so that three-phase calculation method can be used. The System transformation method, virtual nodes and the structure of PSASP are illustrated. The modification of node admittance matrix and the process of the calculation are discussed in brief. The wscc-9 nodes system example and a practical example show that the power quality analysis system has higher availability.

articleTitle: IEC61850 based modeling of self-control area for topology recognition in hierarchical and distributed control of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Large scale application of intermittent energy resources in distribution network has brought about great challenges to information processing on operation-management level. To make the processing more scientific and orderly, the concept of hierarchical and distributed control mode was put forward, in which all the DER systems in one distribution network are divided into several self-control areas, operating optimized controlling independently and hierarchically. Currently, there is no uniform information model to describe the concept “self-control area” yet, which makes it difficult for upper management class to operate topology recognition and to update the information of feeders connected to a certain self-control area timely. In this paper, the functional requirements for hierarchical and distributed control were analyzed, and an information model for self-control area is constructed. The information model hides specific characteristics of DER equipment within the self-control area and only provides generic view of the DER system for the upper management level. In addition, the model is constructed according to IEC61850 standard rule, containing additional information about the area's boundary, which helps improve the information interaction between different DER systems. Finally, a study case was constructed to illustrate the general progress of self-control area coordinate controlling and how the topology recognition system was realized.

articleTitle: Research on speed control method for motor actuator used in 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligent operation level of the motor operation mechanism of 40.5kV vacuum circuit breaker, and finish the opening operation of the circuit breaker under the preset stroke curve, the relationship between winding voltage and speed of motor is studied in the running process. The speed control method of motor by controlling the voltage at the specified point is proposed. Aiming at the opening process of circuit breaker, combined with the armature equation and torque equation of motor, motor model is established. The motion characteristic equation about winding voltage of motor, motor speed, stroke of the motor is established. The experiment on the speed control of the motor is carried out. According to the speed requirement of the preset curve at the multiple stroke points, the voltages at different positions are calculated by means of the characteristic equation, the duty cycle of every stroke point is regulated in real time, and the running speed of the motor is controlled. The experimental result shows that the error between the measurement speed and the calculated speed is less than 0.035m/s, the contact of vacuum circuit breaker can achieve the specified speed at the specified stroke point.

Author Keywords: control voltage at the specified point

articleTitle: Research on the optimal configuration of hybrid energy storage
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The randomness and volatility of intermittent energy will make the power grid unstable. And energy storage is connected to the PCC (Point of Common Coupling) in order to stabilize the fluctuations, so that the impact caused by intermittent energy is reduced. The energy density of energy-type storage like battery is high, but the service life will be reduced fast if the storage is charged and discharged frequently. The energy density of power-type storage like super-capacitor is low, but its power density is high and the times of charging and discharging are large. This paper focuses on the optimal configuration of the hybrid energy storage system constructed of batteries and super-capacitors. FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) is for the spectral analysis of intermittent energy output during a control period and the output of the hybrid energy storage is calculated. Taking the cost and service life of batteries and super-capacitors into consideration, the optimization model with the target of minimum annual cost is established. At last the model is solved by PSO (Particle Swarm Optimization) algorithm and is verified in the study case.

articleTitle: Analysis of main technical problems for XS and JS ±800kV UHVDC projects system test
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The main technical problems of Xiangjiaba to Shanghai (abbr. XS) and Jinping to Sunan (abbr. JS) 800kV UHVDC transmission projects system test were analyzed in this paper. Based on the system stability calculation results, 46 kinds of main circuit connection modes and referring to 500kV HVDC system commissioning test experiences, the system test program and test plan were prepared, which was divided into four parts that were single converter system test instructions, monopole system test instructions, bipolar system test and de-icing mode system test instructions. Duo to rectifier side system was weak in the initial operation stage, AC bus voltage control and reactive power control had been solved. The main technical problems in XS and JS UHVDC project system test were analyzed in detail, which included VBE and control interface function verification, island mode test and de-icing connection mode test. These technical problems had been solved during system commissioning test, which guaranteed to complete XS and JS UHVDC project system commissioning test and put into operation in time.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal power flow for DC distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The goal of maintaining system operation stability, improving reliability and reducing loss in DC distribution system can be achieved through optimal power flow (OPF). Firstly, a multi-objective OPF model of DC distribution system targeting on reducing system total fault rate and power loss is established with consideration of constrains including converter capacity, operation safety and the charge-discharge rate of energy storage devices. The multi-objective optimization of power flow is converted into single objective optimization using the lexicographically stratified method, then it's solved effectively by second-order cone programming. Finally, through multi-period simulation of a 5 node system, the efficiency and accuracy features of the proposed method is verified, and the algorithm achieves optimization of both reliability and economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on regional grid power dispatch and control strategy based on grid wind power integration capacity
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of large-scale wind power in our country, it has some negative effects on the safe operation of regional grid, especially when the low-peak load regulation capacity is insufficient, which can cause serious wind abandonment phenomenon and affects wind power's scale. There is a way to get the regional grid power integration capacity on an operating section considering limits of grid peak-load regulation capacity. Then the wind turbines are able to be added to the regional grid dispatch and source schedule in one day. By researching one traditional optimization model of regional grid dispatch and control strategy, this paper provides a new multi time-scale operation control method considering grid winder power integration capacity and economized the abandoned wind power. This paper also proved the new strategy is effective by an example which showed the new dispatch and control strategy could improve the access capacity of wind power and reduce the operating costs.

articleTitle: A method based on 2DOF-IMC to voltage low-frequency oscillation suppression in high-speed railway traction network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Aiming at the low-frequency oscillation of traction network caused by the high-speed railway electric motor units (EMUs), when transient current control strategy (TCCS) based on traditional PI controller is adopted by the line-side converter (LSC) of the EMUs, by analyzing the PI controller parameter adjustment, it is found that this suppression measure has its limitations. In order to overcome the above problem, this paper brings internal model control (IMC) into the TCCS, and according to the internal model control principle, a two-degree-of-freedom (2DOF) internal model controller is designed to replace the traditional PI controller in the TCCS. Then comparing the performance characteristics of TCCS based on traditional PI controller with TCCS based on 2DOF-IMC. Finally, the EMUs adopting the two control strategies are applied to the time-domain simulation model of the train-grid respectively, it can be found that TCCS based on 2DOF-IMC provides better tracing and load disturbance regulation characteristics, in addition, it is able to suppress the low-frequency oscillation of high-speed railway traction network effectively.

articleTitle: Probabilistic study of the requirement and control strategy of battery energy storage systems for reducing wind power curtailment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Application of battery energy storage systems (BESS) could help reducing wind power curtailment. Due to the uncertain nature of wind power as well as conventional generation and loads, it is more reasonable and accurate to determine the quantitative requirement for BESS probabilistically. Moreover, the effectiveness of using BESS to reduce wind power curtailment is affected by their charging and discharging control strategies. In this paper, a method based on sequential Monte Carlo simulation (SMCS) is proposed for probabilistically analyzing the requirement for BESS. Three practical charging and discharging control strategies of BESS are also proposed and compared both qualitatively and quantitatively as for their effectiveness in reducing wind power curtailment. The proposed method and control strategies are tested in a real large power system in northwest China.

articleTitle: Detection of harmonic in power system based on TT-transform
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Rapid and correct detection of harmonics is the premise of suppressing harmonics in power system, and is also of great significance to the improvement of power quality. A new detection method for the harmonics based on TT-transform (Time-Time Transform) is proposed in this paper. In view of the instantaneous data of the power system, TT-transform is firstly used and diagonal element of the transformation result is got, then, FFT transform is used on diagonal element to extract the characteristic quantities of harmonics such as harmonic order, amplitude, and the start and end time of transient state, etc. The fundamental principle and characteristics of TT-transform are firstly presented, and then the detection method of harmonics in power system based on TT-transform is elaborated in detail. Finally, the steady harmonics, transient harmonics and the harmonics with noise are simulated respectively. The simulation results verify the efficiency of the proposed method, and show that it is also characterized by simple utilization, high accuracy, and good anti-interference performance.

articleTitle: A method of setting specific security supply criteria for a distribution network based on cost-benefit analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a method to develop security supply criteria for different stages of distribution network, considering the cost benefit method and power supply requirements of ER P2/6ER and DL/T256 Comprehensively. The cost benefit analysis method can balance the reliability loss and investment cost. Taking an real distribution network as an example for calculation and analysis, its customized security supply criteria can be set. The search results can be used as an guide line or decision basis for distribution network planning and construction. Its applicability has been proved in some domestic cities.

articleTitle: Current protection constraints based determination method for maximum access capacity of inverter interfaced DG
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the fault characteristic of inverter interfaced DG (IIDG) controlled by low voltage ride through, the connection voltage and short-circuit current variation influenced by IIDG's capacity are analyzed when fault occurs in distribution system. It turns out that the connection voltage and current of IIDG vary nonlinearly as IIDG's output power increases continuously. According to these characteristics, a current protection constraints based determination method for maximum access capacity of IIDG is proposed, under the premise of ensuring traditional protection effectiveness. The simulation verified the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: An autonomic voltage coordination control in ADN based on MPC
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the penetration of intermittent distributed generation (DG) in active distribution network (ADN) growing fast, bus over or under voltage problems in ADN will be more frequently. This paper presents a novel autonomic voltage coordination control in ADN based on model predictive control (MPC). With the optimal coordinated control strategy for solving these voltage problems, this control method takes advantage of on-load tap changer (OLTC) and DG to make voltage stay in reasonable ranges. Based on MPC, autonomic coordination between voltage regulation units is calculated from a multi-step optimization, updated and corrected by real-time measurements optimally. Thus model uncertainties and measure noise are effectively compensated. The proposed autonomic voltage coordination control is tested in a modified IEEE 33-nodes ADN system hosting DG.

articleTitle: Transient and dynamic stability enhancement by coordination control of HVDC links of northwest ac\dc grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, Transient stability enhancement by emergency power control and damping of slow oscillations with active power modulation of HVDC-links are analyzed. Digital simulations show that emergency power control can improve the transient stability and proper selected of active power controller can effectively suppress the inter-area oscillation in large-scale ac/dc hybrid power grid.

articleTitle: Study of the minimum unit scheduling technology for the grid with substantial power import and restricted generation schedule
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to deal with the problems caused by reduced schedule of the local units, a minimum unit scheduling and evaluation technology based on the multiple security and stability constraints is developed in this paper. The process of minimum unit scheduling is determined. The quantitative method is proposed to evaluate the security and stability margin of the grid under the minimum unit schedule. In addition, the application of the technology in the scheduling of local units in Shanghai grid is presented for two typical scenarios of 2016. The study of minimum unit scheduling technology is expected to provide guidance on safe and reliable unit commitment scheduling and facilitate the implementation of “energy saving and emission reduction” program through the efficient usage of external clean power and lowering dependence on fuel-fired plants.

articleTitle: Common information model and its application based on source and load interactive system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A source and load interactive system is an overall thinking and systematic study of the grid operation and control in the complex environment of interaction between power supply, grid and load. Source and Load Interactive System takes advantage of advanced measurement, communication technology to aggregate distributed power supply, energy storage system, controllable load, such as different types of distributed energy, which utilizes advanced applications to achieve coordinated optimization operation of distributed energy and more reasonable optimal allocation and utilization of resources. However, due to a lack of unified information model and interface standards among all kinds of different application systems, it is difficult to create information communication standards, which results in a lot of difficulties in the integration of a variety of distributed energy and load interactive systems, and the monitoring and coordination management is also difficult to achieve. Based on IEC61970 standard, distributed generation, energy storage, the controllable load, and the electric vehicle charging are expanded by using the common information model(CIM), which can directly reflect distributed energy attributes of the source and load interactive system, such as total capacity, maximum power, real-time power of photovoltaic system, current state of energy storage system, etc. The extension of the CIM based on the economic dispatching of power distribution network side and the time domain simulation could lay the foundation of further research.

articleTitle: Distribution network optimize planning based on operation efficiency and benefits
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of economic and society, the planning and construction of distribution network mainly focus on the improving of power supply capacity and power supply reliability, while there exists commonly a lack of attention to the operation efficiency and benefits. The existing research about the efficiency of the power industry mainly concentrated in the power generation link, lack of analysis for the distribution. Based on the foundation of the operation efficiency and profit connotation, this article proposed an evaluation index system to reflect the efficiency and profit of the distributed network. Based on the comprehensive evaluation index of operation efficiency and benefits, we established a planning optimization model for the transformer substations, and the goals of the model was to promote the efficiency and benefits of the transformer substations. The optimal planning constraints were also determined. We selected Voronoi and differential evolution algorithms to solve the optimization model and put forward the overall process of optimal planning problem. Through the application in typical pilot area, the validity and the practicability of the method were verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of impact of DG on LVDC distribution network protection
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Compared with traditional AC distribution network, DC distribution network, which stands for future distribution network is suitable for distribution generation (DG) to multiple access. DG access changes the structure of low-voltage DC (LVDC) distribution network, affecting the reliability of relay protection. To eliminate the influence, a protection strategy which is based on Hall DC transformer is proposed. First, study about the effect of DG access on relay protection when DG is connected is discussed in detail for different capacities and locations. Then analysis shows that the integration of DG will cause rejection or malfunction, which may threaten the reliability of LVDC distribution system. Finally, the analysis shows that the optimization strategy based on Hall DC transformer can eliminate the effect by changing operation conditions.

articleTitle: The optimization of CPP strategy based on load data analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes the optimization of critical peak pricing(CPP) policy. It includes two aspects: the selection of CPP dates and CPP time intervals, and the determination of electricity prices at CPP days. For the former aspect, temperature-triggering method is employed to determine the CPP dates, and the frequency distribution of the time intervals where critical peak loads(CPLs) appear is used to determine the CPP time intervals. For the latter aspect, firstly the load response model under CPP based on load-price elasticity and load transfer potential(LTP) is built. Then with the objective of cutting critical peak loads(CPLs), the optimization model is established and solved to obtain the optimal pricing strategy on CPP days, considering the fee balance mode and the fee increase mode. The results show that the second mode surpasses the first mode.

articleTitle: A novel phase selection element
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper investigate the phase selection element used for zero sequence current differential protection and negative sequence current differential protection. Faulted phase is specified by phase relationship of sequence components of differential currents in the fault branch: the negative sequence component of the three-phase differential current is in phase with the negative sequence current of the fault branch, and by subtracting the capacitive current caused by system power source from the positive sequence component of the three-phase differential current, the corrected positive sequence differential current is in phase with the positive sequence current of the fault branch. Then, based on the phase relationship between the negative sequence differential current and the corrected positive sequence differential current, the faulted phase can be selected. The phase selection element proposed in the paper is immune to the distributed capacitive current along the line, is available during the whole fault period with high sensitivity. Simulation based on PSCAD model verified the validity of proposed phase selection element.

articleTitle: The design of a remote meter acquisition module based on 6LoWPAN
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Smart meter, as a key part of the smart grid, is responsible for collecting the user characteristics in the advanced metering infrastructure. As more and more applications have been upgraded to the IPv6 protocol, 6LoWPAN can potentially replace the ZigBee as the standard protocol in the “Internet of Things” area. Representing an application of IPv6 technology in the smart metering, this article introduces the design of an electricity information acquisition module. With STM32 microprocessor and SI4432 RF transmitter/receiver embedded in this module, a LAN has been set up for the data transmission based on the 6LoWPAN. The individual and system tests of this advanced module have shown its robustness, interference immunity, high network stability and lower power consumption comparing with other modules with different hardware and operating systems.

articleTitle: Studies on load characteristics of Tianjin power grid during the twelfth five-year
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the load data of Tianjin, the paper analyzes power grid load characteristic curves, and discusses influence factors. Firstly, the paper focus on the current situation of load development and the characteristics of power consumption structure are based on the situation of supply and demand, power consumption structure, and industrial structure. Secondly, the paper analyzes the annual load characteristics of Tianjin power grid, including load characteristics, typical daily load characteristics. Finally, the paper discusses the main factors influencing the load characteristics of Tianjin power grid.

articleTitle: A survey of research on identification method for winding material of distribution transformer
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, the manufacturing industry of distribution transformer (DT) in China has developed rapidly, and the competition is highly. The quality of the DTs was worried, where even using aluminum winding instead of copper winding in DTs without symbol. During the 13th Five-Year Plan period, the investment of distribution network construction will reach 1.7 trillion RMB, which makes a big market space for DTs. It is significance to study on winding material identification method, which can guarantee the benefit of the investor, promote the DTs quality, and ensure the reliability of power supply. The reasons for using aluminum winding instead of copper winding without marks are analyzed. The structure, demission, performance, and cost of DTs either with aluminum or copper windings are analyzed. The advantages and disadvantages of various identification methods for winding materials are compared, where the structure size and X-ray radiographic identification method are mainly introduced. The trends of identification method for winding material will be fast, reliable, and portable.

articleTitle: Coordinated voltage control using tiered weight coefficients of optimization targets
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the locality feature of voltage control problems, This paper proposes a coordinated voltage control method with tiered weight coefficients of optimization targets, the optimization problem is formulated and solved based on the model predictive control method. At the initial control time, the correlation degree between buses is obtained based on the dynamic voltage response feature and fuzzy clustering method and the weak buses are identified according to the predicted system trajectory. In the optimization objective function, the higher correlation degree between the controlled buses and the weak buses leads to lager weight coefficients of the corresponding voltage deviation terms. In a fault scenario, the weight coefficients of the optimization targets are tiered-distributed, and the simulation results of the Nordic32 52-bus test system shows that the proposed method remarkably reduces optimization scale under the premise of a global control performance.

articleTitle: Research on rural indoor cable leakage detection and localization
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Through the analysis of the characteristics of most of rural indoor cable routing adopting wall concealed laying and there being more nodes in the lines, for the problems of leakage detection and location of rural indoor cables presenting small leakage current and different cable parameters in the same house, this paper designs a kind of handheld testing device with a certain precision and convenience. According to the magnetic field signal being generated by leakage current, inspection tour method is applied to leakage detection and location of rural indoor cable. The mathematical model of magnetic field generated by current carrying cable is established through Biot-Savart's Law. It is to calculate the size of a magnetic field generated by the leakage current. The leakage points are located by using the magnetic field signal's differences before and after it. Applying MULTISM simulation verifies the feasibility of the signal processing circuit. Set up the testing platform, and measure the magnetic field generated by the current of less than 30mA, and further verified the feasibility of the analog circuit.

articleTitle: Non-technical loss detection by multi-dimensional outlier analysis on the remote metering data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A multi-dimensional outlier analysis method is presented in this paper for electricity stealing suspect detection (ESSD). A preprocessing method is first presented to resolve the defects in remote metering data. After that, six features are extracted from the customers' daily consumption series, and a cluster-outlier interactive algorithm is applied for solving the ESSD problem. A case study with an estate located in the north of Shanghai, China is provided at the end of the paper. Results show that the presented method can search out the electricity stealers timely in their first months of consumption drop, and is of much higher search rate and much lower misjudgment rate relative to the one-dimensional outlier analysis method.

articleTitle: Research on the control technique of low voltage ride-through for grid-connected photovoltaic inverter
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the new requirements of large-capacity MW solar power station, this paper establishes a mathematical model of the inverter, analyzes the drawbacks of synchronous reference frame phase-locked loop in low voltage ride through, improves the performance of decoupled dual synchronous reference frame phase locked loop and designs the proportional integral controller parameters. It uses the feed-forward decoupling, grid voltage feed-forward control and coordinated control in current control loop. The experiment results show that the proposed control techniques can make the three-phase photovoltaic grid-connected inverter operate stably and reliably under low voltage ride through condition, and make the inverter meet the relevant standard requirements. This proves the validity and feasibility of the proposed control technologies.

articleTitle: A robust approach of single-phase-to-ground fault location for distribution grids with neutrals non-effectively grounded
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Locating single-phase-to-ground faults (SGFs) in distribution grids is of great importance to avoid the worsening of the fault and guarantee a continuous and steady power supply. This paper presents an innovative approach of SGf location by using the fault information which is acquired by the fault location devices and sent to the master station of the Distribution Automation System (DAS). The criteria successfully used for locating phase-to-phase faults (PPFs) are modified to locate SGFs. The approaches of making the information binary and differential are described to meet the requirement of the proposed location criteria. Nevertheless, sometimes erroneous information is sent or received. To enhance the robustness of the proposed approach, the Bayes theorem is introduced to take full advantage of the redundancy and correlation of the information from fault location devices with various mechanisms. Two examples are given to prove that a SGF can be located correctly even under the conditions of missing or erroneous information. The proposed approach has been embedded into the Open 5200 Distribution Automation System which is in service in Xi'an. More than ten SGFs have been successfully located.

articleTitle: A multi-timescale wind power forecasting method based on selection of similar days
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the progress of grid planning schemes selection, annual wind power data in different timescale is needed in the calculation of characters. In this paper, a multi-timescale wind power forecasting method based on selection of similar days is proposed. The annual wind power will be clustered by scale of days, and then the LS-SVM forecasting model of each cluster will be trained separately. In the forecasting progress, a similar day of the forecasted day is selected in its cluster as training data. The forecasting model of this cluster will be used to get forecasting results, the time-resolution of which is in level of hour. The forecasting wind power of each day will be combined into annual wind power. A case studied shows that the proposed forecasting method is correct and effective.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of delay measurement switch in intelligent substation process level using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Constructing SMV network of intelligent substation process layer with switches has been becoming a fashion. This structure is convenient to share information among multiple devices, but it leads to uncertainty and indeterminacy in terms of time delay when SMV packets transmitting in the network. This drawback requires a reliable clock to realize synchronization, and the merging unit should have the ability of timing keeping to a certain degree. To solve these problems, this paper gives a structure of switch based on FPGA aiming to measure the time delay of SMV packets transmission, and proposes a scheme of measuring and storing the time delay using the reserved bytes in IEC 61850-9-2 frame. FPGA realization and experiments justify the proposed structure and scheme of time delay measurement.

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimization planning of the active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With active management, lower network loss, higher reliability, the active distribution network is one of the future trends of the distribution network. This paper establishes multi-objective optimization planning model for the active distribution network. The comprehensive optimal scheme is analyzed in three objects: the investment cost, the network loss, and the system reliability. Based on the Pareto optimization method, the paper proposes the multi-objective optimization planning algorithm, then the final planning scheme is determined. Through the simulation results of the IEEE 33 standard model, the validity and rationality of the model is verified.

articleTitle: Automatic establishment and optimal selection of power system black start plans
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Black start plan is very important for power system restoration after a blackout. In this paper, a new method is proposed to establish the initial black start plans automatically and evaluate the established plans. With consideration of the special power system status, black-start (BS) unit and non-black-start (NBS) units are preselected to reduce the calculation burden. The k-shortest path algorithm is applied to form the initial black start plans. Then, a new evaluation index is defined to assess the plans. The plan with the maximum index is selected as the optimal plan. Simulation results of Shandong power grid show that the proposed method is effective and feasible.

Author Keywords: successful rate of NBS unit start-up

articleTitle: Novel acceleration methods for electromagnetic modeling of high-speed interconnects in distribution grids ASIC
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Application Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) serving as the hardware foundation of smart equipment, play an important role in operation, control, protection and communication of future distribution grids. Recently, the design and electromagnetic (EM) analysis of high-speed interconnects is the key part for Integrated Circuit (IC) technology, especially for ASICs. The full wave spectral domain approach (SDA) in conjunction with Method of Moment (MoM) is the most accurate and comprehensive approach among all EM modeling approach of high-speed interconnects. However, acceleration methods are needed to decrease its complexity and increase its efficiency. Novel acceleration methods in SDA are present to solve a typical high-speed interconnect structure. Numerical results show that the novel methods can achieve higher accuracy and efficiency than conventional acceleration methods.

articleTitle: Research and application on operation and control technologies of smart distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Smart distribution network (SDN) is a comprehensive system integrating a large number of distributed generation (DG), energy storage equipment, electric vehicles and so on. This paper focuses on the key technologies of SDN operation and control, including situation awareness, operation optimization and self-healing control. They provide a theoretical and technical basis for the reliable operation and control of SDN. These technologies have been applied in a pilot project, which significantly improve the energy efficiency and power supply reliability of local distribution network.

articleTitle: The bi-level programming optimization method of extended black-start schemes considering safety factors during restoration process
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to enhance safety of extended black-start schemes during the actual restoration process, the safety factors that affect the restoration process are incorporated into the optimization objective set. Considering the leader-follower logical relationship of generator restoration to path restoration, a novel bi-level programming model for extended black-start scheme optimization is established in this paper. In the model, the upper programming objective is defined as the comprehensive optimization of the schemes with high safety constraints, using the generators to be restarted as the decision variables, and the lower programming objective is defined as the restoration path optimization with high restoration safety, using the transmission lines to be restored as the decision variables. A hybrid solving algorithm combing the improved bacterial foraging algorithm with the Dijkstra algorithm is adopted to solve the built model. The test results on the New England 10-unit 39-bus system verify the validity and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Probabilistic graphical model based residential energy behavioral analysis on hybrid computing platform
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The accurate customers energy behavioral can be analyzed from large amount of data acquired by smart meters. Practically, an ideal analysis system should meet two kinds of data demand: fast with low accuracy and slow with high accuracy. In this paper, a hybrid computing platform to process large amount of real-time data is proposed to analyze customer's energy behavioral. The structure and function of the platform is introduced. A graphical model based power consumption characteristics analysis algorithm is proposed. The implementation of the algorithm on hybrid computing platform is introduced. With energy usage data, four characteristics of resident energy consumption models are clustered. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the efficiency of mass data clustering analysis and also proves the feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Ontology-based automatic mapping technology for heterogeneous common information model
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Common Information Model (CIM) provides a unified information model for distribution automation, which is the premise for interactive information of smart distribution network. However, with the rapid update and private extension of CIM, the information models of different systems may remain heterogeneous and make information exchange difficult. Traditional solution costs too much human efforts to accomplish differences analysis work. This paper based on ontology model proposed a mapping algorithm to automatically map heterogeneous CIM. With only very few manual review, it can provide mapping solution for heterogeneous model transformation efficiently, which benefits the integration of heterogeneous distribution information model. The accuracy of proposed algorithm has also been verified through test case.

articleTitle: Analysis of voltage sag causes and cases based on on-site data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage sag and short interruption are increasingly hot spots of power quality concerns. This paper presents the application of more than a thousand voltage-sag protection equipment by Golden Cooperate in China, over ten years in petrochemical, coal chemical, chemical fiber and semiconductor industries and in power plants. With the original data from on-site equipment, main causes of voltage sags are analyzed by data mining methods. The analysis results are presented according to industries and geographical regions. In addition, case analysis is presented.

articleTitle: Clustering approach and characteristic indices for load profiles of customers using data from AMI
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the clustering approach and characteristic indices for load profiles of customers are researched. First, a method for extracting the typical electricity usage profile of an individual customer is proposed, in which the density-based DBSCAN algorithm is followed by a correction strategy aiming at eliminating the significant distortion in the extraction results caused by DBSCAN. Second, K-means clustering is performed to cluster the behavior of the customers' typical load profiles and the evaluation function for clustering effect is applied to determine the most appropriate number of clusters. Finally, the characterization indices are presented with which the profile cluster of a customer could be identified easily. The effectiveness of the proposed methods is demonstrated by the real data of power consumption of industrial and commercial customers from AMI.

articleTitle: Study on improving the current carrying capacity of power cable in real-time operating environment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: By analyzing the various factors affecting the current carrying capacity of power cable in actual operating environment, the mathematical model of temperature change of cable in the actual operation can be obtained. On this basis, establishing a dynamic relationship between its real-time current carrying capacity and operating temperature, and solving by algebraic equations and differential equation alternately, to study the dynamic changing process between its current carrying capacity and operating temperature of cable in real-time operating conditions. Finally, the example proves that the study of current carrying capacity of cable in real-time operating environment can be as far as possible to play its maximum transmission capacity and improve operating efficiency.

articleTitle: Bi-level programming based optimal reactive power allocation for hierarchical voltage/var control in partitioned distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel reactive power allocation optimization method based on the bi-level programming (BP) model. Considering hierarchical voltage/ var control in partitioned distribution network and dynamic coupling relationships between periods, the BP model is applied to make a research on the optimized expansion of existing allocation. In the proposal, lower model aims to maximize the balance of reactive power locally while upper model targets at minimizing the voltage deviation from expected value. Besides the upper and lower model are interlinked and coordinated through the nodal voltage.
