Simultaneously, two contribution factor indexes are employed to quantify the ability of improving the voltage quality and optimizing the branch flow. And these indexes can be derived from the voltage-var sensitivity and branch flow-var sensitivity. Then according to the indexes, the best ones are chosen as compensation nodes and employed in the bi-level programming model. Finally the results of the American PG&E 69-buses distribution network validate the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on microgrid protection based on transient polarity comparison
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the characteristic of flexible operation mode of distributed power, the fault current between grid connected and islanding way is very different, conventional three-section over-current protection isn't suitable for microgrid power system. A big challenge is brought forward for microgrid protection, to satisfy quick acting and selective requirement. A microgrid protection principle based on transient polarity comparison is proposed in this paper, and it can adapt to the different operation mode. The one-dimensional discrete wavelet transform by Mallat algorithm is researched to extract the fault transient high frequency information, which is used as the basis of fault judgement. It can realize fault location by comparing the polarity of the transient high frequency signal. Furthermore, this realizing scheme of equipment is designed. Finally, the simulation work is carried out by Matlab to verify the correctness of the protection principle.

articleTitle: The flexible control strategy study of receiving end large power grid under global energy connection
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper puts forward a comprehensive control method of UHV receiving end power grid based on user intelligent interaction. The load flexible control cloud platform, together with the existing dispatching operation and marketing system, realizes load regulation by smart plug-in units with the function of micro-control and infrared adjustment. When high power deficiency happens caused by UHV failure or emergency shutdown, the load flexible control cloud platform can play an important role on hierarchical control of virtual power plants flexibly and fine. The large scale virtual power plants response to form clusters aggregation effect, contributing large power to support grid power supply and demand balance, to ensure the safe and stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: A time-related business scheduling strategy in software defined networks
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the time-related service scheduling problem in software defined optical networks, a cross-layer control architecture and a time-flexible cross-layer optimization strategy of time-aware software defined optical networks are presented in this paper. With the introduction of time factor, we deploy the strategy to network controller. It can flexibly allocate resource to realize time-related business scheduling based on time-sensitivity of service. The simulation results show that, the proposed strategy can flexibly and efficiently allocate network and application resources by concerning time factor, which can overcome the congestion and low-usage of resource.

articleTitle: Analyze on simplified simulation model of converter station
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a simplified simulation model of HVDC converter station based on real-time simulation system (RTDS) is presented. Instead of several converter units, a lumped parameter model is purposed. Equivalent calculations are done on converter transformers, converter bridges and control loops. Simulation results are analyzed on static operating point, small disturbance and fault states. A comparison between simulation results of simplified model and traditional model shows, simplified model has the same characteristic as traditional model when operating around statistic operation point. The simplified model uses less simulation nodes and less calculation resources, therefore it is more suitable in large scale distribution power network simulation.

articleTitle: Simulation study of power transformer inrush current and internal fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper is devoted to electromagnetic transient model and algorithm of inrush current and internal fault for power transformer. In the paper, it presents transformer model with excitation nonlinear characteristic based on the controlled source theory transformer simulation and damping trapezoidal algorithm. It simulates inrush current and internal fault by that model. When transformer inrush current phenomenon is simulated, usually piecewise linearization method will be adapted to solve the problem of transformer excitation saturation. However, after the comparison of simulated results with different step sizes, the paper finds it has overshoot distortion with larger step size and it increases simulation time with smaller step size. Therefore the paper proposes to predict next simulated exciting current during the simulation procedure. When predicted value is over the saturation threshold, exciting current revised formula will replace the original one. This method effectively solves overshoot distortion problem without decreasing simulation step size and improves simulation efficiency. On the basis of this simulation, it researches on transformer internal fault principle and modellings turn-to-turn short circuit internal fault for transformer. This model is able to simulate transformer turn-to-turn short circuit internal fault directly by setting up the parameter without any external circuit building. These models and algorithm are validated by test case.

articleTitle: Medium voltage switch-fuse combinations are still well fitting with smartgrid deployment
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In MV ring network configuration, the typical MV switchgear of the MV/LV substation specified by the utilities is a compact and often non extensible 3 functions switchgear RMU consisting in two load-break switch units plus one protection unit connected to the MV/LV transformer. The protection unit may be a switch-fuse combination or a circuit-breaker. For such public distribution applications, protection of MV/LV transformers by MV switch-fuse combination offers an optimized solution. Switch-fuse combination have their place in the investments for Smartgrids.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient coordinated multi-point transmission for centralized power wireless private TD-LTE network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes and evaluates the energy-efficient Coordinated Multi-Point (CoMP) transmission schemes for centralized power wireless private TD-LTE network to utilize the limited radio frequency resources to satisfy the explosively increasing data traffic demands in Smart Grid. Centralized architecture is introduced to implement the power wireless private TD-LTE network. Energy-efficient CoMP transmissions are modeled as optimization problems and solved by proposed methods. Simulation results are given to evaluate and compare the performance of transmission schemes.

articleTitle: Practical fault location estimation based on voltage sags magnitude
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to make full use of the existing voltage sag recording device, a practical location algorithm is proposed based on the voltage sag magnitude. Firstly, the fault distance distribution function is established by a nodal impedance matrix that well reflects the variation of fault distance, and according to fault distance distribution function and the post-fault voltage sag data measured by monitor the fault distance is then calculated. Secondly, determining the placement scheme can well find the fault position in the whole power grid. Finally, we only use voltage sags magnitude to locate the fault position. The simulation results and error analysis show that the proposed method is correct and available.

articleTitle: Generation dispatching management of small hydropower plants in CSG
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the dominant and most widespread distributed energy in China Southern Power Grid(CSG) area, Small hydropower contributes a lot to the power supply of local disticts, especially those remote rural districts. The basic situation and main characteristics of small hydropower plants in CSG are introduced in this paper. Problems existing in generation management of small hydropower plants such as local grid dynamic stability, power prediction difficulty and lack of generation data are discussed. To solved these problems, specific measures including statistic analysis based on survey, generation infomation collection, small hydropower OMS development and enhancement of operation management are adopted in the last five years in CSG. Effective results are proved from both grid security enhancement and small hydropower generation improvement, providing feasible and practical dispatching experiences to other small hydropwer abundent districts.

articleTitle: Research of test models of electric power dispatching data network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the size and service applications of electric power dispatching data network expanded gradually, types of router device accessed are also increasing. Technical requirements of devices networking characteristics, performance, and compatibility play important roles at the safe and stable operation of the dispatching data network. Performance, compatibility, and networking test models are proposed in this paper, which based on an analysis of the service types, network structure of dispatching data network and the development of routers. It is proved by practices that, these test models cover the entire service application scenarios of the current dispatching data network, futher standardizing network equipment access tests to the dispatching data network and promoting product upgrade and continuous improvement.

articleTitle: Research of energy storage devices and power coordinated control strategy of micro grid with photo-voltaic connected
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The energy storage devices of photovoltaic and their control strategies are significate for the maintain of voltage stability of microgrid. In this paper, aimed at improving the voltage stability and the disturbance resisting ability of voltage, the power coordinating control strategy of photovoltaic energy storage device was researched and improved. Firstly, energy storage battery was selected as the main storage unit. The control strategy switches the Buck-Boost mode by detecting the balance of powers between photovoltaic cells and load. Energy storage device can smooth power fluctuations which caused by changes of light intensity and load for stabilize the voltage of DC bus. Secondly, the coordinating control strategy was designed for power balance of photovoltaic and energy storage battery which maintained the stability of DC bus voltage. Lastly, voltage stability of the micro grid with energy storage system service and out of service in this pager was calculated by voltage stability index LZ and simulation calculation in PSCAD. The results certificated the energy storage system with Buck-Boost mode coordinating control strategy could effectively maintain the voltage stability of load bus which attained the objective of coordinating control strategy design.

articleTitle: Shielded solid insulated switchgear technology offers many advantages and responds to all trends in switchgear standardisation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For industrial applications, availability of internal MV networks is of high importance. Facing often more severe environmental and installation conditions than the normal ones described in standards, it appears that one important parameter is the ability of MV switchgear to withstand harsh environmental conditions, without losing insulating performances. Shielded Solid Insulation Switchgear (2SIS) perfectly answers these needs.

articleTitle: Simulation model based on reliability and maintenance of a component and their effect on cost
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Maintenance actions are important activities carried out by utilities to maintain the operability, reliability and sustainability of systems. These actions are mainly divided into two categories, corrective and preventive with different degrees, e.g. as-good-as-new, as-bad-as-old, imperfect. In this paper, a general flexible maintenance model is created that integrates both corrective and preventive maintenance actions as well as their maintenance degree. The model incorporates a novel parameter, maintenance efficiency, which inherently influences maintenance actions and the behavior of the component under study. Impact of each maintenance action are evaluated and observed by considering several implemented indices, e.g. expenses, reliability etc. For input data, information on failure history of the component suffice. The model is implemented and run in ARENA software and the study presented shows accurately the relation and impact of employed variables.

articleTitle: Studies on oil-immersed distribution transformer product service system based on Kano model and analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Market demands on the product performance and additional service of oil-immersed distribution transformer have become increasingly diversified. Single form of oil-immersed distribution transformer product and pure business relationship cannot adapt to current needs. Product service system innovation design can change single product form to the combination of product and service, it has the significance of further satisfying user requirements, and it is an extension service in a new form of physical product. In this paper, according to Kano model, user requirements were collected and classified. Then based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP), each class of user requirements was sorted by optimal weight and recombined. Finally, user requirements were mapped into correlative function/service characteristics, innovation design of oil-immersed distribution transformer product service system was achieved. The results have a certain guiding role for transformer manufacturers to adapt to the demands of power supply enterprises.

articleTitle: A novel load flow model for distribution systems based on current injections
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the wide application of distributed generators (DGs) and other distributed energy sources (DERs) being integrated to distribution systems, the DGs can be described as different load flow models. Traditional load flow calculation model might have difficulty in getting the load flow results fast and accurately. A novel model to solve the load flow problem is proposed in this paper, especially for distribution systems with DGs. Based on the analysis of DGs' characteristics, the buses are classified into 5 types: slack bus, PQ bus, interconnecting (IC) bus, PV bus and PI bus. Using the current injection equations written in rectangular coordinates, different variables (I, θ, V, α, I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>, Q) are introduced into the proposed model for different bus types. The computational results validate the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method, when compared to the traditional load flow model in terms of power injections.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of outage analysis key technology based on information integration of power distribution and utilization
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on multi-source data modeling and information integration of power distribution and utilization, outage analysis key technology under different time dimensions is studied. Implementation of several key techniques are also elaborated including consumer outage event alarm and reason analysis, consumer outage statistic and impact access, real-time consumer power recover analysis, consumer power reliability analysis and consumer outage simulation analysis. The study indicates that instant and correct outage information and recover information of consumers can be provided while power dispatching of distribution and utilization can be supported by outage analysis results published based on the unified model and information integration for power distribution and utilization.

articleTitle: Research of active distribution system economic planning considering power quality
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Active distribution systems are faced with various power quality problems, which are caused by stochastic output of distributed generations and uncertain load. Current research one-sided focus on how to suppress power quality problems, without unified considering power consumer economic loss and power grid construction investment. In this paper, the planning objective is to minimize both power consumer economic loss caused by power quality problems and power grid construction investment of improving power quality. Based on the chance constrained programming method, a multi-objective network structure planning model for active distribution system is proposed. The model can be solved by non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) combined with Latin hypercube sampling-based Monte-Carlo simulation, the solving steps was given in this paper. In the end, this paper illustrated the network-structure Pareto optimization curve of Active distribution systems.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on “9.19” ±800KV Jinpin-Suzhou DC bipolar block fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) that directly flown into the Jiangsu Power Grid has effectively alleviated the power shortage of Southern Jiangsu province, however, bipolar block fault of DC transmission system in high power mode may give rise to great impact on receiving-end power grid, and thus may severely affect security and stability of the large-scale power grid. In this paper, the process bipolar block fault of Jinpin-Suzhou DC system is presented, and its impact on Jiaugsu power grid is analyzed based on the PMU fault record. Utilizing the Dynamic Stability System (DSA) system of Jiangsu Power Dispatching and Control Center, a simulation analysis of the fault is given, and by comparing the simulation curve and PMU record data, the causes of differences between these two curves are analyzed. Advice on power grid operation, modeling and on-line simulation is given at last.

articleTitle: Optimization and modeling of power supply capability in distribution system based on analyzing interconnections among main transformer
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the basic thoughts of calculating power supply capability of distribution system, which is based on the interconnections among main transformers and the N-1 guideline, this paper put forward an improved optimization calculation model of maximum power supply capability considering constraints of main transformer overloading and tie-line capacity. The model described general process of the main transformer N-1 verification and the load's second transfer caused by the main transformer's short-term overload. The model was solved using the linear optimization toolbox of MATLAB. On this basis, the paper defined three types of calculation modules for power supply capability and established the comprehensive analysis program. Finally the effectiveness of the method and model was verified through analyzing the power supply capability of a practical example.

articleTitle: Application of index of conditional value-at-risk in evaluation of power grid weak links
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power grid weak links affect the safety of power system operation directly. The index of conditional value-at-risk will be applied in this paper to evaluate weak links. Firstly, the paper introduces the theory of the index and the method of evaluation. Then a lines status sampling method which combines load rate and non-sequential Monte-Carlo method is proposed to calculating lost load. Finally, the index result which comes from simulation of IEEE39-bus system is verified effective by comparing with power betweenness and improved electric betweenness. The index can provide the reference in power system planning and make relevant accident prevention measures.

articleTitle: A study on IEC CIM DR information modeling based on reverse engineering
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Information model is the core content of IEC International Standard. This paper studied the IEC CIM DR information modeling following the roadmap proposed in the IEC PC118 WG2 preliminary work which was intended to give the overall framework and roadmap of DR International Standard. Firstly, the information model of OpenADR2.0b specification is analyzed. Next, the XMLSchema model was transformed into UML model based on reverse engineering. Then the UML model was supplemented considering the DR requirement and use cases. Finally, a model mapping table and ultimately IEC CIM DR Expansion Model was put forward by comparing, expanding and fusing with the CIM model. The study aims to promote the development of DR International Standard.

articleTitle: A distributed service restoration method in active distribution network based on the contraction of frontiers
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A distributed service restoration method in active distribution network with distributed generators(DG) interconnected is proposed in this paper. According to local topology, switches are divided intogroups to share local measurements. The restoration process is accomplished by the contraction of frontiers. The frontiers are the decision makers of network reconfiguration based on local communication and they will contract step by step until they meet together in a group. During contraction, the load transfer path and islanding separation will be determined. A simulation case of 10kV distribution network with DGs is studied and the whole process of service restoration is analyzed based on DIgSILENT software.

articleTitle: Sequential control of capacitors and taps of distribution network with distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Capacitors and taps of MV distribution systems are usually discrete optimization objects, a control sequence is needed to respond to the randomness of renewable distributed generations (DG), and many existing algorithms are trapped into the dimension house. A control strategy is proposed to minimize network losses, switching costs, generation wastes of DGs and voltage deviation, a weighted sum method is used to reflect the preferences on the mutually conflicting control objectives. For the mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problems of capacitors and taps control, a cooperative particle swarm optimization (Co-PSO) method employing cooperative behavior to significantly improve the optimizing ability is used. Finally, the correctness, convergence and robustness of the proposed algorithm are verified by comparison against existing popular schemes through detailed simulations over 24h on the IEEE 13-bus unbalanced distribution system.

articleTitle: Study of the interaction between photovoltaic inverter and power quality harmonic and its suppression method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the process of photovoltaic (PV) generator was connected to the grid, in order not to affect the power quality of grid, the current harmonic component from PV inverter needs to meet the relevant interconnection standards. This topic put-forwards a method based on impedance analysis, which analyses the harmonic interaction between the photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected inverter and power grid containing background harmonic. The basic reason of harmonic resonance problem caused by grid-connected PV system is duo to the existence of impedance intersection at the point of common connection (PoC), which is determined by the equivalent output impedance of the inverter and the equivalent impedance of the grid. At that intersection point, the sum of the impedance reduced to the minimum value and the current amplitude significantly increased, which leads to the harmonic resonance phenomenon. To analyze this problem, this paper established the NORTON equivalent model of the inverter, developed the expression for the equivalent output impedance of the inverter, and analyzed the reasonable range of the equivalent inverter output impedance based on the maximum limit of photovoltaic (PV) grid harmonic voltage, current and harmonic resonance conditions. On this basis, the PI control and the quasi PR control methods were used respectively to adjust the equivalent output impedance of inverter. Based on the simulation experiment, the equivalent output impedance was effectively suppressed, and the harmonic resonance phenomenon was avoided.

articleTitle: Modeling Simulation and Testing Research on Corona Discharge of Dampers for AC Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Corona performance of hardware fittings is an important consideration in the design and operation of high voltage transmission lines. As the major critical suppression component, the corona discharge characteristics of dampers is directly related to the energy saving and environment protection effect. Simulation by finite element method were discussed to calculate the electric field distribution and research work of corona discharge were experimentally performed respectively both at Wuhan and Tibet. The electric-field distribution and inception voltage characteristic curves of different altitudes were also given in this paper. It indicated that the photon number measured by ultraviolet image apparatus increases exponentially with the applied voltage and the absolute value of correction errors given in this paper based on the simulated altitude test value can be controlled at not more than 5 percent, which can be regarded as theoretical basis for corona discharge, and particularly helpful for design and optimization for dampers of high altitude transmission line.

articleTitle: Comparison of global maximum power point tracking methods under partial shading conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper categorizes existing global maximum power point tracking (GMPPT) methods and makes a comparison of their major characteristics. Our work could be considered as a useful reference to choose a suitable method for specific PV systems.

articleTitle: Study on quality fuzzy synthetic evaluation method for power transformer based on life cycle theory
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power transformer is one of the key equipment in the power grid. Its quality is directly related to the continuous and stable operation of the power system. It is difficult to evaluate the power transformer quality, because of the complex technology, longtime manufacturing cycle, and high fuzzy information. The quality fuzzy synthetic evaluation method for power transformer based on life cycle theory is proposed, which can solve the above problem. The factor set is established, which contains multi-source information and quality defects information. The multi-source information can be classified to manufacturing, manufacturing, installation, commission, and operation stage. The evaluation set is established with four ranks. The membership degree set is determined based on the fuzzy statistical method. The weighting set is calculated based on the Delphi method. At last, the method proposed is verified by the example.

articleTitle: Primary strategy by deloaded Permanent magnet wind generator
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional winds turbine cannot support the frequency stability of the island grid, when using maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control strategy. This paper proposed a method that the load of the grouped wind generators control strategy, control the speed of the rotor to over-speed control condition, achieving the deloaded generator operation when the wind speed is under rate wind speed. When the wind speed is higher than the rated wind speed, combined invariable pitch control with over-speed control to achieve the load reduction. This method provides active backup for the generator in the frequency stability regulation of the island system. Simulation results showed that the load shedding control reduce the fluctuation of the system frequency and stabilized the island operation when the load increasing rapidly.

articleTitle: Preliminary study on architecture of global energy internet standard
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Global Energy Internet (GEI) is the trend of development of the energy industry with broad prospects and potential economic benefits and social benefits in the world. It is crucial to establish the technical standard system of GEI for technology innovation and industrial development. First, technical standard systems and standards at home and abroad have been combed in the field of ultra-high voltage transmission, smart grid and clean energy. Secondly, brief analyses on economic and social benefit have been analyzed for establishment of the GEI standard system. Through the discussion, the content and methodology of GEI standards system are clarified with clear technical courses. Finally, specific suggestions are put forward for application of the GEI standard system, and the study will make a beneficial exploration for the development of GEI.

articleTitle: Analysis on natural contamination characteristics of UHV AC post porcelain insulator
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to study the natural contamination characteristics of UHV post porcelain insulator, we tested pollution severity of post insulator for three years which operated in 1000kV Jindongnan UHV AC substation. According to ESDD and NSDD measurement and pollution composition analysis results, a series influence factor of comparative analysis on natural contamination characteristics were performed on post insulators. Such influence factors include the top surface to bottom surface of insulator shed, the windward side to leeward side of insulator shed, average diameter, long time contamination depositing and etc. The results are as follows: 1) The distribution of pollution matter for 1000kV post porcelain insulator is very uneven. The ESDD ratio of high-voltage end of insulator is 3.4 times severe than other part, and The NSDD ratio is 2.3; 2) The pollution severity measurement value of insulator top surface is higher than bottom surface generally. The ESDD ratio of top surface to bottom surface of insulator(T/B) is 1.8, and the NSDD ratio of top surface to bottom surface of insulator (T/B) is 1.6; 3) The pollution severity measurement value of insulator leeward side is higher than windward side generally. The ESDD ratio of the windward side to leeward side of insulator (W/L) is 0.64, and the NSDD ratio of the windward side to leeward side of insulator (W/L) is 0.55; 4) The saturated ESDD is not proportional to continuous deposition time, but the saturated NSDD is basically proportional to continuous deposition time; 5) The pollution level of insulator has descend trend along with the increase of average diameter; 6) the CaSO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> content of pollution matter is 68%. This work can provide some important references for UHV project external insulation design, product manufacturing, operation and maintenance.

Author Keywords: ESDD (equivalent salt deposit density) and NSDD (non soluble deposit density)
deposition ratio of the top surface to bottom surface of insulator (T/B)
deposition ratio of the windward side to leeward side of insulator (W/L)

articleTitle: Application of SSSC to improve the transmission capability of Tianjin 220kV power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: After introducing the present operation situation of Tianjin power grid, this paper reveals the causes of the limited transmission capacity of total cross-sectional area and the circuitous power flow of the double lines in Tianjin. The development and state-of-art of static synchronous series compensator (SSSC) technology are covered in this paper along with the lines running plan of Tianjin power grid in future. A variety of measures to deal with the limited section of transmission capacity and roundabout power flow are proposed and compared, which draws to a conclusion that SSSC is the optimal solution for improving power grid structure and adjusting regional power flow. Therefore a detailed application scheme of SSSC is proposed subsequently for the 220kV power grid in Tianjin. The electricity compensation amount of SSSC demands in Tianjin area is analyzed theoretically, and three alternative capacity of SSSC under steady state control are proposed. The optimized capacity and location scheme of SSSC are derived with equivalent data of Tianjin power grid, and are presented in a transmission capacity effect table. Considering the N-1 transient stability limit and the line rated current constraints, the compensation capacity and the capacity curve of the cross section are given, which provides the basis for the SSSC scheme of various operation modes in Tianjin power grid. Finally, the validity and rationality of the SSSC application in Tianjin 220kV power grid are verified via the power flow data of BPA.

articleTitle: The typical network scheme of micro-grid based distributed wind-solar-storage systems
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based On The Full Investigation Abroad Micro-Grid Laboratory System And Typical Demonstration Project, Combined With Characteristics Of Micro-Grid And Energy Structure, The Paper Elaborated The Power Mode Of Micro-Grid, Proposed Typical Structure, Which Including Network Topology, Electrical Structure, The Power Supply System (Ac / Dc Power Supply And Three-Phase / Single-Phase Power Supply). Then The Paper Proposed Typical Network Scheme Of 3 Large Categories, 7 Small Types, Which Can Be Applied In Different Areas And Different External Grid. Finally, We Analysis And Applied The Typical Network Scheme By Actual Project.

articleTitle: Adaptability analysis of differential protection for UHV half-wavelength AC transmission line
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Relay protection is one of problems troubling the development of half-wavelength AC transmission technology. This paper modeled the half-wavelength line with the distributed parameter, researched the fault characteristics and the adaptability of phase-splitting steady current differential protection theoretically and through plenty of simulation work, and analyzed its influencing factors from three respects. The result indicates that conventional steady differential protection algorithm is not very suitable for half-wavelength transmission, the sensitivity of middle range is the biggest problem. Then adaptability of zero sequence current differential protection and differential protection based on deviation of power frequency component are researched, the simulation results indicate they have better sensitivity. The research result shows the differential protection can be set as backup protection, and need to coordinate with the quick protection which protect the range close to two ends.

articleTitle: Research on automatic testing based model validation framework for distribution automation system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of energy and information technologies, smart distribution system has become an emerging area for the development of smart grid. Self-healing and active distribution system are the hot research topics of smart distribution network. The Distribution Automation System (DAS) is the fundamental system for integration and realization of such technologies, which integrates computer science, modern communication technologies and distribution automation technologies. The reliability of DAS has an profound influence on the application of emerging smart distribution network. After rigorous testing, DAS itself has been certified and authorized for higher security, reliability. As the model of distribution system evolves frequently, the correctness of the network model will seriously affect the applicability and reliability of distribution automation system. The network model management and validation are the key technologies to improve the reliability of DAS and applicability of advanced applications for smart distribution system. At present, there are relative researches on model validation technologies, such as basic grammar examination, model name and topological relation validation. Although these approaches can improve the automation and reliability level of distribution network model management to a certain extent. However, there are still some shortcomings: lack of automatic verification ways for interactive validation based on both diagram and model for DAS, which is heavily dependent on the system operators and there may be remaining potential security risks; lack of automatic testing tools, which increases the workload for the systematic validation of network model, and reduces efficiency and reliability at the same time. Compared with traditional manual test approach, automatic testing technology utilities emerging test approach to realize fully automatic test or semi automatic testing, which could effective reduce manual intervention, accelerated testing cycle and enhance testing efficiency by reduction of the repetitive and redundant testing process. Besides, with carefully designed test cases, automatic testing technology could guarantee the reliability of complex control system. Automatic test has been applied in the development of modern complex automation system. This paper presents a model validation framework based on automatic testing technology for distribution system. Firstly, an automatic testing framework for network model validation is proposed. Then the procedure and test approach are developed based on the automatic testing framework. The approach proposed in this paper has been applied in a practical distribution automation system. Actual examples are presented to prove that the proposed approach can effectively improve the efficiency of model management and validation for distribution system and greatly reduce the potential model related risks which could otherwise downgrade the reliability and correctness of DAS. The proposed approach could be applied and provide foundation for the further development of smart distribution system.

articleTitle: The research on the on-line and off-line theoretical calculation software of line loss by Guangdong power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper introduces the present progress of the on-line and off-line theoretical calculation software of line loss by Guangdong power grid. Due to the benefit of reducing line loss, to improve distribution line loss management is important. The theoretical calculation model is the base of software, while the practical model is more effective than the theoretical model for engineering application, because the practical model is modified to adapt the demand of Guangdong power grid's data systems. This paper also introduces the data source from the data centres with the development of the practical software. The on-line calculation is feasible if some disadvantages are solved. The suggestions for solving the disadvantages are given, which is the next step to improve the software. The present software is applied effectively in Guangdong power grid includes 19 cities.

articleTitle: A real-time online model of power purchasing and selling based on TMR
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presented a kind of online calculation model for the purchase and sale of electricity business using TMR (Tele-Meter Reading system) real-time production data. The model solved the inconsistent of the data between power purchasing and power selling, and realized the real-time calculation of the margin income among the power grid corporation. Meanwhile, the model discovered the “inventory” problem under the traditional statistical mechanism of power selling. The result of the example shows that this model can calculate the index of power purchasing and selling synchronously. It found “inventory” phenomenon in power selling, and analyzed that the main reason for this phenomenon is due to inconsistent of statistical cycle and management factors.

articleTitle: Effect of polarity reversal time on electric field in converter transformer bushing
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Polarity reversal is a special condition of converter transformer bushing that needs to bear both DC voltage and AC voltage in an instant polarity reversal, and the time of polarity reversal effects the bushing of the electric field distribution simultaneously. The finite element method is used to analyze the ±600kV converter transformer bushing in different polarity reversal time under the condition of electric field distribution, and the change of maximum electric field intensity in different polarity reversal time. Results show that the DC static voltage make free charges accumulation on the surface of solid media to lead to a dramatic change of electric field distribution when the polarity reversal occurs, the faster the voltage reversal change the higher the maximal transient field is. A transient peak value of electric intensity appears in respective epoxy resin and transformer oil after the polarity reversal and the silicon rubber after the polarity reversal.

articleTitle: The analysis of filed intensity on body surface with different entering equal potential working methods
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Most live working projects need lineman enter Equal Potential Working(EPW) for handling, so which method to enter EPW has a significant impact on safety of the lineman. With 220kV cup type tower as objects, the simulation model of the lineman use insulating ladder and hanging basket to enter EPW is established, and filed intensity on body surface is calculated based on finite element method. Simulation results show, when using insulating ladder and hanging basket to enter the side-phase EPW, filed intensity on foot can reach 101.9 kV/m during equal-potential operation, but filed intensity on left and right hand reaches maximum near the tower. Compared with using insulating ladder, the range of filed intensity on different parts of the body with using the hanging basket to enter EPW is smaller, with real benefits to the safety protection in live working on transmission line. When using hanging basket to enter the center-phase EPW, filed intensity on foot can reach 124.2kV/m during equal-potential operation, but filed intensity on head reaches maximum near the tower. This means that, when the safety protection for lineman is evaluated, the process should be considered, rather than during equal-potential operation.

articleTitle: Design and development of a simulation system for smart distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The power system is regarded as the most complex man-made system, and is also a huge system with high security and reliability. With the increasing complexity of the power grid structure and the operation mode of the smart distribution grid, the simulation analysis of the power supply network is becoming more and more important. The current smart distribution grid security analysis, mainly exist in the following three problems: one is that manual process of the typical operation mode costs staff much time; the second is only to check the stability level of power grid by the typical power flow mode and this cannot fully reflect the complex operation of power system; The third is that boundary condition of load level, start-up mode is relatively single, load distribution is also different from the actual operation of the power grid, and calculation of local component overload is often discrepancy with the actual. On the basis of existing achievements, simulation and analysis system in this paper is through the system integration and the new technology further research, 3D visualization display and interactive system for simulating smart distribution grid is designed, including visually exploring the operation mode of the specified boundary condition and safety assessment technology for the specified operation mode etc.

articleTitle: Bi-directional tracing method based on the separation of power supply paths
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the deepening of electric power system reform, accurate physical basis is urgently needed for the research on economic problems, and power flow provides theoretical foundation for the fair and public operation of power market. But most existing tracing methods are based on proportional sharing principle which is difficult to be proved strictly. And the operation parameters of power system change with the states of system, while the intrinsic parameters of power system, such as line impedances, and the network structures are fixed. This paper presents a bi-directional tracing method based on the separation of power supply paths in power grid. Under the premise of known power flow in an AC section and in consideration of the line-to-ground capacitances, this method conducts an equivalent conversion on the system's intrinsic parameters, which cannot merely form the single-power multi-load networks, the single-power single-load networks and the single-load multi-power networks, and can further realize the bi-directional tracing in multi-power multi-load loop networks. Coordinate this method with economic accounting, the profit distribution of the power grid can be computed and revealed.

articleTitle: The research and application of stability control system operated on Qipanjing Industrial Park isolated power system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In recent years, the stability control system not only has been widely used in domestic large power system, regional power grid, new energy systems, and also been successfully applied in abroad, such as southern Kyrgyzstan grid system and Ecuador 230 kV power grid system. The stability control system escorts for the safe and stable operation of the domestic and foreign power grid. With the development of economy, large power grid has reliable power supply, frequency stability, voltage stability advantages, but it can not cover all the electricity demand of the enterprise, which is the reason the isolated power grid exists. The current situation and long term planning in the isolated grid are introduced in Qipanjing Industrial Park in this paper. The characteristics of isolated grid operation and the difficulty of system security control are analyzed. The solution of the stability control system and the engineering application of the system configuration are presented in Qipanjing isolated grid. An important reference is provided for the wide application and design of the stability control device in the isolated network system in the future.

articleTitle: Research on power distribution system of green well-off villages and small towns in east China
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power distribution system design of the green well-off villages and small towns in East China is studied in this paper. Electricity load forecasting, power distribution and energy-saving systems design, effect of distributed energy accessing to the villages and small towns grid are studied. Finally, the advices are given on the power distribution system design of the green well-off villages and small towns.

Author Keywords: green well-off villages and small towns

articleTitle: The architecture and technology of demand response within Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the demand response project and Energy Internet, meanwhile makes a brief introduction of them. We also innovative summed up the demand response use case in the energy network to clarify their relationship. With analyzing current energy network concept, we summarize architecture and technology.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of dynamic reactive voltage in wind power cluster system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the sake of studying the stability of dynamical voltage when large-scale wind farms cluster join up, this paper established the doubly-fed induction generators (DFIGs), which mainly considered the fluctuation of wind power. Based on Hopf bifurcation, it's proposed that the dynamic analysis method is combined with traditional Continuation Power Flow and Time Domain Analysis. The proposed method analyses and compares the dynamic response properties and voltage control capability of the wind cable set area between different power compensation devices. The simulation results of a certain wind farm cluster in Hami, Xinjiang Province indicate that traditional static analysis results are much more optimistic compared with the proposed method. Considering the multiple time scale and the operating characteristics of cluster system, the proposed dynamic analytical method can more accurately calculate wind farm voltage stability limit.

articleTitle: Design of building integrated photovoltaic based on Ecotect analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering the rapid increasing of building integrated photovoltaic, a design method based on Ecotect Analysis is proposed in this article. Modeling analysis of the building's sunshine condition is processed to get the annual total solar radiation and sunshine hours per unit area of the building facade and roof. According to the analysis result, the setting position of the photovoltaic system can be determined and the annual generation capacity of the photovoltaic system can be estimated, and all of these can provide references for the design of building integrated photovoltaic. In addition, several high voltage grid connected schemes are given analyzing the Hangzhou south railway station case.

articleTitle: A new kind integrated environment control plan for the secondary equipment terminal box in substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is a harsh operating environment for the outdoor substation secondary equipment terminal box in its long-term worktime. Condensation often can be found inside it due to the climatic cause. This may lead to insulation performance of the secondary equipment degrading or lead to the devices rusting, molding and even more explosive precedent, resulting in secondary equipment damage, DC grounding, structural jamming, protection device tripping mistake and other issues, bring a serious threat to the safe operation of the power grid. By studying the operating environment of outdoor secondary equipment terminal box in substation, and analyzing the defects of existing control method, a new kind of integrated control plan is proposed in the paper, which can provide a theoretical basis for the substation to ensure the stable and reliable operation of the secondary terminal box, and to protect the safe operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: A Big Data analysis based new method for power grid dispatch and control training simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the construction of Global Energy Internet, power system has the trend of the scale expansion, the network complexity, the equipment precision and data massivication. Substation automation and power grid equipment level are continuously improved as well, but the traditional power grid dispatcher training simulation system (DTS) has been unable to adapt to the increasingly precise secondary electric equipment simulation requirements. A Big Data analysis based new method for power grid dispatch and control training simulation first uses ETL tool to extract and standardization process the data of secondary equipment and signals they emit. Then do the equipment type association rules mining to equipment and signal data after preprocessing, and correlation matching in accordance with association rules. At last, classified equipment data will be divided and load according to the condition of area, substation, bay and voltage grade, and drive the equipment detailed simulation logic. The method based on the actual operation monitoring data, uses semantic analysis and association rule technology and ETL and ElasticSearch tools to implement the grid primary and secondary equipment signal extraction, parsing, mining and load, so that operation monitoring equipment detailed simulation logic can be driven and the authenticity, accuracy, adaptability and precision of simulation can be improved.

articleTitle: Research and application of key technologies for high-capacity microwave oversea transmission
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In high-capacity microwave oversea transmission, the fading which caused by the multipath propagation interference, effects the microwave signal badly. Based on the analysis of key technology for high-capacity microwave oversea transmission, this paper studies a solution adopting siting design, dual spatial diversity and multiple frequency diversity, as well as antenna Hi-Lo method together. The solution is applied on microwave oversea long-distance transmission between Shantou and Nanao and improves the performance successfully.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling strategy of active distribution system using improved harmony search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The optimization schedule strategy of the active distribution system (ADS) is the core technology required to actively manage distributed energy resources (DERs). This paper establishes an optimal scheduling model for the ADS, whose blurring purposes are voltage quality improvement and operation cost reduction under control variables of different kinds of distributed generators (DGs). In addition, the improved harmony search (IHS) algorithm is proposed to produce the optimal scheduling strategy of the ADS. The case study in different parameters and different algorithms demonstrates the validity of the proposed optimal scheduling model and the IHS algorithm for ADS.

articleTitle: Risky bilateral contract for distributed wind energy in smart microgrid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel risky bilateral contract for trading distributed wind energy with flexible load in smart microgrid. Due to the randomness of wind energy production, wind energy can barely be traded at a pre-determined quantity. While in smart grid, load demand of electricity consumer can be easily adjusted (reduced or shifted) without decreasing its satisfaction, which can be utilized for integration of distributed wind energy. As a result, the wind power producer benefits from fewer penalties caused by less deviation between real-time traded quantity and pre-offered one. The electricity consumer, on the other hand, benefits from a decreased electricity bills without reducing its satisfaction. We take into account distributed wind energy, three categories of household appliances, and batteries. The Nash bargaining theory is used to determine the price of risky bilateral contract. Case studies are then conducted to demonstrate the efficiency of the risky bilateral contract.

articleTitle: An on-line fault diagnosis method for power rectifier device based on fault current characteristic
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current characteristics of short circuit and open circuit of single thyristor as well as the current characteristics of open circuit of AC line, and comes up with a new on-line fault diagnosis method for the rectifier device. For the single thyristor short circuit, the theoretical DC value calculated using the measured AC current will be greater than the real-time DC value measured, and the DC components of the fault phase and non-fault phase are opposite in sign, which can be used to locate the fault thyristor. In the open circuit situation, if the DC component value of current calculated by slide window is continually larger than the threshold value, it is single thyristor open circuit, and the fault thyristor can be identified by the sign of fault phase DC component; if the DC component value of current firstly increases above a certain value and then reduces to 0, the fault can be identified as AC line open circuit, and the fault phase can be located with the help of minimum amplitude of the fundamental wave. This method takes both open circuit and short circuit faults into consideration, and it can also be applied to the fault diagnosis of multiple parallel rectifiers. Simulation results show that the fault identification speeds are 1ms, 10ms, and 2ms in thyristor short circuit, thyristor open circuit, and AC line open circuit cases respectively, and that the fault location speeds are 20ms, 30ms, and 22ms correspondingly. The method can diagnose the faults of single element in a rectifier quickly and accurately, which can effectively prevent the expanding of fault and improve the repair efficiency. So it has theoretical and practical value.

Author Keywords: single phase AC line open circuit

articleTitle: The research about the principle of interface aging between housing and core of composite insulators
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The one of the important reason which lead to power line dropped is interface aging. According to the core fracture of composite insulator on the 500kV power line of CSPG and the temperature abnormal rise of composite insulators which number are 25, 38, and 42 on No. 5123 tower XuYang power line of Shanghai power company of SGCC, these composite insulators had been done test about each appearance. The results of test show that the hydrophobicity is well and the material of silicon shed isn't aging. But there are some humps on the surface of housing and erosion on the interface between whole housing and core of composite insulators. The penetrant (1%fushine) appear on the interface between housing and core. The erosion had extended from high voltage to the middle part of composite insulator. One of the reasons about erosion on the interface between Housing and core of composite insulators is mold releasing agent seeping from core. The crack between housing and core has been made by the mold releasing agent and the partial discharge has appeared. The water which were absorbed on the production of core has taken part in electrochemical reaction lead to erosion.

articleTitle: An automatic-optimization-decoupling-technology-based network partitioning methodology for electromagnetic transient simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Network partitioning is widely used in power system simulation to accelerate simulation process. Due to uneven or non-optimize network partitioning and extension of the simulation process caused by manual network partitioning in the past work, an automatic network partitioning methodology based on automatic optimization decoupling technology (AODT) is developed in this study for electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation in large power networks. The methodology is based on the combination of the long transmission line decoupling algorithm and the node-splitting algorithm, and the number of the subnetworks to be divided can be either specified or unspecified. The methodology will be tested on a real power network using Advanced Digital Power System Simulator (ADPSS).

articleTitle: Research on fault diagnosis method of transformer winding loosing
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Latent winding loosing fault will occur in power transformer after several short circuit current (I) impact, which will affect the operation condition of transformer. In order to research diagnosis method of transformer winding loosing fault, aiming at a 35kV transformer, the vibration mathematic model of transformer winding is established in this paper. The monitor platform on vibration signals is built. The 85% and 100% short circuit current (I) impact experiments are made. Load experiment is made before and after short circuit current (I) impact on the transformer, and the vibration signals of winding are tested. The energy entropy method is adopted in order to calculate features, and winding loosing fault is diagnosed. Experimental conclusions indicate that change rates of feature are 22% and 56% when winding loosing fault occurs, and diagnosis results agree with the actual condition of transformer, which calibrates the availability of the diagnosis method.

articleTitle: Current condition of liaoning wind power industry and its impacts on power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the installed capacity of Liaoning's wind power reaching 8 million kW, wind turbines' daily maximum load and generating capacity repeatedly set new records now and then, which have some impacts on Liaoning's power grid in terms of peak regulation, voltage stability and frequency control. This paper starts from the characteristics of wind power and wind resource in Liaoning province. It brings forward some concrete measures in light of the operating conditions of Liaoning Power grid, which guarantee operational security and stability of the power grid while improving the grid's wind power accommodation capacity as much as possible.

articleTitle: Research and application of distributed power load regulation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power, its scale and level have been greatly improved. How to increase power grid's accommodation capability of wind power has been the prominent problem increasingly. A kind of distributed power load adjusting system based on cloud platform is put forward from the point of smart grid's operation. The system consists of cloud terminal, cloud server and App client part. The cloud terminal's connections and control mode and control strategy of cloud server are designed and researched. If the system is used in a Power Grid Corp, the demand of 700MW is increased by controlling the air-conditioning and electric water heater with the cloud terminal. The simulation results show that the Power Grid Corporation's accommodation capability of wind power increase 2.16%. The application if this system is not only convenient for the user to control electric equipment and save electricity, but also provides the solutions for peak load shifting and wind power accommodation. Fatherly it provides new measures for the development of energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: A new protection scheme for boundary load switch in distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A new protection scheme for boundary load switch, implemented by using only transient zero-mode current, is proposed in the paper. For neutral indirectly grounded system, the traditional boundary load switch, which is based on power frequency components, is difficult to determine the direction of single-phase-to-earth fault. In this paper, the transient zero-mode current has been analyzed for single-phase-to-earth fault in neutral indirectly grounded system. It concludes that there is significant difference in magnitude of transient currents between the load side fault and source side fault. Load side fault and source side fault can be distinguished by comparing the magnitude of measured transient zero-mode current with the setting threshold. The simulation tests associated with the typical distribution system in EMTP-ATP validate the protection scheme and algorithm for boundary load switch can work properly.

articleTitle: Optimal operation research of distribution network with high penetration of dispersed wind farm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Environmental pollution and energy shortage have resulted in a recent strong demand for distribution networks to accept renewable clean energy. As an important part of distributed generations, DWP wind power (DWP) with its clean and flexible characteristics has been an important focus of domestic and foreign entities. In this paper, high penetration optimal operation model for DWP wind farm (DWF) was established with taking the maximum wind power real-time penetration as the objective function, and the reactive power output of wind farms was considered to regulate the voltage. The harmonic search algorithm was used to solve the model, simulation test with IEEE33 node system model was carried out, and the results show that the established optimization model as well as its solution strategy can make full use of the reactive power output of wind farms to achieve the maximum wind power consumption.

articleTitle: Structural analyses and optimizations of fixed PV mount
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: PV mount is support of PV modules. In a photovoltaic plant, the amount of PV mounts is considerable. Therefore, few optimization in a unit of PV mount results in significant economic benefits. Also a proper mount will be conducive to construction and maintenance. However, the special literatures are rare until now. In this manuscript, three types of fixed PV mounts are presented firstly, and their characteristics under real load are summed up. It is observed that two-column mount with rigid base (TCMR) is economic and will simplify construction if pile foundation can be used. Furthermore, detailed study of TCMR is carried out. Parametric analyses on TCMR shows that interval of seat for beam is vital for force in beam and suggested layout of purlin and main beam is presented. Brace between beam and column can effectively reduce force in beam and column and is recommended to apply in PV mount.

articleTitle: Optimized configuration method of capacitor type device against DC magnetic bias with the least device quantity
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to prevent transformer magnetic bias made by HVDC monopolar operation, for the time being, the devices to against DC magnetic bias are mainly installed in several stages. At first, DC current is obtained by simulation or measure value in substation. Second, the places to deploy the device to against DC bias are decided based on that if DC current beyond the standard in the spot. Then, DC current is measured in the operation to judge following device placement scheme. Repeat steps upside, the device to defense DC magnetic bias will be set into the necessary place and the DC current will be restrained lower than standard ultimately. In this way, it is a long cycle and hard work to achieve the whole process. Furthermore, the comprehensive solution of device placement can't be obtained only according to the existing engineering measurement value or simple simulation calculation based on fixed operation condition. The paper proposes a simple and comprehensive method to complete device configuration. In each procedure, for placement of devices to against DC magnetic bias, DC current distribution in various AC power grid operation modes are calculated with PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software, then, different device placement solutions may derived. The paper establishes an AC power grid simulation model for actual AC system adjacent to DC grounded pole, then, a voltage source is accessed to transformer neutral point as an equivalent circuit to DC current influence. finally, DC current distribution in AC system can be calculated. A set of configuration rules is proposed in the paper. Based on the rules, there are several initial configuration solutions of device against DC magnetic bias. Subsequently, the initial solution can be refined as follows: the equivalent circuit of capacity type device to against DC magnetic can be accessed to transformer neutral point, repeat the process of calculating DC current and accessing the device equivalent circuit against DC bias. As a conclusion, there are several solutions obtained. An estimate scheme is set up to evaluate the solutions proposed. The evaluation goal is to make the number of the device installment least, and the final optimization result is given. The study shows that: the solution proposes in the paper utilizes simulation method, which can give an integrative and economic scheme. Also, it can be easily realized.

articleTitle: Harmonic current source based on fractional order FIR repetitive control
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Harmonic current sources (HCS) that can provide variable-frequency and amplitude output current are widely used in automatic testing of the electrical equipments. Digital repetitive control (RC) can achieve zero steady-state error tracking of any periodic signal with known integer period, hence, it's suitable for harmonic control, but it usually fails to provide precise tracking of variable frequency periodical waveform with fractional time delay. In this paper, a fraction order delay FIR filter based on Lagrange interpolation is used to approximate the factional delay items in RC. The design criteria is summarized in a simple form, and the stability of Fractional order RC is also analyzed in this paper, experiments is conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed FORC strategy.

articleTitle: A novel real-time estimation method for fault current of inverter-interfaced distributed generations T connecting in feeder
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The acquisition for fault currents of gridconnected distributed generations is of great significance to improve the performance of protection in distribution network. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel real-time estimation method for fault currents of distributed generations. Considering the low voltage ride through (LVRT) control strategy, the fault equivalent model of inverter-interfaced distributed generation (IIDG) is established firstly. Besides, a method for calculating the positive-sequence voltage at the point of common coupling (PCC) is put forward. Then, based on the electric information including current and voltage at both sides of the feeder, a real time estimation method for fault current of IIDGs is proposed. The accuracy of the proposed method is verified by a 10kV distribution network with multi-IIDGs established in PSCAD/EMTDC at last.

articleTitle: Layered-price model of resident demand response
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes a Layered-Price Model (LPM) of resident demand response to maximize the profit of the utility company and minimize the payment bills of all users. The LPM is composed of two models naming LPM-I and LPM-II. LPM-I is a Stackelberg game model established between utility company and Household Energy Control Center (HECC), and LPM-II is a cooperative game model established between HECC and house appliances. The utility company determines multiple flexible pricing strategies through the proposed LPM to all categories of users. According to the multiple pricing strategies, HECC could automatically choose the optimal price strategy and determine the energy schedules of appliances with the aim to minimize their payment bills. The equilibrium of the demand response based on LPM is proved to exist and be unique. Simulation results show that the LPM and the multiple pricing strategies lead to significant reduction not only in users' payment bills but also in the decreasing valley-to-peak in daily load. Therefore, the proposed LPM of demand response is beneficial for both users and utility company.

articleTitle: Partial discharge acoustic location measurement based on image fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) is one of the major causes of insulation degradation/ageing in power equipment, it is significant to detect PD accurately for guarantee equipment's safety and reliable operation. To achieve an accurate PD monitoring and PD location, a new type of PD on-line monitoring system was presented in this paper. The PD phenomena taking place of equipment's surface and/or interface was detected by 32*32 ultrasonic array sensors, which is capable of collecting and processing multi-sensor synchronized ultrasonic signal came from PD taking place. Based on Acoustic Doppler theory, the measured sound intensity is decided by received the number of entire waves in unit time, which produced by PD. According to the measured sound intensity sequence, a mapping relationship in plane-coordinate between PD event and its location system could be established. Furthermore, 2D image of object is taken by HD camera in this system, the PD location visualization could be achieved by digital image fusion. The system can intuitively show the discharge location in the image and its status in the development and changes, timely find power equipment's failure and has extensive application value.

articleTitle: A combined clustering algorithm for the classification of electrical equipment's family defects
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Electrical equipment's family defects are common deficiencies usually caused by some particular factors such as the material of equipment and the process of design and manufacture. In order to classify these defect data, the paper proposes a clustering algorithm combines PAM and FCM. The method uses PAM firstly to generate the cluster prototypes with the goal of lowering the initial randomness of FCM, and then it runs FCM to obtain the final clustering results. These steps are expected to ensure the accuracy of the algorithm and take less iteration. Experiments using electrical equipment' s family defects data-sets to test and verify the accuracy and efficiency of the algorithm are discussed. The results show that the combination methods used in this paper provide a better performance in both accuracy and run time when compared with traditional analysis approach like hierarchical clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Transformation method of heterogeneous common information models
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to promote information integration between smart distribution systems, the Common Information Model(CIM) is now widely used as a common semantic basis. With the updating process of CIM, the heterogeneous problem caused by different versions has become a serious impediment to information exchange. Therefore, this paper proposes a transformation method of heterogeneous Common Information Models based on model mapping. First, XML Path Language (XPath) is used to address CIM model mapping pairs, thereby generating an Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation(XSLT) script for model data transformation. Then, all nodes in the original model are matched and converted corresponding to the new version of the model. In this way, parsing and transformation of heterogeneous models of smart distribution network can be completed. IEEE 13 node feeder model is chosen as an example to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method, the conversion result turns out to be precise and valid.

articleTitle: An economy and reliability comprehensive assessment method of distribution network connection modes
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Comparison of the connection modes is one of the most important questions in the planning and maintaining of the urban distribution networks.
