Considering the characteristic of the actual distribution networks, this paper creates a load distribution model in which considers load density as the main indicator, considers the constraints such as current limit and voltage drop limit of the branches, and sets up unified reliability and economy indicators. Based on the above studies, this paper establishes an economy and reliability comprehensive assessment method which is suitable for the analysis of the distribution network connection modes. Then, this paper does a comparison of different connection modes in overhead lines and cable lines using the assessment method, and gets comparison results under different line lengths and different load density situation.

articleTitle: Analysis of blackout character under the typical grid structure
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the development of the scale of domestic power grid interconnection, reasonable evaluation of the grid structure become an important problem to be solved in the power industry. In this paper, power failure model under different network structures was set up, from the perspective of self-organization critical features of power system to measure the security of the power grid structure. Power-law index which indicates the potential risk of loss of blackout was put forward. Using the proposed indicator on the Shandong power grid, the results show that grid structure directly affects the safe and stable operation of power system. And the scale of potential power outage is closely related to the compact degree of network connection.

articleTitle: Exploration of simplified modeling method applied to VSC-HVDC converter
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The switching action in PWM converters is high nonlinear and consuming expensive computing resources severely. These factors limit large-scale system simulation such as renewable energy integration. This paper proposes simplified modeling method that regards the converter as a dual-port controlled power conversion element by considering its function and controlled characteristic. The controlled characteristic and control strategy are included in the simplified model except for the law of conservation of energy. The simulation results of simplified model from transient state to steady state are in good agreement with the results of detailed model, which shows the simplified model is feasible and has high accuracy. What is more important is that the method is easy to understand and the amount of calculation is dropped greatly by ignoring the internal complex structure of switching process.

articleTitle: Thermal manager of anti-freezing building in HVDC substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper discusses the thermal management of the structure design of an anti-freezing building in an HVDC substation. The CFD simulation has been carried out under the condition of natural wind velocity with the influence of the air cooler. The result shows that the hot air reflux ratio is proportional to natural wind velocity when the anti-freezing building has a certain height; the hot air reflux ratio is proportional to the anti-freezing building height when the natural wind is in a certain velocity. Through detailed cost analysis, the most optimal height of anti-freezing building is about 6 meter. Based on the thermal analysis, rational design of anti-freezing building can effectively prevent hot air recirculation, and the air cooler inlet temperature decreases 3°C.

articleTitle: Analysis on selecting application of energy-saving conductors in overhead transmission line construction
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Comparing with common aluminium conductor steel reinforced(ACSR) with equal outside diameter, the DC resistance of energy-saving conductor is lower, So applying it in transmission lines can enhance conductivity and decrease line losses. This paper introduces the characters of three new energy-saving conductors, analyzing the technical characteristics and economic characteristics of energy-saving conductor and common aluminium conductor steel reinforced. A general method of selecting energy-saving conductors is proposed binding with the project.

articleTitle: Measures against voltage sags & cases from on-site data
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Voltage sags are inevitable phenomenon in power system operation. Firstly impacts of voltage sags on sensitive loads in thermal power plants, petrochemical and coal chemical industry, chemical fiber industry and semiconductor industry are discussed. Then, treatment measures of voltage sag are discussed from power supply side and user side, including reducing the occurrence of line faults, reducing fault clearing time, changing power supply pattern, installing mitigating devices, adopting to AC&DC power supply scheme, and improving anti-interference performance, etc. Based on the on-site data from voltage sag treatment center of Golden Cooperate Company, cases of the above solutions are presented and analysised. Finally, treatment strategy for both power plants and other industrial users are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on an improved fuzzy detecting algorithm of harmonic and reactive-power signals for the shunt APF
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The harmonic and reactive current detection and analysis is a prerequisite to achieve the control of power quality, the accurate detection of harmonic and reactive current can provide a good basis for harmonic control. this paper proposes an improved harmonic and reactive-power current detection technique based on the fuzzy controller method combined with particle swarm optimization (PSO) for the APF, the PSO can enlarge the value range of the adjustment factor of signal parameters in the Fuzzy algorithm, the harmonic and reactive-power components can be detected fast and accurately. The proposed method has some advantages such as: This method omits the vector transform and low-pass filter, and the hardware cost of this method is low for no PLL circuit. Simulation and experimental results are utilized to prove that the proposed algorithm is simple and effective.

articleTitle: Vacuum disconnector and continuous vacuum monitoring on a 2SIS medium voltage distribution system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An extended summary is given about aspects dealing with the application of vacuum disconnectors. Discussed are normative requirements, dielectric considerations in new and aged condition, failure mode analysis in case of loss of vacuum and vacuum monitoring. The influence of vacuum monitoring on the availability of the disconnector application in “open ring” and “closed ring” distribution networks as well as in the fast transfer switch application is discussed. It is shown that the continuous vacuum monitor improves the availability of the disconnector function to 99.99998 %.

articleTitle: A fast simulation model of PMSG with asymmetric control during an asymmetric grid fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a fast simulation method of PMSG, which adopts positive and negative sequence current separate control strategy during an asymmetric grid fault. Based on analysis of fault characteristics, the asymmetric control strategy is developed in PSCAD, aiming to alleviate the adverse effects on converter and grid during an asymmetric grid fault. Separate positive and negative sequence current and lock the phase respectively with SPLL method, then control each component in a closed loop by means of feedback decoupling, thus restraining ripple of DC bus voltage and second harmonic are realized. Furthermore, a simplified method based on remaining control and principle of energy balance is proposed. Simulation shows the rapidity and validity of the method, providing theoretical support for equivalent modeling of large-scaled direct-drive wind farm.

articleTitle: Research on fault detection method of grounding grids based on surface potential distribution
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Grounding grids play a very important role for the safe operation of the substation. When grounding grids fault occurred, resulted in abnormal surface potential or uneven distribution, and that will be a serious threat to personnel and equipment. Considering the influences of leakage current and displacement current in the soil, establish mathematical model of transient electric field. Combining with the grounding grids of 800kV GIS substation, I established three dimensional electric field model of grounding grids using finite element method and obtained surface potential distribution of three-dimensional figure. And then I analyze the buried depth, soil resistivity, and other factors of grounding grids on the surface potential distribution, using the method of transient wave injection. At last, I calculated the surface potential distribution of the grounding grids in the case of fault and non-fault, proposed a method of grounding grids fault detection based on surface potential distribution features. Research shows that: the influence rule of the buried depth of grounding grids to the surface potential distribution of conductor and grids center are different. The surface potential increased gradually with the increase of soil resistivity. It is possible to detect grounding grids fault according to the characteristics of the surface potential distribution.

articleTitle: Influence of lamp placement on power saving efficiency for indoor visible light communication systems
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper studies the influences of lamp placement on power saving for indoor visible light communication systems. Four typical schemes are considered. By modeling the pulse waveform design of the communication system as a linear programming problem, power consumption is minimized for each scheme. Numerical results show that lamp placement is important for indoor visible light communication systems. When the power consumed by the controlling circuits is negligible, higher power saving efficiency can be obtained by dividing the LEDs into more uniformly spaced units each having a local controlling circuit while the total number of LEDs is kept unchanged.

articleTitle: Studies on the internal fault simulations of powerformer
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper discusses the set-up of a mathematical model of powerformer, a new type of synchronous machine, for analyzing internal phase and ground faults in stator windings. The method employs a direct phase representation considering the cable capacitance. To effectively implement the internal fault simulation, the magnetic axis locations of fault parts are arranged appropriately. Besides, all machine windings supposed to be sinusoidally distributed in space and the system is magnetically linear. With above-mentioned assumptions, the current equivalent equations, voltage equivalent equations and the rotor motion equations are formed and combined to implement the fault simulations. The analysis presented in this paper has been implemented as computer software package PFSIM. Simulation results showing the fault currents, during a single phase to ground fault, a two phase to ground fault and a phase to phase fault, are presented. With the data generated by this internal fault simulation model, the protection scheme used for powerformer can be validated and improved accordingly.

articleTitle: A method of determining emergency reserve in a system with multiple HVDCs feed-in
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Emergency reserve (ER) is set to deal with the power imbalance events, such as forced outage of units or HVDCs, to guarantee the reliability of a power system. The reserve capacity would affect both the reliability and economy of a power system that should be set coordinately. In this paper, the mechanism of ER and the main factors affecting the ER capacity requirement in a regional power grid with multiple HVDCs are analyzed. The process to calculate the minimal value of the emergency reserve capacity is designed based on the reliability indexes of LOLP10 and EPNS10. And from the viewpoint of economy the calculation method of the maximum capacity of ER is proposed, all of the generation cost, the reserve cost, and the load loss cost are taken into account. Finally, effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper is demonstrated by examples based on the data of a regional power grid with 7 HVDCs feed-in.

articleTitle: Calculation of the discharging parameters of SF6/N2 mixtures
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: For the study of the discharge parameters characteristics of different proportions of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture, thus the reason of synergistic effect was analyzed from the perspective of inter-particle interaction. With the `two-term' approximation to solve the Boltzmann equation, the discharge parameters of different mixing ratio of the SF6/N2 mixtures can be acquired including the electron energies distribution function (EEDF), the equivalent ionization coefficient (α/N) and the equivalent adsorption coefficient (η/N), as well as the equivalent effective ionization coefficient (α-η)/N, and the effectiveness of the calculation method and results are proved by comparing with other experimental data. The results showed that: With the reduced electric field E/N is increased, the EEDF in the low energy region (<;8eV) decreases, while the EEDF in the high energy region (>8eV) increases, and the phenomenon of EEDF dips exists near electron energy of 3eV that phenomenon will become more obvious with the increasing of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, and this phenomenon does not exist in pure SF6 molecules; as the E/N increases, the equivalent ionization coefficient a/N has a significant increase, while the adsorption coefficient η /N is reduced, and the equivalent effective ionization reaction coefficient (α-η) / N also increases; with the percentage of SF6 increasing, the equivalent critical breakdown field strength (E / N)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">cr</sub> increases significantly.

articleTitle: Comparison of epoxy and thermoplastic embedded pole regarding reliability and cost in air insulated switchgear
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Recently embedded Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCB) with thermoplastic have been introduced on the market. The substitution of epoxy resin by thermoplastic is of concern in ambient air insulated switchgear solutions. This paper reports a study performed for VCB embedded poles with two technologies: epoxy resin and engineering thermoplastic PA66. A comparison is made between both technologies reagarding reliability, long life tracking withstand, cost and environmental impact by performing a multi-criteria life cycle assessment.

articleTitle: A study on UHF partial discharge online monitoring system verification methods
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the purpose of performing field verification on 1100kv GIS UHF partial discharge sensors, the author utilized the steep pulse signal injection method and the transfer characteristic experimental method to perform this study. The results indicate that both of the methods have feasibility for UHF partial discharge internal sensor field verification, and have very high relevance. The study obtained the attenuation characteristics of UHF internal sensors with different GIS structures, and provides advice on how to optimize the field verification of UHF sensors.

articleTitle: Study on the cooperative relationship of electrical parameters in a steady-state distribution network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the inner relationships of distribution network's power flow data. In this work, a circuit model is first established, based on an actual steady-state grid and its operation data. Then analytical expressions of electrical parameters' transmission relationships, the matching relationships of electrical parameters and their transmission law are analyzed. The results are encouraging, and provide a new way to analyze power flow and to solve the problem of data error in state estimation.

articleTitle: Analysis on outdoor test of PV module's I-V characters
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Outdoor test approach of PV modules is different from the one in laboratory and necessary for the performance evaluating of PV modules in outdoor working environment. There are mainly three kind outdoor test approaches of PV modules, offline test approach, online test approach and mobile laboratory approach. The principle and application of the three test approaches are analyzed, and the test accuracy comparison are carried out through test results on same one PV module.

articleTitle: A grid adaptability test method eliminating cable impacts for offshore wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of grid-connected offshore wind turbines (GCOWT), a grid adaptability testing of it should be performed. After analyzing the difference between onshore and offshore wind turbine testing and modeling the system, detailed spectral analysis based on AC cables is made to derive how cable parameters affect the resonances. A modification method based on resonance frequency shifting (RFS) by changing offshore compensation device parameters is proposed. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the harmonics distortion at high voltage side of GCOWT transformer satisfies the testing standards when applying RFS.

articleTitle: The method of harmonic analysis and suppression of medium frequency electric furnace
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To resolve the harmonics pollution of medium frequency electric furnace in a steelwork, power quality monitoring is conducted for power source in steelwork and substation. By the analysis of test data, the 11th, 13th, 17th harmonic are the main reason for the pollution of power quality. The effective measures were put forward for users to prevent harmonics pollution, Effectiveness of the measures was verified by the comparison data before and after treatment.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis method of high voltage circuit breakers based on wavelet packet decomposition and ELM
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to improve the method of the existing circuit breaker fault diagnosis, based on the existing shortcomings of mechanical fault diagnosis, a new method for fault diagnosis is proposed based on wavelet packet decomposition and ELM, and feasible diagnostic steps and analysis are also introduced. It uses wavelet packet decomposition extract characteristic vector of combines vibration and acoustic. Then, the characteristic vectors are used to build the input vector of ELM to conduct fault diagnosis. Experiments show that the proposed method is effective to diagnose the mechanical faults of high voltage circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Analysis of identification and treatment methods of arc suppression coil fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The faults of arc suppression coil appearing often in the course of work are described and the nature of the faults is divided in this article. The different faults as general failure, arc suppression coil abnormal failures, malfunctions and the arc suppression coil disable failure are discussed and studied, and the appropriate treatment scientifically are given.

articleTitle: Research on application of video anomaly detection in power grid unified video monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the promotion and application of power grid unified video monitoring platform, the amounts of forward video devices accessing to the platform and the business application systems supported by the platform are increasing. Traditional monitoring technology lagging today cannot meet the requirements of real-time and intelligent monitoring in power production, safeguard and other fields due to defects such as relying on human intervention, unsatisfying monitoring efficiency and overwhelming all-weather workloads on monitoring personnel. This paper expounds the design and development of an intelligent video analysis and management system supported by video anomaly detection technology, based on the existing video resources of the unified video monitoring platform. The system is capable of real-time analysis on abnormal events in videos, also with real-time processing capability and high detection accuracy rate according to the test results, and thus reliable for safe operation of the electric power system.

articleTitle: A new way to express the multi-infeed HVDC system and interaction factor
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In multi-infeed HVDC system, the interactions and influences between DC systems and AC systems are complex as the electrical distances among DC converter stations are relatively short. Multi-infeed interaction factor (MIIF) can effectively reflect the interaction among DC systems. However, present methods to obtain the interaction factors are through simulations which are unclear in physical meaning. The paper theoretically analyzes recent analytical expressions based on impedance matrix to calculate the MIIF and proposes a new way to express the MIIF based on the admittance matrix. From both expressions, it is clear that how the equivalent impedance of AC system and coupling impedance can affect MIIF. PSCAD simulations validate the effectiveness and the correctness of the proposed expressions and some useful conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Test and simulation research of security and stability control technology of UHVDC based on real-time digital simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The RTDS simulation models for Lingzhou to Shaoxing(Lingshao) ±800kV UHVDC transmission system are set up, meanwhile, through simulating the 3-level functions of the master control, pole control, and valve control, the real-time digital simulation research and closed loop testing platform for the security and stability control devices is built, without access to actual UHVDC control and protection system, which saves the testing cost and time. Based on the research and testing platform, the security and stability control strategies for AC and DC system of the Lingshao UHVDC system are tested, which in the end verifies the correctness of the control strategies and the accuracy of the simulation models.

articleTitle: 1 Year report & results on 10kV multi-chamber arresters field test in Guangdong Province, China
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper represents describes method and results of field test on 10kV Multi Chamber Arresters (MCA) in high lightning density area. Application of these devices allows to protect durably and efficiently overhead power lines rated at 10 kV from induced overvoltage.

articleTitle: Control strategy of STATCOM for asymmetrical load compensation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to compensate the asymmetrical load currents by star-connected cascade STATCOM, a novel control strategy combining individual phase instantaneous control with zero-sequence voltage injection is proposed, which splits the whole STATCOM into three single phase STATCOMs and proper control strategy is implemented. Besides, an improved deadbeat current tracking method is also presented to improve the dynamic characteristics of current. The effectiveness of this control algorithm is well validated by prototype experimental results.

articleTitle: Analysis on the allowed output of distribution generation considering distribution network static security
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Position and capacity of the distributed generations (DG) have a direct impact on static security of the distribution network. A method to calculating maximum allowed output of DG for each node using voltage sensitivity and current sensitivity based on linearized power equations is proposed, and it reduces the computation obviously. The calculation results are analysised. The method of installing DSTATCOM to improve maximum allowed power of DG is analysised. The accuracy and effectiveness of this method is tested by IEEE-33 system.

articleTitle: Introduction of EcoGrid and its enlightenment to China
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a demonstration project of real-time power market named EcoGrid is introduced. First of all, the background, the main aims and the new concept of the real-time market of the EcoGrid in Bornholm are briefly introduced. Then, the participators from the customer side are classified into 5 types according to the different controlling style. Moreover, the behaviors and functions of the actors, including the distributed energy resources (DERs), the demand responses (DRs) and the market operators, are summarized. Next, the implementation stages, the evaluation results and the roadmap of EcoGrid are drawn. Finally, the implementation experiences and enlightenments to China are proposed from the technology and management aspects. The theoretical analysis in this paper will promote the construction of Energy Internet in China under the circumstance of the power market reforms.

articleTitle: Substation planning method for active distribution network in the context of energy internet
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Developing a low-carbon power system is critical and fundamental to cope with the challenges of global warming, in which transmission network will play a key role. Based on the background of low-carbon economy, the paper put forward a substation planning method taking account of the access of large scale distributed generations (DGs). With the continuous increase of DGs' permeability, the capacity value of DG was more and more important. The capacity value of DG can be defined as DG credit capacity (CC) which can be evaluated according to the principle that the reliability index was unchanged before and after DGs' access. The weighted Voronoi diagram method was used in the work of substation planning considered CC. A low-carbon evaluation objective function was added to the substation planning model to assess the contribution to low carbon economy.

articleTitle: Study on diagnostic method of aging 10kV XLPE cable
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the widespread use of XLPE cables, the faults caused by the cable indicate the increasing trend of multiple and frequency, its running state has a direct relationship with reliability of power system. By surveying 10kVXLPE cables' status of Guangzhou city, we find that aging is the main factor causing the insulation breakdown. And then a 10-meter cable out of service was accelerated aging under overload current and overvoltage in the lab. After that XLPE samples cut from the cable insulation before and after the accelerated aging experiment separately, were analyzed through OIT (oxygen induction time) test, crystallinity, content of O element. The results, compared between XLPE samples, suggest that overload and overvoltage can shorten the OIT and increase the crystallinity degree of XLPE and its content of O element, which are the characteristic parameters to assess the cable aging. Finally, a case of cable ageing diagnosis, combining with 0.1 Hz tan6 detecting, was given to illustrate how this diagnostic method of 10kV XLPE cable works efficiently in Guangzhou networks.

articleTitle: Mutual impedance parameter modeling and accurate location algorithm of angled space crossed transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: On the account of more and more inevitable scene of angled space crossed transmission line in real project, classical distribution parameter model is no longer applicable, and coupling effect between two lines needs to be reconsidered. This paper popularizes mutual impedance from limited conductor to angled space crossed lines, and analyses the characteristic of mutual impedance coefficient along the line. Based on the segmented nominal-π line model, in which mutual impedance of each section is obtained by Neuman's Integral, the location equation is derived by utilizing the feature that the voltages calculated from two sides are equal at the fault point. Simulations in PSCAD compare the differences of fault-location results between in the condition of considering and ignoring coupling effect of space crossed transmission lines. The calculation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm has higher accuracy, and is not affected by fault types.

articleTitle: The proper transmission efficiency evaluation of the grid with consideration of its security constraints
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The first priority in the process of power grid construction, development and operation is to maintain a high operating efficiency while the security and reliability of the grid is guaranteed, but there are often constraints between them. An index system reflecting both grid security and efficiency condition is established, including N-1 index, blackout risk index, as well as efficiency indexes of transmission cable and transformer, thus formed the foundation for multi-perspective evaluation of grid operation level; the integrated grid security and efficiency analysis model is established to preliminarily confirm the relationship and variation pattern between those two aspects; the evaluation method of the rationality of transmission efficiency is proposed, which takes security constraints into consideration, and a reasonable transmission efficiency result of the power grid is calculated to provide guidance for the decision-making of power grid planning; the rationality and validity of the comprehensive model and evaluation method are verified by selecting the regional power grid. The research result can be used for the diagnosis of transmission efficiency level of various power grids, thus providing reference for reasonable operation of the grid.

articleTitle: Experiment on breakdown characteristics of SF6/CF4 gas mixtures in short gap
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, researches were carried on the breakdown characteristics of short gap SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/ CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, under the flat plate and needle board electrodes, the breakdown voltage of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> gas mixetures was measured when partial pressure ratio of SF6 is from 0% to 100% and the pressure is from 0.1MPa to 0.4MPa, the effects of the gas pressure and other factors on insulation performance of SF6 and its mixed gas were studied. The electron temperature, electron density and other parameters were measured by spectrometer when mixed gas was completely brokenkdown, the correspondence between the micro parameters of gas and macroscopic parameters such as pressure, temperature was established, and the breakdown characteristics of gas were analyzed. The study shows that when ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SF6</sub> is 20%, the breakdown voltage of gas can reach to 82.26kV under 0.35MPa which equals to pure SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas under 0.25MPa. When ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SF6</sub> is 40%, the breakdown voltage of the gas in 0.4MPa can reach 106.8kV, which equals to the pure SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas under 0.3MPa. Under 0.1MPa-0.4MPa, the electron temperature gradually decreases with the increase of the gas pressure, and gradually increases with the increase of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> partial pressure ratio in the mixed gas. In 0.1MPa, when ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SF6</sub> is 20%, the electron temperature is 20280K, when ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SF6</sub> is 80%, the electron temperature reach to 50120K. The electron number density increases with the increase of the gas pressure, and gradually decreases with the increase of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> partial pressure ratio in the mixed gas. In 0.1MPa, when ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SF6</sub> is 20%, the electron number density is 3.54×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, when ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">SF6</sub> is 80%, the electron number density is 3.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. The experimental results can provide a basis for the study of the variation of the conductivity and other physical parameters of the mixed gas plasma.

articleTitle: Comparison and analysis of protection latency time between intelligent and traditional substations
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the protection latency time between traditional and intelligent substations are compared and analyzed. In traditional substation, the analog information such as current and voltage are tranmitted to the protection and control devices via electric cable, while in intelligent substation the introduction of digital protection devices and intelligent substation prolong the protection time, which brings safe threaten to the cutoff of power system fault. The compositions of operation latency time are compared in each link and two major different time latency links are analyzed in details, and the mechanism of time latency is investigated and the effective meausures to reduce the protection latency time are proposed. Finally, the experiment of protection time comparison between two is carried out and the results prove the validity of theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Regulatory approach for reliability management
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Distribution is the interface between power supply and end-users. International experience shows that majority of power supply interruptions can directly or indirectly be traced to the distribute network. More than ever before, reliability of power supply has become one of key concerns of electric power system and customers. One the one hand, as a regulated business, distribution network operators (DSOs) have the obligation on quality of power supply, while on the other hand, costs of energy non-supplied push costumers particularly from industry and commercial sectors for higher reliability. Various methods have been implemented in order to improve and maintain reliability of power supply across different jurisdictions and DSOs. This paper analyses and synthesizes the regulatory frameworks in Europe, the US and Australia and relevant practices of selected distribution networks on reliability management with an aim shedding lights on effective distribution network performance management and regulation in China.

articleTitle: Capacity credit evaluation of distributed generations and analysis of its influence factors
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the penetration of renewable DGs in the distribution system is ever increasing, their capacity value can no longer be overlooked in the distribution system expansion planning and operation. In order to support the development of distributed renewable resources and better utilize them in the distribution network, a credit scheme needs to be developed. In this paper, a Monte-Carlo simulation based method is proposed to evaluate the capacity credit of DGs. This paper first defines the capacity credit of DGs using ELCC and then proper index for reliability equivalence is selected. Based on this, a Monte-Carlo simulation method is adopted to compute the reliability of the distribution system. Then, the capacity credit of DGs is calculated by Secant Method. The validity of the technique proposed in this paper is testified using an example distribution system. Further, the influencing factors of DG capacity credit are analyzed comprehensively, including load amount, DG composition, and load composition and so on.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional assessment of the developing situation of provincial electricity market considering the external economic factors
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In the face of the dynamic and uncertain influence of the external economic environment, in order to correctly grasp the development trend and law of electricity market, a variety of factors in the external environment should be synthetically analyzed. The paper, based on the thought of dimension reduction in the many indicators of external economic environment, establishes a quantitative model for evaluating the developing situation of provincial electricity market. Through the seasonally adjusted and standardized processing of raw data, the data can reflect the real law. Besides that, it uses methods to do dimension reduction in the economic indicators. Finally, the model respectively is used in the dimensions of industries and cities, which could determine the electricity prosperous level of industries and cities. Through analyzing their changing trends, the model could provide some guidance for the future policies in industrial adjustment and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Study on SVG plus FC allocation optimization by considering reactive load fluctuation coefficients and probabilistic analysis of compensating capacity
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Traditional reactive compensation capacity design of power grids and the proportional allocation strategy of dynamic reactive compensation SVG(static var compensator) plus FC (fixed capacitor) are lack of effective planning, which always relies on engineering experience only. A method allocating the ratio and capacities of dynamic reactive compensation and traditional capacitor compensation was proposed, in which met the requirements of voltage quality and system economy with tracking load fluctuation. In this method, optimal reactive power divided point (RPDP) strategy for reducing transmission power losses was used to determine the capacity of total reactive compensation, which amended by the confidence intervals analysis of daily reactive load curve in different power system operation modes. Next, the allocation ratio of SVG and FC defined by the reactive load fluctuation coefficients and investment economy factor of these reactive compensating installations was given in the final optimization model which consider about the system investment and voltage deviation. An actual grid network was used as a test case, and the model was solved based on Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO). The result proves the feasibility and validity of the method proposed.

articleTitle: An overview of research on affecting factors of distribution network reliability
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Reliability is an important content for the evaluation of distribution network's power supply capacity. With the increasing construction of the distribution network, the continuous developing of distribution automation technology and the constantly emerging of distributed power supply, the traditional reliability evaluation system cannot satisfy the demand of distribution network development. Considering the factors that affect the distribution network reliability evaluation, the state of distribution network reliability evaluation is analyzed by grid structure, distribution automation and distributed generation. Finally, the problems to be further researched in future are proposed. It can help with the establishing of reliability evaluation system that adapt to distribution network development.

articleTitle: IEEE1888-based auto-DR deployment and communication process
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: IEEE1888 is a new intelligent energy standard in recent years, which is suitable to use in industries, buildings, parks and other fields. This paper proposes an IEEE1888-based auto-DR deployment scheme. The functional components of DR load aggregation layer and communication process in this deployment scheme are analyzed in this paper. Then an example of smart electricity usage community is described at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: DIFA topology distributed configuration based on the adjacency of switches
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As the increasing requirement of power supply reliability, multi-contact distribution network is more and more widely used. However, the application of distributed intelligent feeder automation (DIFA) in multi-contact distribution network will face the problem of topology identification. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a topology distributed configuration method based on topology unit. In the method, we take each smart terminal unit (STU) as the basic unit to store topology information, which is represented by the adjacency of switches. And the nodes information in topology structure is generated by the configuration information automatically. Each STU only stores the topology information of its managing area, called topology unit information, and obtains the topology unit information in other STU by peer-to-peer network. Finally, we can get the topology structure of desired region by the connection of topology units. The method has the advantages of high maintenance efficiency and fast generation speed, which can lay the foundation for the application of DIFA in multi-contact distribution network.

articleTitle: Discussion of power transmission ability increasing method based on power electronic technology
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to make full use of the original transmission corridor, improving transmission ability of power network, a new idea for increasing the power transmission ability has been put forward which is based on the VSC technology. Firstly, the existing problems of urban power network are analyzed. Then according to the characteristics of cable line in urban power network, the technology scheme of the original AC transmission corridor power transmission ability increasing is proposed, and the operation control mode and technical characteristics of the system are described. At the last, the simulation of the above technology scheme is carried out, the results show that the proposed scheme can improve the transmission capacity of the original AC transmission line, which can be improved by 1.58 times.

articleTitle: A data-driven technique for investment strategy of distribution systems upgrade
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents an investment funds allocation model for distribution system upgrade based on data-driven technique. First, a bilevel programming evaluation system is established, which takes upgrade measures as element layer indices and comprehensive evaluation parameters as performance layer indices. In order to mine the correlation between these indices, enormous indices data generated by a virtual distribution system program is analyzed through artificial neutral network (ANN). Second, the trained ANN is embedded in the distribution network upgrade optimization model, which is solved by genetic algorithm (GA). Finally, effectiveness and feasibility of model are verified by a city distribution system.

articleTitle: A grey correlation and topsis based evaluation method on main electric connection of new generation smart substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the construction of new generation smart substation, traditional main electric connection of substation also need to be impoved, evaluation work should change accordingly. To evaluate the main electric connection of new generation smart substation, a method based on a Grey Correlation and Topsis is proposed. By overcoming shortcomings that traditional Topsis method cannot reflect the situational changes of data sequence, This method systematically combine the Topsis and grey correlation constructing a new kind of relative degree index as a standard of evaluating. The reliability and the advancement of the method is verified in the relevant case.

articleTitle: Assessment method of grid-connection performance for distributed voltage source converters
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Considering grid-connected performance under various typical working conditions, a grid-connected performance assessment method based on measured data is proposed in this paper. First, Three level index system of grid-connected performance evaluation is established, the acquisition condition and data processing method of the measured data are analyzed. Then, the calculation and feature extraction methods of each individual index under multi conditions are presented. And then using analytic hierarchy process, weight of the same level of indicators and the relationship between the upper and lower levels, based on improved membership function, fuzzy mathematical model for grid-connected performance indexes of distributed converters is built. Finally, the grid-connected performance of 132kW distributed voltage source converters in Nanjing is evaluated, the effectiveness and practicality of method presented in this paper are verified.

articleTitle: A pre-study on operating model and supporting technology for new electricity retail policy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In order to adapt the new policy of the retail side reform, the novel operating models of power retail are proposed for Chinese electricity retailing side reform based on analysis of different power marketing systems in the world. The key technologies for the distribution and utility integrating system are discussed to support the electricity retailing company, which include the planning & design, optimal operation, device management & maintenance, and electricity trade service. According to the new electricity retail policy and development of energy technologies, the distribution and utilization integrating support system is proposed in this paper as the new trend and effective solution for the future electricity retail, which is called the Regional Energy Internet (REI). Both the architecture and the profile of the REI are described to show the preliminary concept of supporting platform for the competitive electricity retail, including SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) platform and advanced applications.

articleTitle: PluriHis : A highly scalable scheme of distributed historical data storage and access
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Overwhelmed by the massive volume of production data, traditional RDBMS-based historical storage solutions are going burst. A distributed data storage and access mechanism incorporating NoSQL designs is presented trying to solve the problem. With the orchestration of master nodes(2 machines, active-standby), real-time data incoming are routed to be cached on selected nodes to fulfill the load balancing requirements. Real-time data collected will pass two layers of local cache before finally dumped by each PluriHis node. Client modules on PluriHis nodes run in P2P mode and will actually register the name/location of a data point only after the corresponding request is successfully serviced. Master nodes will route all the data requests to the relevant PluriHis nodes and data query and retrieval is supported by a NFS-like network file sharing protocol. As Indicated by the benchmark results recorded, PluriHis is a highly capable candidate in implementing the next generation SCADA system with big data support.

articleTitle: Determining distribution network power supply partition zone by rolling-ball model
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the power distribution network, This paper will be equivalent to power supply partition model of distribution network and lightning protection design rolling-ball model. The boundary is determined by equaling to optional power point and lightning point; The radius is determined by equaling to transmission line model and rolling-ball method. Load point will be seen as air terminals and the zone that power supply is not guaranteed could be determined after the load power supply can meet the premise. The final power supply partition zone is defined based on the power supply guarantee rate under the different lightning flashes, and the specific location of the power supply is fixed by refining power boundary range. At last, an actual example is used to verify the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Research on distribution system planning theoryunder the trend of load-supply integration
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a new distribution system planning theory under the trend of load-supply integration is explored. First, this paper analyzes the development trends and characteristics of future distribution system, and points out that the integration of load-supply will be the most important feature of future distribution system. The feature blurred the boundaries between the load and the power supply, makes energy complementary strengths fuller, power system operation more flexible, electricity balance more timely. The feature also hasa major impact on distribution system planning. Boundary conditions of planning become less clear and more uncertainty, optional schemes varied. This paper analyzes the basic theory of traditional distribution network planning methodology and inadaptability in the situation of integration of load-supply. Further, this paper proposes a new construction idea of theoretical system of distribution system planning under the situation of load-supply integration from the five areas of objective, requirements, core, key points and process. Distribution system planning objective will change from single, short-term to multidimensional, long-term. The requirements of long-term system reliability, economy and asset life-cycle management will be higher. Planning accuracy requirements will further increase and be closer to the operational requirements. Accurate planning will establish load models of the load-supply integration, carry out characterization analysis and distribution network system calculation to search limit states and weak links of system operation. Core of distribution system planning is using divided-period probabilistic production simulation of power system based on synchronization of load and supply to replace the traditional method of power balance. Simulation results contain system operation reliability analysis of different types of typical periods and operational state, and iterative optimization with all distributed power supply, micro-grid, active load of planning area and external power exchange. Overall operating cost index obtained from optimization analysis supply the basis for scheme comparison and selection. Planning key is to improve the network adaptability, to achieve the maximum range of plugging and playing of distributed power, energy storing device and various control units. Planning process shall include repeated iterative optimization of source, load, transmission system and distribution system.

articleTitle: The research and optimum design for vacuum circuit breaker with spring mechanism
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The contact welding phenomenon of the vacuum interrupter occurs frequently when the vacuum circuit breaker closing short circuit current. It cause the circuit breaker refused tripping or vacuum interrupter burst, which belongs to the serious accident. A lot of research work about contact welding phenomenon has been done in universities and companies at home and abroad. The reason in the vacuum interrupter contact welding after analysis can from different aspects: such as contact materials, closing speed, contact pressure, contact closing bounce etc. Phase selection can avoid the vacuum interrupter contact welding when it closes the bigger inrush current. But there have no research and optimize match about the institutions of the output characteristics and load characteristic, so as to improve the capability of anti fusion welding in the domestic and foreign reference. This article was based on test results, and put forward the output characteristic of the institutions and the load characteristics matching problem is another important influence factor of fusion welding, and analyzed the influence factors of the output characteristics of spring mechanism in vacuum circuit breaker. Finding that the output characteristics of vacuum circuit breaker are seriously affected by the track of the cam contour and the angles between four-bar linkage of driving mechanism. According to three different output characteristics, opening and closing test of short-circuit current respectively for vacuum circuit breaker, rated voltage: 40.5 kV, rated current: 31.5 kA, short-circuit close current: 80 kA. Contact spring pressure: 3200 N ~ 3400 N. Figure 1 shows the different four-bar linkage structures and output characteristics of the cam. Curve 1 for the four-bar rod Angle is α1. 1 # cam structure, Curve 2 for the four-bar rod Angle is α2, 1 # cam structure, Curve 3 for the four-bar rod Angle is α2, 2# cam structure, spring mechanism relative to the output of the circuit breaker shaft torque curve.

articleTitle: Based on Sugeno fuzzy integral combined multi-parameter partial discharge diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Affected with testing equipment, testing environment, Single partial discharge detection method, Anti-jamming capability poor. This paper presents a multi-parametric method for partial discharge diagnosis, First, extract the high-frequency discharge signals, UHF, Ultrasonic Information Feature, Proposed graph-based method for high-frequency current discharge signals in high-frequency component is analyzed, PSO proposed variation of ultrasonic components for analysis, Neural network algorithm for special high-frequency component is analyzed, By constructing fuzzy measure, Fuzzy Integral Calculation, Data fusion of multiple classifiers, Improve diagnostic accuracy.

articleTitle: A magnitude-phase detection method for grid-connected PCC of distributed generation systems based on sequence decoupling
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: It is a precondition of riding through the grid faults for distributed generation systems that the magnitude/phase information of voltages or currents at the grid-connected point of common coupling (PCC) must be acquired precisely, so that the control subsystem of the distribution systems could tackle the faults. However, the conventional three-phase software phase-locked loop (SPLL), which adopted PI control method and is widely used for the magnitude-phase detection, had a low speed of dynamic response affected by negative-sequence and harmonic components, so that it could not exactly acquire the magnitude/phase information of fundamental positive-sequence component. This paper proposes a novel three-phase magnitude-phase detection method based on double dq synchronous reference frame. The proposed method can decouple the positive dq and negative dq sequences and detect the magnitudes/ phases of fundamental positive-sequence component and negative-sequence component of three-phase voltages or currents. The simulation results verify that the proposed method overcomes the shortcoming of conventional three-phase SPLL and tracks accurately the magnitude/phase of the fundamental positive-sequence voltage under bad harmonic condition. The proposed method can suppress odd harmonic propagation and has a higher detecting precision. Thus, it can be widely used in the three-phase power electronics equipment.

articleTitle: Discussion of application about using of big data technology in harmonic monitoring platform
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: At present, several provinces' power supply companies have established harmonic monitoring platform in China, by real-time monitoring the voltage and current of power grid, then upload these data to the main station to analyze and settle. The platform can collect about 1 TB(1TB=1000GB) data every day[12], these data contain all the indexes of power quality, but we can only use this platform to do some basal data analysis work, but not processing analysis with multi-indexes, so that it does not show strong supporting effort to the power grid operation. With the development of energy internet and the third industry, more and more unstructured data are impacting the power grid operation, how to make better use of big data technology to deal with the data from monitoring platform has became the focus of the power grid company. In this paper, some introduces of contents and characteristics of harmonic real-time monitoring platform and big data technology has been made, by comparing the way of using and settling data of platform to the big data technology, meanwhile by combining with the characteristics of power quality data, we analyze the combination of the two prospects. At last, the development direction of the advanced application for the harmonic line monitoring system is discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on information fusion method of distribution equipment condition comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposes an information fusion method which is suitable for distribution equipment condition comprehensive evaluation. In view of the characteristics such as distribution equipment condition has complex information source, multiple types of information and different data format, different sources of data features are excavated. Combining with the particularity of distribution equipment condition evaluation and the applicability of different hierarchical information fusion method, an information fusion model for distribution equipment condition comprehensive evaluation is built, meanwhile the corresponding information fusion method is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on equivalent energy storage of cascade reservoirs for wind power accommodation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With the increasing of wind power installed capacity, power peak-load regulation has become main restriction for wind power accommodation. With an aim at this problem, this paper suggests a novel method for solving wind power accommodation. Firstly, digging the inverse peak-load regulation capacity of cascade reservoirs, using adjustable cascade reservoirs capacity realizes an aim, when renewable energy surplus, hydro-plants station output is lower, and when renewable energy shortage, hydro-plants station output is higher. And then, a short-term programming formulation of the wind power maximum accommodation is built to realize an optimization dispatch of power system, where cascade reservoirs operation condition constrain is considered. Finally, this paper takes Gansu province as an example to analyze and verify this method.

articleTitle: Object-oriented data center for integrated wide area protection and control
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper firstly reviews the development history of power system protection, especially the wide area protection and control trending to integration in smart grid. It also descripts the features of adaptability and coordination in the integrated wide area protection control system. This multi-levels system is composed of the local intelligent electronic device, the high-speed communication network, the integrated wide area protection and control. One of the key element is the data center at the wide area level. The data center is an information platform for receiving and storing and sharing the power grid information. Based on the IEC 61850 standards, the paper mainly descripts a scheme of object-oriented data center. The scheme is about the object-oriented dynamic data stream layout by using the model files. For the latency requirements about off-line analysis process and real-time data serving, the data center is designed as a multi-levels storage system. It achieves the following goals: wide applicability, easy expansion and high performance to support information platform for integrated wide area protection and control system.

Author Keywords: Integrated wide area protection and control

articleTitle: Research on the way of power plant and substation's basic data regulation to improve the qualification rate of power system state estimation in HeBei power network
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The qualification rate of power system state estimation has become an important assessment indicator of power grid operation in regional power grid. In this paper, combined with the operation of the state estimation software in Hebei power grid, the influence factors of the state estimation's qualification rate is analyzed. The improvement measures to improve state estimation's qualification rate is studied. The basic data regulation measures of power plant and substation is strengthened. And the family-defects regulation of the main integrated automation companies has developed.

articleTitle: Influence factors analysis about terminal voltage of wind turbine when single phase grounding fault occurs
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The stator of the doubly fed induction generator is directly connected to the power grid, which is very sensitive to the disturbance of power grid. Wind turbine will take off the network when grid voltage drops because of single-phase fault. It will seriously impact on safe operation of power grid. This paper introduces the requirement of low voltage ride through performance of wind turbine and the effect of power grid fault on the operation of wind turbine generator. Based on the fault component analysis method, the influence factors of the single phase voltage sag of the system are analyzed. The simulation model is built on the PSCAD/EMTDC and the analysis results are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the structure optimization of distribution network in Shanghai considering reliability and economy
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Power supply reliability refers to the ability of grid on continuous power supply to users. It is a comprehensive embodiment of structure, technology, equipment, and management level. The optimization of the grid structure is studied in this paper, based on the current situations and prospects of long-term. Combining with the higher and lower voltage, both economy and reliability are taking into account. The recommended power supply structure is proposed based on the reliability quantitative analysis and technical economic comparison of typical wiring, to meet the construction requirements in all kinds of power supply areas, as well as the demands for reliable electricity in the economic and social development. Here, this structure refers to abundant power supply capacity, strong grid structure, harmonious development, reliable and flexible operation, reasonable return on investment, and integrated planning.

articleTitle: Study on power generation of PV station under shadow effect of ultra high voltage tower
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a photovoltaic station which local in Yancheng, Jiangsu province with installed capacity 19MW as an example to analysis the output of PV station which effect by the shadow of (ultra high voltage) UHV tower. Firstly, the model of UHV tower is established, the shadow range of UHV tower on winter solstice day is calculation according to local latitude and longitude information combined with the method of sun position calculation. Secondly, according to the location of UHV tower placed in PV station and the number of UHV tower, the range of UHV tower shadow which effect the PV station is analyzed. Based on these analysis, the change of annual power generation of PV station which before and after the effect of UHV tower shadow is simulated. The results shows that, this PV station which installed capacity is 19MW will be loss 139593kWh power generation per year by the effected of UHV tower shadow. The simulation results can provide some suggestions for the PV station and UHV optimization design.

Index Terms: Energy In The Form Of Heat

articleTitle: Detection of 3P voltage fluctuation in wind farm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Wind shear, tower shadow, and yaw error can produce 3P voltage fluctuation in P.C.C., and then influence on sensitive loads widely. Equal interval analytical mode decomposition (EIAMD) and Hilbert transform are used for detection of 3P voltage fluctuation. The natures of Hilbert transform, frequency distinguish ability, and voltage fluctuation radios have discussed to improve the speed and accuracy of calculation. The theoretical findings are substantiated by simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: Research on the load management and assessment system for the high energy-consuming enterprises based on key index data analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: According to the electrical characteristics of high energy-consuming enterprises and their management requirements, gateway real-time power demand, power factor, load rate and electricity consumption are selected as the key index data for load management, and a load management system is developed using these index data. On the secondary data integration, the electricity monitoring data and the electricity consumption data were gathered into a unified platform, which provides real-time monitoring of electricity workshop, threshold crossing alert, subentry statistical analysis, comprehensive ranking and management evaluation function. Ranking in the calculation of each power plant workshop, using a weighted sum of sub-margin approach, and the establishment by AHP evaluation model by three sub-indices, the top layer is the decision-making layer, the intermediate one is a layer of the guidelines, and the lowermost one is the solution layer. The goal of decision-making layer is to reduce the enterprise power business costs, the guidelines for the intermediate layer include reducing maximum demand value, improving power factor value assessment, reducing the average tariff, and reducing electricity fees during an assessment cycle, and the solution layer need to achieve the goals of the upper layers by the management of the electricity fees, load rate, power factor, power demand, and the average load. Using the system, the management department of the enterprises can make summary statistics by electricity index data, and at the end of the exam period, evaluation and reward will be executed according to the ranking result. This system can gradually improve the employee energy-saving awareness and power efficiency, which can reduce electricity costs for the enterprises.

articleTitle: Research of reducing the secondary loop voltage drop in TV
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The secondary loop voltage drop in voltage transformer(TV) directly influence the accuracy of metering. We start with the main problem and cause analysis of the secondary loop voltage drop, and then present seven kinds of method with which can reduce the secondary loop voltage drop, finally make a field test and summary about them. The Automatic Tracking and Compensating Method and the Fiber Optical Transmission Method are priority recommended among all the seven kinds of method.

articleTitle: Modeling and application of power grid dispatching operation risk consequences
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Dispatching operation in modern power grid has the complexity and uncertainty, which makes the traditional dispatching mode based on experience of dispatchers face severe test. In this paper, risk consequences calculation is introduced to large-scale power grid dispatching operation. For the various operation steps in dispatching order, the concepts of operation state and operation developing state are put forward, and corresponding calculation model is established. In terms of assessment indices, an index system including heavy-load, power limit exceeding of control section, voltage violation and loss of load is used to describe power grid dispatching operation risk. On this basis, normalization and commensurability are applied to evaluate the risk consequences of each operation step and of the whole dispatching order. Finally, the proposed model is used to assess operation risk of Guangdong Power Grid. The results show that the proposed model is suitable for real large-scale power grid. During risk assessment, high-risk operation steps of the dispatching order can be found out, which provides an efficient identification method to discover potential risk from formulating dispatching order at the beginning of power grid dispatching. It is showed that this proposed model can lay an important theoretical foundation for the dispatching operation risk assessment system in the future. And the research results in this paper have already been applied in the Guangdong Power Grid.

articleTitle: Design of discrete event based OpenADR simulation platform for load dispatching
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, we have studied the architecture of the most recent OpenADR specification. Based on the profile specification, we have presented a novel simulation platform that integrated both the information and electric characters. It can be used as a strategies simulation of the training tools for power dispatcher. There are several essential parts in our simulation platform that is the interaction between different entities, the modeling of each OpenADR node, and the finite state machine. Finally, the simulation platform is shown can further work is concluded to be integrated in this simulation platform, more advanced application modules are expected to improve the function of this platform.

articleTitle: Simulation research for suppressing gyroscopic effect of maglev flywheel energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The maglev flywheel energy storage system is a kind of high efficiency ways for energy storage and conversion. It has many advantages such as zero-millisecond switching time, high efficiency, high energy storage density, low maintenance costs, long life-time, and no pollution. It has been applied widely. Since the flywheel energy storage characteristics, the moment of inertia ratio between pole and equatorial is large, gyroscopic effect in high speed greatly influence the rigid modes frequencies and stability of the flywheel rotor, the traditional decentralized PID control has been unable to meet the requirements. The cross-feedback algorithm is used to suppress the effect of the gyroscopic effect of magnetic levitation system which simulated by MATLAB. From simulation results, the measurement error of rotor speed, the size of attenuation factor and the delay time of control system will influent the suppression effect of gyroscopic effect with the cross feedback control algorithm, the ranges of influence factors is cleared with simulation to ensure the effectiveness of cross-feedback control algorithm, and laid the foundation for further engineering application.

articleTitle: The study on the application of the unified power flow controller for Shanghai grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, the basic principle and current application and development of the unified power flow controller (UPFC) are briefly introduced. After that, the necessity to set the UPFC on the zhayun-2268 line is elaborated from the aspects of transfer capacity of power imported channels and increasement of voltage stability. At last, some key problems encountered, such as the UPFC's locating and sizing, the main electrical connections, the control strategy and the protection coordination are further illustrated.

articleTitle: Analysis on the whole process management system of the secondary system in smart substation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The construction of the smart substation is the developmental trend of the electric power system, and the smart substation is a important link of the smart substation. The paper proposes a practical scheme of building the whole process management system of the secondary system in smart substation. The establishment in the management system of the secondary system professional model which manages four roles such as personal, engineering, equipment and materials in building and administration smart substation, also establish the professional process of the management system of the secondary system. Some key technologies such as the technology of graphic display and the consistency check of Model file design are analyzed. Then we create a engineering pilot that execute in building new 220 kV Gaohua smart substation in Shenyang. So we realize management and control such as the construction process of the smart substation, device and configuration file in smart substation. We can establish duty of each department, make sure job content in each link and consistency of Model file design.

articleTitle: SSR characteristics study considering DFIGs at different locations in large wind farm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Addressing the Subsynchronous resonance(SSR) problem in doubly-fed induction generator(DFIG) based wind farm and series-compensated network, most of the literatures use single DFIG to represent the entire wind farm. This paper divides the entire wind farm into two wind turbine clusters according to the different locations and each wind turbine cluster is represented by a DFIG. Small-signal model of the two-DFIG system is built and SSR characteristics under different wind speeds, output power allocation ratios and cable impedances are studied. The impact levels on SSR characteristics of two different locations wind turbine clusters are compared. Result shows that the DFIG with short electrical distance from bus-bar has greater influence level than that with long distance. System has higher level of stability with more output power allocated to DFIG that is far from bus-bar. System stability and resonant frequency increase as the impedance of cables between wind turbine cluster and bus-bar increases. The mechanisms of different impact level by DFIGs at different locations are theoretically analyzed.
