publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An analytical expression of the stator current of DFIG and the flux of stator and rotor is obtained, by analyzing the transient model of DFIG (Doubly-fed Induction Generator). And the analytical expression of the active power of DFIG and the rotor reaction flux is obtained by vector analysis of stator current and rotor flux. Then, this paper infers the analytical expression of the active power output and the stator short circuit current. Next, the instantaneous trip protection action value of the access point downstream must be adjusted in real time with the different output of the DFIG wind field is analyzed. Thus, this paper proposes the adaptive instantaneous trip protection scheme based on the action value to be adjusted in real time with the different output of the wind field. Referring to the parameters of the first exemplary project in which the dispersed wind power is integrated into the 10kV local power grid, the active distribution network simulation model is established in PSCAD/EMTDC, with numerous simulation tests carried out for line protection. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively solve the sensitivity and selectivity issues of the instantaneous trip protection action of the wind field access point downstream in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Assessment of line loss rate in low-voltage transformer district based on BP network model optimized by LM algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A novel method of assessing line loss rate in transformer district is presented and realized by programming, which is BP network model based on LM algorithm. The pretreatment of samples by K-Means clustering algorithm according to electric characteristics solves the numerical dispersion of line loss rate in transformer district. On this basis, each class is trained by BP network optimized by LM algorithm. BP network is adopted to map complex non-linear relation between line loss rate and electric characteristic parameters. Variation of transformer district line loss rate is obtained under different grid structures and load characteristic parameters. 601 transformer districts in a region as an example, simulation and calculation are performed to verify the accuracy of the proposed method. This method has the advantages of fast convergence and high accuracy, compared to standard BP neural network.

articleTitle: Survivability assessment of power grid based on modified centrality
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: An approach related to the survivability assessment of each substation/bus in power grid is presented. It is derived from the graph-theoretic centrality whose basic concept, however, is modified by incorporating the practical electrical properties. The simulation reveals that the modified centrality indices can identify the ability of each substation/bus in power grid to survive when subjected to contingency such as load integration. The proposed approach to evaluate the survivability of the individual substation/bus in particular may benefit power grid planning and dispatch to determine the proper access point for the new load and operation pattern.

articleTitle: Microgrid operational benefits distribution based on the theory of cooperative game
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To solve the internal distribution problem of microgrid operation benefit, a benefit distribution method based on the economic operation and cooperative game theory is proposed, which can satisfy individual rationality and global efficiency. It can be used to estimate value of various participants in microgrid and provide references for payment and settlement inside microgrid as well. The influence of characteristics of participants on the result of the distribution is analyzed through a typical example. Results indicates that the method proposed in this paper can realize rational distribution of microgrid benefit, and it could also guide and stimulate participants to improve own characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on power energy storage allocation of weak power distribution grid with high-density distributed generation integration
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The weak power distribution grid with high-density distributed generation is different from traditional distribution grid in voltage stability, which is easy to cause inaccurate estimation of stability margin in extreme running-mode verification. The local absorption of optical record will cause excess energy storage capacity thus impacts the operating economy. In this paper, an analysis method of stability margin with input variable based on power distribution grid was proposed. In addition, through the adaptive genetic algorithm of quantum code, the voltage deviation of all nodes were qualified with the power-type battery optimization of each node in the weak power grid under the fracture surface of the input variable. Then effectiveness of the method was verified with the IEEE36 node example.

Author Keywords: adaptive genetic algorithm of quantum code

articleTitle: The power system risk assessment under rainfall weather and subsequent geological disasters
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The heavy rainfall weather often results in subsequent geological hazards and causes severe transmission line outage. In this paper, risk assessment model is established to evaluate related impacts against power grid. Specifically, transmission line failure probability is quantitatively modeled for risk evaluation based on precipitation and transmission tower deflection and non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation and optimal load shedding model. The interior point method and risk indicators are used for system risk calculation. The simulation examples of a Western China regional power grid show that the power system risk gradually increases with the expanded scope and increases severity of the hazards, which is in accordance with the real situation. The proposed methodology is very valuable in guiding transmission line construction and maintenance in tough weather and geological regions and is capable of substantial improvement of power supply quality.

articleTitle: The research of substation battery on-line inspection and repair system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Every year substations have a large number of discarded battery. These discarded battery increase environment handle stress and pollute groundwater resources, causing huge economic waste. This paper, based on the important role of storage battery in substation DC system, analysis the current status of battery operation, maintenance and the using of online monitoring device, propose substation battery on-line inspection, repair system. The system has daily maintenance detection, online charging and discharging, online to sulfide repair, comprehensive analysis, intelligent management, automatic alarm, and other functions. Under the premise of ensuring the system operation safety, promote battery performance, safe and reliable.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on transient power characteristics of wind power grid-connected system under grid voltage sag
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The transient power characteristics of grid connected wind power which composed by many paralleled wind turbines, transformer and collection line, will significantly affect the safety of the power grid and the wind farm itself. In this paper is presented a model of Doubly-fed Wind Power Generation Unit(DFWPGU), which includes two control measures: one is the outer voltage loop and inner current loop model for grid-side converter, the other is the external reactive loop and inner current loop model for rotor side converter. In order to analyze the transient power characteristics, the topology of Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) wind power integration is built, and a circuit for the two-port network formed by DFWPGU side and grid side is derived by network transformation. Additionally, the mathematical relationship among the power consumption of the two-port network, the grid voltage, line parameters and wind power output is deduced based on the equivalent circuit. The simulation of wind power grid-connected system is conducted in PSCAD/EMTDC. The proposed control scheme of DFWPGU is validated. What's more, it is pointed out that collection line has transient reactive load characteristics during grid voltage dropping and the reactive power loss of collection line changes with line length and DFWPGU's active output.

articleTitle: The research of three phase four wire active power filter on small independent micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The harmonic had a bad influence on power quality on micro-grid, so it is very necessary to find an effective way to suppress the harmonic. New control method of three phase four wire active power filter (APF) is applied to suppress harmonic in micro-grid in this paper. Compared with traditional single methods, one cycle control method and improved space vector pulse width (SVPWM) method are combined, the new control method omitted the harmonic detection circuit, reduce the switching loss in certain degree and the utilization ratio of the DC side voltage is improved. The model of new control method of three phase four wire APF model and small independent micro-grid model are built. Then simulation analysis on small independent micro-grid harmonic suppression is made. Simulation results show that one cycle controlled three phase four wire APF has a good compensation effect in harmonic suppression on small independent micro-grid.

articleTitle: Research on reliability-based feeder system planning methods
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Feeder system is an important part of the distribution system, which is not only shouldering the mission of fulfilling social responsibility, but also related to economic benefit of power supply companies. In the traditional planning method of feeder system, power supply reliability is implicitly reached by “N-1” criterion, but it is not particularly effective in reducing costs and handling budgets. Therefore, this planning method does not meet distribution network differentiation and meticulous management requirements and it's difficult to protect the interests of power supply companies and consumers, unable to adapt to future development needs of distribution network. In this paper, based on the different requirements for power supply reliability in different regions, the key elements of feeder system (feeder capacity, zone, segmentation, protection, switching time, etc.) and their flexible configuration method were proposed. Based on coordination accident support capacity of different zone switching mode and transfer capability for feeder system, feeder system planning method that supports feeder layer outage, transformer outage and substation outage and the overall process of feeder system reliability design were put forward, to ensure planning scheme achieve satisfactory electrical performance, accident control, optimal power supply reliability and economy. Finally, distribution network optimal planning in high reliability demonstration area of a city was selected as an actual case and satisfied planning scheme was obtained, to verify the effectiveness of the proposed planning methods.

articleTitle: Robust optimal dispatch model of islanded microgrids with uncertain renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To handle fluctuation and intermittence of renewable energy sources, this paper proposes a robust microgrid dispatch model considering variability in renewable energy generation. Compared to the previous robust model, the proposed model takes time factor into account. To solve the optimization problem efficiently, this paper presents the mixed integer linear programming and column and constraint generation algorithm. As an example, an islanded microgrid with a wind turbine(WT), a photovoltaic cell(PV), a battery energy storage system(BESS), a micro turbine(MT), a diesel engine(DE) and a fuel cell(FC) is studied, and simulation results demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Short-circuit calculation method for islanded micro-grid based on master-slave control
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The quick response of inverter integrated distribution generation (HDG) source under fault makes the equivalent circuit of sequence network different from traditional power system. Based on the control strategy and the equivalent model of inverter integrated distributed generation (IIDG) under fault, IIDG source can be taken as voltage source or current source in sequence-network. With the analysis of sequence network for micro-grid with multi-DG integrated, this paper presents a novel short-circuit calculation method for islanded micro-grid based on master-slave control. The proposed short-circuit calculation method is based on the equivalent model of HDG considering unbalanced control and, consequently, is applicable to unbalanced systems. PSCAD/EMTDC simulation studies have demonstrated the proposed scheme can accurately figure out the fault current.

articleTitle: An adaptive distance backup protection setting scheme according to the power flow transfer
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The removal of one of the transmission lines will cause power flow transfer. The transferred load of for the affected lines is different. According to the degree of the power flow transfer and using the flow transfer coefficient as the weight, this paper proposes an adaptive distance backup protection scheme. Based on the real-time flow distribution measured by the wide-area measurement system (WAMS), the flow transfer coefficient can be calculated. Then, using the coefficient as a weight, the degree of the setting impedance shrinkage can be adjusted. This scheme could not only prevent maloperation, but also identify the fault and it has the ability of enduring transition resistance. The simulation results on an IEEE 39-bus testing system illustrate the validity of the scheme.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of active distribution network with distributed renewable power plant cluster
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Based on the research of single distributed generation output characteristics, the united operating features of distributed renewable power plant cluster will be analyzed in this paper. It is also necessary to put forward an optimal structure and control strategy of distributed renewable power plant cluster. Active distribution network is a new development trend in power system area nowadays. With the distributed renewable power plant cluster integrated into current distribution networks, reliability analysis of power system shall be researched when considering the characteristics of active distribution networks. Use sequential Monte-Carlo simulation method to calculate the reliability indexes of distribution networks considering different distributed energy permeability, network structure, and distribution automation level. Taking a typical area as an example, analyze the changes of distribution network reliability after the distributed renewable power plant cluster integration. This article finally gives suggestions on how to plan and control the active distribution network with distributed renewable power plant cluster integration.

articleTitle: Effect of load on zero-sequence current in low resistance grounding system with complex grounding fault
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The events that a single-line fault evolves into a multi-line fault are increasing recently in China Southern Power Grid. To make matters worse, zero-sequence current is closely related to the load in fault lines particularly when a complex multi-line single-phase grounding fault (SPGF) occurs in a low resistance grounding system. In this case, the load factor must be considered, otherwise it may result in unneglectable calculation errors. Therefore, a comprehensive theory analysis on the relation between zero-sequence current and load was carried out for complex multi-line SPGF firstly. On this basis, the influence mechanism of load variation on zerosequence currents was analyzed in detail, and some general rules were revealed at last. The conclusions summarized in this paper can provide a theoretical basis for improving the performance of zero-sequence current protection.

articleTitle: Information modeling of distribution grid's operation situation under disastrous condition and its application
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Key technologies of operation situational awareness tackling with disaster destruction will dramatically improve the safe and reliable operation level of smart distribution network. Based on IEC 61970/61968 standard, extending information models that can reflect the relevant situation of network operation have been established, which are about distribution equipment, distributed energy resource, strength of network topology and distribution network load. Analytic hierarchy process based synthesis method of multi-dimensional situation was presented. Messages which are of conformance to IEC 61968 standards for distribution network operation situation have been designed. Then information interaction process in an example scenario has been analyzed which is about situational risk warning. It lies the foundation for unified expression and application of situation awareness technology in both smart distribution grid operation, management and dispatching.

articleTitle: Control method of islanded microgrid to improve reactive power sharing and power quality
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Due to the influence of feeder impedance, reactive power supplied by distributed generation (DG) based on traditional droop control could not be shared according to their droop gains. This paper proposes a control strategy which is based on virtual impedance, frequency/voltage and reactive power regulation for islanded microgrid. Virtual impedance is added to existing control loops to improve the characteristics of output impedance, weaken the power coupled caused by resistive component. Secondary regulation on the voltage and frequency deviations from droop control, improves the quality of voltage and frequency. Secondary reactive power regulation directly controls the distribution of reactive power. Reactive power sharing can be obtained independently from inverter output voltage, and it can limit the reactive power sharing errors. A microgrid simulation model is built in Matlab/Simulink simulation platform, and simulation analyses verify the validity and feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Experience and challenges of SPG in the business of power distribution and retail
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Shaanxi Regional Electric Power Group Co., Ltd (SPG) is a state owned regional power company and directly belongs to the People's Government of Shaanxi Province in China. In 1989 the former SPG was set up and began its main business of electricity distribution and retail, which was simultaneously along with worldwide electric market reform. As an independent distribution and retail company in China, SPG has got a 26-year development history. This paper presents SPG's main experience of power distribution and retail, in particular the organization framework and business operation mode, and discusses the challenges with the New Electricity Reform in China. These experiences may be valuable to new retail companies set up under the present electric reform in China and be comparable with distribution and retail companies abroad.

articleTitle: Hierarchical multi-objective unit commitment optimization considering negative peak load regulation ability
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper proposed a multi-objective unit commitment model based on a comprehensive consideration of negative peak load regulation ability and operation cost of conventional generators. A hierarchical multi-objective optimization method based on discrete particle swarm optimization and predictor corrector interior point method (DPSO-PCIPM) is proposed. The final commitment solution can be selected from the Pareto front. A widely-used 10 unit system and its extended systems are adopted to evaluate the proposed model and solution method. The simulation results show that the proposed model and solution method is effective and efficient, especially for the large-scale systems.

articleTitle: Application of scaling genetic algorithms using mapreduce in optimizing the configuration of PMU
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Because the structure of power system is getting larger and more complex, the configuration of PMU become a more complicated problems. Some algorithms are used to optimize the configuration schemes and achieves anticipated goals, however some of them can not improve the measurement accuracy and increase the computational efficiency at the same time. In order to enhance the precision of state estimation and the efficiency of optimal configuration, this paper models genetic algorithm into the MapReduce model, so the MapReduce genetic algorithm(MRGA) possesses some parallel computing performance, such as scalability, better fitness convergence and so on. MRGA is implemented on computing clusters of Hadoop to search the optimal configuration of PMU. Meanwhile, this feasibility and the computing performance of MRGA is verified by IEEE14-node system, IEEE118-node system, and Wp2383-node system. This method has significant advantages in the installed PMU number, the diversity of solution, the astringency and the practicability.

articleTitle: A novel statistical Markov-based approach for modeling charging demand of plug-in electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The integration of a massive number of plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs) in power distribution infrastructure brings direct technical challenges to the network management in terms of planning, control and operation. In order to promote the penetration level of PEVs, it is important to understand the different PEV states as well as the PEV charging demand. This paper attempts to address such technical challenge to present a novel statistical modeling approach for PEV charging demand through adopting a Markov-based approach. Through the analysis of the available driving behavior statistics data, the PEV states can be mathematically formulated and derived. Through the adoption of Markov model and Monte Carlo simulation technique, the Markov transition probability matrix of PEVs can be obtained. As a result, the transition among different PEV states of individual PEVs can be explicitly described. A number of case studies are carried out to validate the effectiveness of the proposed modeling approach.

articleTitle: Screening method for optimal phase sequence of quadruple circuit power transmission line on the same tower based on a self-built PSCAD/EMTDC phase sequence commutation module
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: To meet the large transmission capacity requirement, the technology of multi-parallel transmission lines on same tower has been widely applied. However, the wrong arranged phase sequence easily triggers the unbalance of the electrical circuit. Therefore, through analyzing factors that influencing the electrical unbalance in four-parallel transmission line on the same tower and setting an objective function based on zero sequence and negative sequence through unbalanced degree, current circulation sequence unbalanced degree, and electrostatic sequence unbalanced degree, the study has aimed at screen the optimal phase sequence. The optimal phase sequence screening module for four-parallel transmission lines on the same tower was programmed by C and FORTRAN language in the PSCAD software. By traversing all the phase sequence automatically and analyzing the simulation result by MATLAB, The module can obtain phase sequence alignments and screen the optimal phase sequence. The simulating experiment result has illustrated that arranging four-parallel transmission lines on the same tower by the optimal phase sequence commutation model can effectively resolve the three-phase unbalance problem. In addition, it is also very economical and workable.

Author Keywords: Four-parallel transmission lines on the same tower

articleTitle: Study on unbalanced power flow in distribution network with distributed generators of power grid
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: With rapid increase in wind power penetration into the power grid, unbalanced power flow in distribution network with distributed generators is becoming increasingly important to power sysytem. Due to the variability and uncertainty of wind, such traditional unbalanced power flow analysis method for distributed power supply limit the use of the existing tools for decision-making under uncertain conditions. As a result, unbalanced power flow analysis method, which provides information on uncertainty associated with wind power analysis, is gaining increased attention. This paper presents a novel hybrid intelligent algorithm for deterministic unbalanced power flow in distribution network with distributed generators that utilizes a combination of Cauchy particle swarm optimization(CPSO) and fuzzy ARTMAP (FA) network, which is optimized by using PSD-BPA. The performance of the proposed model is assessed utilizing wind power data from the Baolihua wind farm in Southern China. Unbalanced power flow in distribution network with distributed generators is researched. The typical static load model is established and the impact of distributed generators on feeder voltage profile is analyzed under unbalanced loads. The simulation results are given. References for the global planning of unbalance compensation in distribution network can be provided by the study.

articleTitle: An adaptive distance protection of wind farms connected using natural frequency and characteristic frequency
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) usually operates at variable speed and constant frequency mode in normal conditions, the stator current frequency is related with pre-fault generator speed when three-phase fault happens, if the pre-fault generator speed is non-rated value, the fault current frequency deviates 50Hz. Therefore, the traditional distance protection based on rated power frequency will be mal-operated. Based on this, this paper analyzes the frequency components of the fault current using Prony algorithm, and then presents an adaptive distance protection which combined the natural frequency and the characteristic frequency for the grid connected wind farms, the protection adjusts the round impedance characteristic adaptively with pre-fault generator speed. PSCAD simulation results show that the principle has good performance, it can correctly judge line faults, thus effectively improves the corrective action of the relay protection with wind farms.

articleTitle: Area backup protection based on substation's secondary-DC-loss
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: A scheme of substation SDL (secondary-DC-loss) protection based on the regional grid information is proposed, which can quickly isolate the fault when the in-substation or outlet-line fault occurs in a substation with SDL. With the substations as the objects, the concept of regional master-slave station protection system and its construction modes are proposed, which realizes the effective detection of the SDL of substation protection system by the aid of the regional process-level communication network and the communication power-supply independent of the protection power-supply, and a complete scheme of SDL protection is further proposed. The results of RTDS test show that, the proposed method and scheme can correctly detect the status of substation SDL and quickly isolate the faults in the SDL area.

articleTitle: Analysis for fusing time of fuse under effect of harmonics based on FE method
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: As harmonic can change the fusing time of fuse, this paper established finite element (FE) model of sand current-limiting fuse in ANSYS, and analyzed the influence of harmonic content and harmonic frequency on the fusing time of fuse by thermoelectric coupling simulation of the FE model.

articleTitle: Failure risk assessment method of electric energy meter based on state evaluation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Comprehensive evaluation the operation state of electric energy meter, put forward a kind of electric energy meter failure probability calculation method. Based on the state evaluation to the electric energy meter, the evaluation results and the failure statistics is associated, through inversion calculation correlation coefficient, fitting the failure probability curve of electric energy meter. Examples of calculation indicate that the failure probability is basically in line with the actual situation of the equipment performance, it's a effective method for estimating the apparatus's failure probability in the current operating state, data support is provided for the quantitative risk assessment of electric energy meter.

articleTitle: A novel objective function and analysis for optimal SVC parameters design to damping subsynchronous resonance
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a novel robust SVC controller is designed to damping subsynchronous resonance in power system with series capacitor compensation. A midpoint-located SVC is introduced for damping torsional oscillations and simultaneously for improving power transfer capacity. The different operation conditions are gathered to construct a “set” first. In this “set”, the formula of supplementary damping is derived based of complex torque coefficient. The problem of mitigating SSR is turned into supplying enough positive damping and the calculation is reduced compared to the normal eigenvalue methods. In order to supply positive supplementary damping, the phase characteristic and its feasible ranges of the controller are collected in the “set”, and the parameters are tuned to satisfied these constraints. Finally, the gain of the controller is chosen to achieve the requirement of amplitudes. Since the feasible range and this method are based of different operation conditions, the controller is robust. Eigenvalues analysis and time domain simulation under a large disturbance are considered to investigate the robustness. The study is performed on the system adapted from the IEEE First Benchmark Model. All the simulations are carried out in PSCAD/EMTDC environment.

articleTitle: Research on joint coordination control of stand-alone wind-solar systems with battery storage
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: This paper presents a power coordinated control strategy based on the maximum power point tracking (hereafter for MPPT) control, load power point tracking(hereafter for LPPT) and battery charging and discharging according to the relationship between the system energy flow and the operation condition of Wind-solar Systems with Battery Storage (hereafter for WSSBS), and the realization method was presented referring to practical data. We comprehensively construct stand-alone WSSBS and take the actual light and wind speed as the input. Finally, the feasibility of the power coordinated control strategy is tested under the condition of the random wind, the light intensity and the load in the MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: Strategies and properties of local control for distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: In this paper, a local voltage control algorithm of Distributed Generation (DG) as on-grid inverter was proposed, and its strategies and properties were discussed. It is argued that the maximum voltage appears at the accessing point and thus it is feasible to apply local control of DG. Multi-round local control strategy based on regular time interval is also proposed. Within each round, the voltage is adjusted via controlling the active power and reactive power of DG with respective to the range of voltage limits. Furthermore, a series of damping factor is introduced to increase the stability of the control system. To verify the proposed algorithm, numerical tests are conducted on a case of IEEE 33-Bus DN. The results suggest that a reasonable damping factor will increase the performance of the local control system.

articleTitle: Energy storage capacity configuration for large-scale wind power accessed to saturated system
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: The wind power may cause ever-growing and serious stability hazard for power system, and energy storage plays a very important role in improving the static and dynamic stability of power system. The role of energy storage is introduced in solving wind power integration problem and an electromechanical static model of flow-based energy storage is set up. The capacity requirement of energy storage for system stability with wind integration is calculated by simulation, and relevant configuration method is proposed. In view of a typical power system with wind power integration, the required energy storage capacity is calculated with the proposed method for achieving the static and dynamic stability. Finally, simulation has proved the effectiveness of the proposed configuration strategy.

articleTitle: Study on calculation method of carbon emission in utilization of ACCC conductor in new or modified power lines
publicationTitle: 2016 China International Conference on Electricity Distribution (CICED)
abstract: Driven by higher energy and electricity demand, the world's power grid system has leapfrogged from conventional grids to modern grids, and from isolated urban grids to transregional and transnational interconnected large grids. Some technologies and equipment have been innovated to adapt the acceleration of global energy interconnection. A new type of overhead conductor with a polymer composite core (ACCC) is attracting more attention in global energy interconnection owing to their outstanding mechanical properties and operating characteristics. The ACCC conductor exhibited greater ampacity than ACSR conductor at all operating temperatures. Hence, the transmission capacity of grid can be enhanced by utilization the ACCC conductor without replacement of steel tower and other facilities. This paper puts forward a theoretical calculation method about emission reductions of retrofit measures for utilization of ACCC conductor in new or modified power lines, based on the characteristics of line loss parameters, which are complex energy consumption status and comprehensive utilization of energy-saving technologies.
